Paperless Native is a free and open-source Android client for Paperless-ngx, the self-hosted document management system.
Connect to your own Paperless-ngx server and manage your document archive from your phone. No cloud services, no data ever leaves your device or your own server.
 Features 
• Browse, search, and filter your entire document library
• Upload documents from your camera or photo library
• View PDF and image documents directly in the app
• Edit document metadata: title, correspondent, tags, document type, storage path, dates, and custom fields
• Manage tags, correspondents, document types, storage paths, mail accounts, mail rules and workflows
• Dashboard with document statistics
• Full-text search with filtering
• Biometric authentication
 Privacy 
This app collects no analytics data, uses no third-party SDKs, and does not contact any server other than your own Paperless-ngx instance. The only data stored on your device is your server URL and an authentication token, held in the system's encrypted secure storage.
HTTP connections are allowed so that users running Paperless-ngx on a local network without TLS can still connect.
 Requirements 
A running, accessible Paperless-ngx instance (self-hosted)
 Source code 
https://github.com/afoni95/react-native-paperless

fdroid:de.wivewa.dialer.name: Welefon
fdroid:de.wivewa.dialer.description:
Welefon is a Phone App that is simple and modern at the same time. You can dial numbers and receive calls. It does not do anything you do not need, e.g. provide a contact list that your system contact App alrady contains.
The special feature of Welefon is an API that allows a seamlessly integration of other apps in your phone experience. The Welefon source code contains an example App that uses the API in the folder apidemoapp.
Using this API, other Apps can receive details about the current calls. Like the deprecated PhoneStateListener of Android, this contains the phone number. In contrast to the PhoneStateListener, you do not need to fear the removal of the API. Additionally, Welefon includes details of calls in the background, e.g. calls that are in the state "hold".
Welefon can receive additional caller details from other Apps. This can be a caller name, a caller details action and a RemoteView. The received caller name is shown as you expect it, completly independent of the system contact list. If a detail action is provided, then you can tap on the name to jump directly to the right place in the other App.
The RemoteViews are the method that allows Widgets on your homescreen. The same method can be used to show additional details and controls in the call screen. This allows showing any extra details.
Of course this is safe and secure: The Welefon API can only be used with your permission.

COMING FROM ANOTHER APP?
• Import your Google Keep archive (notes, checklists, labels)
• Import and export Markdown for Obsidian, VS Code, Typora
• Encrypted local backup & restore
SHARE & EXPORT

BEAUTIFUL & LIGHT

• Home-screen widgets: quick note and interactive checklist

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

fdroid:net.millaguie.cosmovisor.name: Cosmovisor
fdroid:net.millaguie.cosmovisor.summary: Spot satellites overhead in augmented reality
fdroid:net.millaguie.cosmovisor.description:
Point your phone at the sky and Cosmovisor overlays the satellites
passing over you right now on the camera image, in augmented reality.
Plus pass predictions, ham-radio tools and a star map.
All the orbital math runs on your device. Works fully offline once the
public orbital data has been downloaded.
FEATURES
* AR view: camera preview with satellites drawn at their real sky
 position, refreshed every second. Tap one for its data.
* "Only visible" filter: hides everything you could not actually see
 right now, using the satellite's brightness and how dark your sky
 is at this hour.
* Satellite list: search by name or NORAD id; filter by category
 (ISS, Starlink, GPS, weather, science...), object type
 (payload / rocket body / debris), country/operator, orbit regime
 (LEO/MEO/GEO/HEO), radio band and "above the horizon now".
* Passes: 24-hour pass predictions grouped by day, with opt-in
 alerts before a pass.
* Sky and astronomy: Sun, Moon and planets, Moon calendar, eclipses,
 a pannable planetarium, Starlink train finder, and bright comets
 and asteroids from JPL's Small-Body Database.
* Ham radio: live full-duplex Doppler (including inverted
 transponders), rig and rotor control over TCP (rigctld/rotctld),
 ISS SSTV and APRS decoded from the phone mic, RTL-SDR reception
 over rtl_tcp (NBFM, SSTV, NOAA APT weather imagery), and a QSO log
 with ADIF export. All opt-in.
* Night mode: a red theme to preserve your dark adaptation.
PRIVACY
Privacy comes first. No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no telemetry.
* Your GPS location is processed only on the device. It is never sent
 or stored off-device.
* The only network requests fetch public orbital data (CelesTrak, and
 optionally the SatNOGS transponder catalog and JPL small-body data).
 They are anonymous and carry no personal data or location.
* Satellite brightness data ships inside the app. Refreshing it from
 our own server is optional and off by default, because it is the
 only download that has no upstream source to ask first.
* Works offline with the last downloaded data.
Cosmovisor is fully de-Googled: no Google Play Services, no Firebase,
no trackers. Location uses the AOSP LocationManager and the fonts are
bundled, so it runs on degoogled devices.
Free software, licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0 or
later (GPL-3.0-or-later).

apple-macos:6479984191.name: SplitCam Live Streaming
apple-macos:6479984191.description:
SplitCam turns your Mac into a complete live streaming studio. Combine multiple cameras, screen captures, images, and video files into a single scene, broadcast to several platforms at once, and use your customized feed as a virtual camera in Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, OBS, and any other app that accepts a webcam. Built natively for Apple Silicon, SplitCam delivers smooth 4K performance with minimal CPU load — whether you're a streamer, educator, content creator, or remote professional.
◆ What you can do with SplitCam
Multistream to 5+ platforms simultaneously. Push a single broadcast to YouTube, Twitch, Facebook and any RTMP-compatible service — no third-party restreaming subscription required. Configure individual bitrate and resolution per destination to match each platform's requirements.
Look professional in every video call. Use SplitCam as a virtual camera in Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Skype, and Discord. Apply backgrounds, overlays, beautification, and lighting correction that follow you into every meeting — your Mac's built-in camera becomes a studio camera.
Build scenes from multiple sources. Mix several USB and built-in cameras, screen and window captures, browser sources, images, and video clips into a single composition. Switch between scenes live with smooth transitions, and reuse your scene library across sessions.
Control SplitCam from your iPhone. Use the free SplitCam Remote app for iOS to switch scenes, start and stop streaming or recording, and manage your broadcast wirelessly — without touching your Mac during a live session.
Record while you stream. Capture local high-quality recordings in parallel with your live broadcast for editing, repurposing, or archival — no need to re-record content separately.
◆ Key features
- True multistreaming — direct RTMP, RTMPS, and SRT output to multiple destinations at once with per-stream encoding settings.
- Virtual camera — recognized as a standard video device by every major macOS app, including Zoom, Teams, Meet, OBS, and web browsers.
- Real-time GPU effects — backgrounds, blur, beautification, color correction, and filters rendered through Metal for low latency and minimal battery drain on laptops.
- Advanced scene compositor — unlimited layers with positioning, cropping, masking, chroma key, and transformations. Save and reload complete scene setups for different streaming scenarios.
- Screen and window sharing — capture full displays, specific application windows, or individual browser tabs at up to 4K resolution.
- High-resolution streaming — up to 4K at 60 fps with hardware acceleration via VideoToolbox, keeping CPU usage low even during demanding broadcasts.
- Wireless remote control — manage scenes, streaming, and recording from your iPhone with the companion SplitCam Remote app, ideal for solo streamers, presenters, and instructors who can't reach the keyboard mid-session.
- Built-in recorder — save broadcasts locally in MP4 with custom bitrate, resolution, and codec settings, independent of your live stream parameters.
- Audio mixer — combine system audio, microphone input, and individual application sound with per-source levels, monitoring, and noise suppression.
◆ Why creators choose SplitCam
- No subscription tax for multistreaming. Most tools require a paid restreaming service to broadcast to more than one platform. SplitCam handles it directly from your Mac.
- Works everywhere on macOS. The virtual camera integrates seamlessly with conferencing apps, browsers, and streaming software - set it up once, use it anywhere.
- GPU-accelerated rendering through Metal keeps your Mac cool and responsive during long sessions.
- Hands-free control. With SplitCam Remote on iPhone, you stay in front of the camera while managing the broadcast - no awkward reaches for the keyboard mid-stream.
- Free to start. Core streaming, virtual camera, and recording features are available at no cost. Optional Pro features unlock advanced workflows for power users

Some key features include: - Asynchronous spike exchange that overlaps compute and communication. - Efficient sampling of voltage and current on all back ends. - Efficient implementation of all features on GPU. - Reporting of memory and energy consumption (when available on platform). - An API for addition of new cell types, e.g. LIF and Poisson spike generators. - Validation tests against numeric/analytic models and NEURON. fedora-packages:ast/ast.name: ast
fedora-packages:ast/ast.summary: A Library for Handling World Coordinate Systems in Astronomy
fedora-packages:ast/ast.description: The AST library provides a comprehensive range of facilities for attaching world coordinate systems to astronomical data, for retrieving and interpreting that information and for generating graphical output based on it. It's main selling points are: * Ease of use. * Facilities for generating plots of generalized non-linear, potentially discontinuous 2-D or 3-D coordinate systems, with detailed control of the appearance of the plot. * Facilities for converting transparently between different coordinate systems, including a wide range of celestial, spectral and time coordinate systems. * Facilities for searching a general collection of connected coordinate systems for a coordinate system with any given set of characteristics. * Allows code for handling WCS information to be written in a general way without regard to the specific nature of the coordinate systems being handled (i.e. whether they represent sky positions, spectral positions, focal plane positions, pixel positions, etc). * Flexible system for saving and retrieving WCS information, including (but not limited to) a range of different popular FITS descriptions. * Written in C but has interfaces for C, Fortran, Java (via JNI), Perl, and UNIX shell. * Extensive documentation.

fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.name: flexmark-java-ext-typographic
fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.description: Flexmark-java is a Java CommonMark (spec 0.28) parser using the blocks first, inlines after Markdown parsing architecture. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains an extension for typographic processing. It converts: - apostrophe (`'`) to `’` - ellipsis (`...` or `. . .`) to `…` - en dash (`--`) to `–` - em dash (`---`) to `—` - single quoted `'text'` to `‘text’` - double quoted `"text"` to `“text”` - double angle quoted `<<text>>` to `«text»`

As such, GENESIS, and its version for parallel and networked computers (PGENESIS) was the first broad scale modeling system in computational biology to encourage modelers to develop and share model features and components. Most current GENESIS applications involve realistic simulations of biological neural systems. Although the software can also model more abstract networks, other simulators are more suitable for backpropagation and similar connectionist modeling. Please install the genesis-simulator-doc sub package for documentation.

fedora-packages:gfs-orpheus-classic-font.description: This rare typeface was first used in the last decade of the 19th century and was offered for use until the 1960s. Its design is characterized by an outstanding subtlety and purity in its letter-forms. With almost round counters, a low x-height, a fairly high contrast and a nearly horizontal axis, it is a very elegant and legible typeface that works excellently on small text. GFS Orpheus Classic is a digital reproduction of this brilliant design. It was digitized by George Triantafyllakos based on specimens from Linotype Co.

Your daily spiritual companion in Jewish tradition

- Special prayers for Shabbat, Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur, Passover, Hanukkah, Purim, and other holy days

Judaism Daily is your faithful companion through joy and struggle, in the quiet of the morning and the stillness of night. Be inspired. Grow in faith. Connect with tradition.

bluejetty:00151387:ios.description:
The TOYOTA DASHCAM App allows access to your genuine TOYOTA DASHCAM with your iPhone using the built in WIFI connection. Adjust the camera settings and/or download your memorable videos directly using your iPhone.
App Features:
- View and download your recorded videos directly to your phone
- Adjust camera settings:
 • Video quality
 • Buzzer noise levels
 • Turn ON/OFF Adventure Mode, and adjust SD card’s Adventure Mode memory allocation
 • Turn ON/OFF Parking Surveillance Mode, and adjust sensitivity, wake-up modes and surveillance start delay functions
 • Live view feature
- For your safety, the app will disconnect from the TOYOTA DASHCAM if vehicle movement is detected. Do not operate your iPhone while vehicle is in motion.
Camera Features:
Your TOYOTA DASHCAM features 5 unique recording modes: 3 automatic modes and 2 manual modes activated using the “ACTION” button:
1) Continuous recording – automatically records when vehicle ignition is on. Never worry about turning on the camera to start recording. When SD card is full, oldest files are automatically overwritten. 
2) Automatic Incident recording – if an abnormal shock is detected when driving, camera automatically locks and protects the video file from overwriting for review at a later time. Sensitivity can be adjusted. Maximum of 10 event videos can be protected from overwriting.
3) Parking surveillance – when vehicle is parked with vehicle ignition off, camera automatically wakes up and starts recording if an abnormal shock is detected. Parking surveillance files are locked and protected from overwriting. Sensitivity can be adjusted. Maximum of 10 parking surveillance recordings can be protected from overwriting.
4) Manual Flagged Event recording – capture interesting moments by pressing the “ACTION” button on the camera. The current video segment(s) 12 seconds before and 8 seconds after button activation will be protected. Maximum of 5 manual event recordings can be protected from overwriting. 
5) Adventure Mode recording – capture your driving adventures. Press and hold the “ACTION” button on the camera for 1 second to start protecting the recorded videos. The Adventure Mode recording will stop protecting files after maximum time is reached, or when the “ACTION” button is pressed and held again for 1 second. Maximum of 1 hour of Adventure Mode videos can be protected from overwriting.

bluejetty:00142732:ios.description:
Tacbo is a simple and flexible soccer tactics board built for coaches.
Create formations, visualize strategy, and share your game plans with your team.
Design smarter practices and winning lineups in seconds.
Tacbo is a powerful yet easy-to-use soccer tactics board designed for coaches who want to clearly communicate strategy and game plans.
Create your own customized tactics board, turn your ideas into visual game situations, and instantly share them with players and staff.
Perfect for youth soccer, high school teams, club coaches, and competitive programs.
-What You Can Do
BOARD Mode – Create & Present
Use Tacbo as a professional soccer coaching board.
• Save boards as images
• Edit board titles
• Draw directly on the field with touch
• Toggle team visibility on/off
• Add and move the ball icon
• Move players freely
• Reset players to default positions
BUILD Mode – Customize Your Board
Create your own personalized soccer tactics board.
All changes are automatically saved.
• Adjust field size
• Add field guide lines
• Customize player icon colors
• Set default player positions
• Define player range areas (calculated based on field size)
• Show or hide player names
• Edit player names
-Advanced Zone Feature
With the Zone feature, you can:
• Analyze space based on opponent positioning and movement range
• Identify open areas on the field
• Evaluate positioning based on passing distance
• Improve team shape and spacing
Tacbo helps you transform abstract tactical ideas into clear, visual strategy.

bluejetty:00015177:ios.description:
Want to Be an Artist?
Welcome to Drawing Academy - a safe, offline drawing game with no ads, perfect for kids ages 2-7. 
It’s the ultimate fun coloring and drawing game for preschool preparation. Every line your child traces sparks creativity, laughter, and joyful learning.
What kids explore inside:
100+ Live Templates: Complete an outline to see butterflies flutter, rockets zoom, and hedgehogs curl.
Tracing Alphabet & Numbers: Trace glowing letters and numbers with coloring activities, reinforced by cheerful chants. Spell simple words while drawing.
Theme Adventures: Draw cute animals like unicorns, sea animals, and dinosaurs by numbers; explore cars, funny monsters, shapes and more!
Magic Color Lab: Shake your device to sprinkle neon confetti and paint with vibrant colors to playful music.
Why parents trust Drawing Academy:
Research-Backed Program: Designed by educators, this app helps children draw easily, improving fine motor skills, spatial logic, speech, and memory.
Ad-free & developed taking into account COPPA requirements. Secure and private, no banners, no pop-ups, and no data tracking — just pure creativity.
Works anywhere. Ideal as an offline drawing companion during flights, road trips, or family visits — no Wi-Fi required.
Parental control panel. Limit playtime, lock purchases, and relax — this is a coloring game with parental control you can trust.
Always ready for takeoff!
Download content once, and Drawing Academy is always ready. From cafes with spotty service to flights at 30,000 feet, enjoy offline learning and drawing without interruptions.
Press "Get" today — transform idle moments into creative masterpieces.
With Drawing Academy, kids learn to draw, master their ABCs, color delightful creatures, and build essential school-ready confidence — all in a secure, offline painting environment parents love and trust.
Subscription Details
Get access to over 100 cute characters and drawings after subscribing to the Drawing Academy. Just download and go!
A free 7-day trial period is available to you, or you can subscribe right after download.
After your free trial, your subscription will automatically start unless you adjust your subscription settings at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
We provide different subscription options for your convenience: monthly and annual subscription.
If you change your mind at any point, cancellation is easy through your iTunes settings.
Payment for subscriptions will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Your subscription automatically renews unless you turn the renewal feature off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period.
You can cancel your subscription anytime through your Account Settings without any cancellation fees.
You can use your subscription on any device registered with your Apple ID.
ABOUT BINI GAMES 
Bini Games (ex-Bini Bambini) was started in 2012 by four parents with experience in children's education. And today, we are a 250-people team of dedicated designers, artists, animators, and educators. To date, we have more than 30 apps, with our user base having reached 98M.
We are inspired by the idea of bringing fun into early education and enhancing a child's natural love of learning through educational apps for kids.
If you need help, have questions or just want to say “hi!”, get in touch at feedback@bini.games
https://teachdraw.com/terms-of-use/
https://teachdraw.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00174470:ios.description:
– Sound. Stillness. Resonance. –
For more than 15 years, i-Qi has gently accompanied people into the day and into mindful moments of calm and meditation with the authentic sound of singing bowls.
Together with Olli Hess, authentic, uncompressed recordings of real singing bowls and instruments were created, featuring exceptionally long natural decays. Peter Hess recommends i-Qi in his book "Sound Transformation" – a special honor and recognition.
Creating space.
Space to awaken.
Space for stillness.
Space for yourself.
– Wake Gently –
Let the sounds of real singing bowls guide you softly into the day. Gentle, gradually shortening sound intervals lead your awareness from sleep into wakefulness without harsh alarms or stress.
The waking principle is inspired by the Golden Ratio. Alternatively, you can choose continuous sounds or create your own personalized wake-up compositions.
– Find Your Calm –
Whether for meditation, yoga, or a mindful pause during the day, i-Qi accompanies you with the sounds of authentic singing bowls and instruments.
Combine multiple sounds, adjust their individual volume, and create your own personal soundscape. The exceptionally long natural decays produce rich overtones and create a living, meditative atmosphere.
– Sound Journeys –
Discover Sound Journeys – ever-changing meditative soundscapes.
Random variations in timing and strike intensity let your singing bowls unfold differently every time you listen. Each journey becomes unique, gently preventing the mind from expecting fixed patterns while keeping attention rooted in the present moment.
– Support i-Qi –
For many years, i-Qi has been lovingly crafted and continuously refined. Your voluntary support helps bring new ideas and features to life.
As a thank you, you'll receive access to 10 premium singing bowls with exceptionally long natural decays, as well as Sound Journeys – ever-changing meditative soundscapes that unfold uniquely with every session.
Of course, all existing features of i-Qi remain fully available to everyone.

bluejetty:00073360:ios.description:
My Hamster Story: Merge Dream Mall is a unique management game that features an adorable art style and a soothing pace. Create a memorable experience in the bits of time after work and study!
ADORABLE HAMSTERS & LOVELY STORIES
You're here to manage a mall for hamsters. You'll meet all these adorable hamsters, and they'll come to you with all kinds of requests or even just to talk to you. And don't forget to tease these cute ones from time to time, unexpected things might happen!
Some of them are into workouts, some are still students, and some have got a deep pocket...
There are even landlord hamsters and those wearing pure gold necklaces!
MANAGEMENT & LEADERSHIP
Your employees, cute as they are, might also be a problem for you, because it's really important for your mall to make them happy when they are in a bit of trouble or when they hand in a resignation application to you.

bluejetty:00136267:ios.name: iCollect Vinyl Figures: Funko
bluejetty:00136267:ios.summary: iCollect Vinyl Figures (for Funko, Hot Toys, NECA, Weta, MiniCo, and other toys) is the #1 app on the Apple App Store for managing your vinyl figure collection or inventory. This app works on all device sizes and syncs directly with our iPh
bluejetty:00136267:ios.description:
iCollect Vinyl Figures (for Funko, Hot Toys, NECA, Weta, MiniCo, and other toys) is the #1 app on the Apple App Store for managing your vinyl figure collection or inventory. This app works on all device sizes and syncs directly with our iPhone, iPad, Mac apps, as well as our apps on other platforms. Scan in or search for any figure you own or want and add them to your lists. Full of incredible features!
• Manage and inventory any vinyl figure toy collectible.
• Loaded with millions of figures from around the world in our database.
• Full barcode scanning and database search.
• Cloud Backup
• Sync across multiple devices, including iPad, iPhone, Mac, and more.
• Supports input in any language and allows selections of any country and currency.
• Filters, sorting, and importing.
• Three different custom layouts.
• Exporting
• Multi-level sorting
• Shake to Select
• Default Field Data
• Customize which fields are displayed
• Section Counts
• Share your figure collection with friends or on social media like Facebook and Twitter.
• Format your Titles with A, An, or The removed.
• Extra features like colored Themes, Dark Mode support, and more.
• Every field is editable.
• Store up to four pictures per figure, including front, back, and inside images of vinyl figures.
• Personal details per figure including Loaned, Purchase Price, Purchase Date, Date Added, Personal Rating, Last Read, Storage Location, Notes, Estimated Value, and more.
• Index bars and search for quick access in large vinyl figure collections.
This app is a completely new collecting experience, written from the ground up for iOS 18, the latest devices like iPhone 16, 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max, SE 2, iPad Pro, and full Universal iPhone/iPad support built-in and syncs directly to our Mac app. Our app was created with a cloud database backend designed specifically to allow each item to be stored with its own individual attributes.
We can import your vinyl figure collection from nearly anywhere. Just send us your import file and we'll get you rolling.
Note: Large collections require an in-app purchase to unlock unlimited storage. You will be prompted when you reach the limits of your selected collectible type.
Data provided by Amazon, Google, eBay, and users like you.
-------
PRIVACY INFO
-------
All of these are OPTIONAL when using our app.
Email Address: We only collect this if you enable Cloud Sync as a login user ID.
Contacts: We only use your contacts if you want us to for "Loaned To" fields.
Photos or Videos: We only use photos that you choose for your item details.
Camera: We only use this for barcode scanning.
None of your data is sold. See our Privacy Policy URL for details.
We do use Google Firebase and Facebook SDK's for analytics and crash data. See their policies for additional details on what they may track about your device.
-------
TERMS OF USE: https://www.icollecteverything.com/privacy-policy/

◆ ママへのメッセージが毎日届く！

はじめて授乳した日、はじめて爪切りをした日…何気ないはじめてを記録することで思い出につながる！
◆ 無料の「ninaruオンライン教室」で育児の悩みや疑問をサクッと解決！
新生児のお世話方法や、寝かしつけ、離乳食、モンテッソーリ教育など…ママが知りたい情報を専門家から直接学ぶ＆質問することができる！
何度受けても無料＆スマートフォンから顔出しなしで参加できるので、育児で忙しいママにも人気！

同じ月齢の子を持つママたちのリアルな体験談が読める！毎日新着の体験談を配信。授乳や離乳食、イヤイヤ期対策のヒントがあるかも？

タイマー機能で授乳時間を計測！記録を保存すれば子どものお世話の記録が残り、生活リズムを確認できる！
◆ 離乳食の献立を毎日提案！「離乳食の献立・食材リスト」
生後5ヶ月から毎日離乳食の献立を提案するので、今日は子どもに何を食べさせようかなと悩まない！食べた食材の記録やメモも簡単に残せる！
◆ 面倒な予防接種も「予防接種スケジュール」で楽ちん管理！
予定日を入力すると、接種日の前にお知らせしてくれる！打ち忘れの防止に便利
◆赤ちゃんのギャン泣きも「寝かしつけ・泣き止み音」でスッと泣き止む！
24種類の豊富な寝かしつけ・泣き止み音を収録！赤ちゃんのお気に入りの音を見つけられる
◆ 「成長スケジュール」で先の予定もバッチリ
「成長スケジュール」で赤ちゃんの成長の目安がわかれば、家族の予定も立てやすい
◆ 知りたい情報をすぐ検索できる！
検索機能だけでなく、カテゴリ分けされた記事一覧で、困ったときにすぐ調べられて便利
◆ 「お気に入り」で自分だけの育児書ができる！
この記事は必ず後で読み返したい！「お気に入り」機能を使えば、自分だけの育児書の出来上がり
◆ 「アカウント登録」で機種変更しても安心
アカウント登録をしておけば、携帯の紛失時や機種変更をしても、お子様のデータや予防接種の記録を新しい携帯に引き継ぐことができます！

【ninaru baby（ニナル ベビー）のコンセプト】
お腹の中で大切に育ててきた赤ちゃん。
妊娠から出産までがゴールと思いきや、これからがスタートです。
離乳食づくりや授乳など、
どう抱っこしたらいいのかな、母乳はどのくらいあげていいのかなと、お世話の方法や赤ちゃんのちょっとした反応に、不安になることもたくさんあります。
また、妊娠中とはちがって、
急に赤ちゃんが中心の生活に変わることで、出産後に戸惑いを覚えるママもいるかもしれません。
ninaru baby（ニナルベビー）では、日々のメッセージでママの気持ちに寄り添い、今必要な記事をお届けすることで、漠然とした不安を解消していきます。
赤ちゃんと一緒に笑顔で楽しく過ごせるよう、ママの育児・子育てを応援します！
※パパの場合は、パパ専用育児アプリ「パパninaru（パパニナル）」をご利用ください。
【ninaru baby制作スタッフより】
ninaru baby（ニナルベビー、になるべびー）をご覧いただき、ありがとうございます。
日々成長していく赤ちゃんに寄り添えることは、ママにとってかけがえのない時間です。
しかし、特に初産の場合、赤ちゃんのちょっとした反応や変化に戸惑ったり、人に相談できずに独りで抱えてしまったりするママも多くいます。
ninaru babyは、『絶対にママの味方であり続ける』アプリをめざして、メッセージ、デザイン、設計に想いを込めました。
ママと赤ちゃんの生活がもっともっと笑顔で溢れるように、毎日のお世話の悩みに応える情報を丁寧にお届けしていきます。
みなさまの育児・子育てのお役に立てれば幸いです。
もしご利用頂けましたら、ご感想もお待ちしております。
【アプリに不具合・問題がある場合】
アプリを起動することが出来ましたら、アプリ内の設定からお問い合わせください。
もしもアプリを起動することが出来なくなった場合、以下のメールアドレスまでご連絡ください。
ninaru-baby@eversense.co.jp

bluejetty:00174439:ios.description:
SEAiq USA is a full-featured marine navigation app for the United States. It automatically downloads and displays charts from NOAA and the US Army Corps of Engineers for the regions you select.
Features include:
* Waypoints
* Routes
* Tracks
* Night color modes
* Anchor alarm
* Automatic download and display of weather (wind & isobar)
* Chart measuring tools (EBL/VRM)
* Wi-Fi-based NMEA and AIS
* Vector charts
No purchase is required to view charts. Premium navigation features are enabled during a 7-day evaluation period. After that, an annual subscription is required. Existing one-time purchases retain the features they unlocked.
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00127206:ios.description:
Be Aware! The most popular and addictive adventure game is now available on the store! 
In Diamond Quest: Don't Rush!, you are an intrepid explorer, pressing deep into the jungles of Angkor Wat temple, the dungeons of Bavaria castle, and the icy Tibet caves. Your quest is collect a series of gems before heading for an exit that leads to the next room. 
In your adventure, you must cut through leaves, break cobwebs to find the precious jewels. Gravity takes hold of precariously balanced boulders and sends them toppling down to smash any slow-moving creatures - yourself included. At the end of each map, you must defeat a boss monster to escape for the next locale.
Features
- Fantastic Visual: Gorgeous HD graphics and lovely sound tracks.
- Exciting Gameplay: Tons of different obstacles and traps to get around: snakes, turtles, bombs, monkeys...Some where you have to dive into the water to complete your quest.
- Checkpoint: Re-spawn your self at the most recent checkpoint at anytime.
- Big Boss: So big and so hard to defeat. Be careful with your life.
- Mystic Tools: Use Mystic Hammer to break the weak walls, Mystic Hook to drag things and Freeze Hammer to freeze things.
- Challenge Puzzle: Challenge your brain and prove your intelligence with hundred of puzzles to solve.
Don't Rush! Otherwise you will be trapped
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00167804:ios.description:
Inspoy is a personal AI stylist that actually knows you: your colors, your body shape, your taste - and the clothes already hanging in your closet. It uses all of that every time it dresses you.
IT STARTS WITH YOU
A short style analysis builds your profile: your color season and palette, your body shape, your aesthetic. Every outfit, every suggestion and every shopping pick runs through it - so the answer is never "what's trending", it's "what works on you".
IT WORKS WITH WHAT YOU ALREADY OWN
Snap your clothes into a digital wardrobe and Inspoy turns them into outfits - combinations you'd never have tried, built from pieces you already love. Save the looks that work, for a dinner date, the office or a weekend away, and stop staring at a full closet with nothing to wear.
SEE IT ON YOU BEFORE YOU COMMIT
A dress you're not sure about, a jacket you've been eyeing, a new haircut or hair color - virtual try on puts it on your own photo in seconds, so you decide with your eyes, not your imagination. No fitting room, no regret.
SHOP WITHOUT THE GUESSWORK
Inspoy picks pieces in your palette and your style from brands you can buy today, and every product page shows how to style the item with your own wardrobe - so you buy things you'll wear, not things that die on a hanger.
WHEN YOU'RE NOT SURE - JUST ASK
Your AI stylist is a chat away: what to wear tonight, how to style wide-leg jeans, whether that coat flatters your palette. It answers with your wardrobe and your profile in mind, anytime.
Loved by 500,000+ people who found their style with Inspoy.
Inspoy is free to download. Premium features are available with a subscription.
This app contains affiliate links to Amazon. As an Amazon Associate, we earn from qualifying purchases.

Embark on a mesmerizing puzzle game adventure with Machinika: Atlas. Stranded within a crashed alien ship on Saturn's moon, "Atlas", assume the role of the museum researcher, the protagonist of Machinika: Museum, whose escape pod led them to the heart of an alien vessel.

- Play effortlessly with intuitive and enjoyable controls, ensuring that the complexity lies within the puzzles, not the gameplay.
- Dive into a mysterious narrative that beckons you to uncover the secrets hidden behind these intricate devices.
- Enjoy controller support or play with touch controls, it's up to you!

bluejetty:00180004:ios.summary:
Your fastest reading companion! Read aloud everything with natural AI voices!
ReadBit is a free text-to-speech reader that helps you to read aloud books, PDFs, docs, web articles and many other file formats. It saves a lot of time by insta
bluejetty:00180004:ios.description:
Your fastest reading companion! Read aloud everything with natural AI voices!
ReadBit is a free text-to-speech reader that helps you to read aloud books, PDFs, docs, web articles and many other file formats. It saves a lot of time by instantly converting any text to an audiobook, reading all the information at your desired speech rate and providing an excellent listening experience with natural lifelike voices.
Features
- Convert text files to audiobooks with advanced text-to-speech in 27 languages
- Supports websites, ePub, pdf, jpg, png and more
- Scan physical documents with your camera and listen
- Amazing listening experience with more than 120 voices
- No more robotic voices! Listen to everything with the most natural voices in the market
- Text reader highlights the document word by word as it reads to enhance engagement and comprehension
- Summarizes text and extracts valuable insights such as keywords, places, and characters across chapters
- Change the speech rate. Listen faster!
- Track your progress with a personal reading habit tracker
A Free Text to Speech (TTS) Reader
Text-to-speech is an amazing technology that converts all text into audiobooks, whether it’s an online book, a pdf, a school assignment, or a lengthy report.
Read Aloud Books, PDFs and Websites with Natural AI Voices
Driving? Or maybe taking a long walk? Listen to your books and web articles with natural, lifelike voices using our cutting-edge text-to-speech reader.
Reading Coach
Strong habits start with small steps! Reading Coach is a tool that serves your document in bites like IG stories, tailored for your daily reading time. We call them Bits, and they make reading easier and more fun than ever! 
Create Playlists
Create a list of your favorite blog posts, articles, books, or pdf and take them with you anywhere you go! You can create playlists to listen to your files back-to-back in your preferred order.
Highlight and Focus
The text reader highlights every word while reading out loud. You can scan physical documents and books to read along while listening. Highlighting the text increases your focus and helps you retain more information than just reading.
Need a spell checker?
Do you know what is one of the best things about a text-to-speech reader? You can use it as a spell checker. ReadBit will convert your file from text to speech, pronounce every word, and let you spot any misspelled words instantly.
Summarize and Save Time
ReadBit is not only a text reader but also a summarizer. It digs out the most relevant information like keywords, characters, and places.
ReadBit is developed by Mediate, an MIT spinoff AI start-up based in Boston. As Mediate, we develop innovative computer vision systems with the support of the National Science Foundation and the US Department of Veterans Affairs.
Subscription Plans:
ReadBit has limited access to some advanced features such as Natural Voices, Font Adjustments and Keywords. If you would like unlimited access, we have created subscription plans.
1 Month: $11.99
6 Month : $59.99 ~ $9.99/month
12 Months: $95.99 ~ $7.99/month
If you choose to purchase a subscription plan, the payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. All plans automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renew may be turned off by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. If you don't choose to purchase a plan, you can simply continue using designated ReadBit features for free.
You can read our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy from here: https://mediate.tech/policies

bluejetty:00146149:ios.description:
Would you like to have a chance to win real cash with your Bubble Shooter skills in game? Bubble Treasure is a good choice. 
It's a classic bubble shooter game that improve your bubble shooter skills while others race against the clock and get a chance to win real cash. As you win and level up, the prizes get bigger! All you need to do is blasting the bubbles and clearing the board as fast as you can.
Compete against other players! Play and win big!

It combines a modern look with a retro classic bubble shooter for a great experience and a chance to win big! Bubble Treasure supports online multiplayer, so you can use your abilities to the fullest. Under the same layout, everyone must race against time to pop all the bubbles. - Match 3 bubbles of the same color

- Real Cash tournaments
- Classic bubble shooter game

- Collect daily and free bonuses
- Play as long as you want without any annoying ads

bluejetty:00152015:ios.description:
The do-it-yourself Panasonic Home Network System makes it quick and easy to create a powerful, wireless network of cameras, sensors and controllers in and outside the home. And control it all from your smartphone and tablet with one simple app. 
The Home Network System also connects to your landline, to let you use smartphones or tablets as home phones.
http://www.panasonic.net/pcc/support/tel/homenetwork/
Main Features
General Functions
- Easy system setup wizard
- No monthly service fees – monitoring, notification and control are free
- Receive power outage alerts from AC-powered components
- Receive low-power alerts from battery-operated components
Indoor/Outdoor Camera Functions
- Cameras display real-time streaming 
- Automatically record video to Micro SD cards in system hub
- Quad view enables viewing up to four cameras simultaneously
- Select motion detection areas for specific recording and notification
- Indoor Baby Monitor plays lullabies
- Indoor/Outdoor Camera enables 2-way communication
- Arm and disarm features at home or away
- Receive alerts when armed sensors detect motion
- View alert event log
Home Control Functions
- Turn system components on/off at home or remotely
- Create smart plug schedules to turn on/off lamps and more 
Digital Cordless Handset Functions
- Arm and disarm system components
- Receive alerts from motion and window sensors
- View alert logs on LCD display
- Make and take calls using landline, and use as intercom
- Playback voicemail 
- View calling log
- Copy contact lists from smartphone and tablets 
- Transfer landline calls to smartphones and additional handsets
The app is kept alive in the background so that the app can receive outside calls and intercom calls, which results in battery consumption.

bluejetty:00021409:ios.name: image.canon
bluejetty:00021409:ios.summary: image.canon is a cloud service designed to ease your imaging workflow, whether you are a professional, enthusiast, or casual user. Connecting your Wi-Fi compatible Canon camera to the image.canon service will allow you to seamlessly upload
bluejetty:00021409:ios.description:
image.canon is a cloud service designed to ease your imaging workflow, whether you are a professional, enthusiast, or casual user. Connecting your Wi-Fi compatible Canon camera to the image.canon service will allow you to seamlessly upload all your images and movies in their original format and quality and access them from the dedicated app or a web browser – and automatically forward them to your computer, mobile devices, and third party services. 
[Features]
-All original images stay for 30 days
You can upload all of the images you have taken to image.canon cloud in original data and save for 30 days. Although the original data will be automatically deleted after 30 days, the display thumbnails will remain.
-Automatic image sorting
If you create the sorting rules in advance on image.canon, uploaded images from your Canon camera can be automatically sorted on image.canon.Sorted images can be transferred to 3rd-party services or a PC.
-Upload to image.canon from Camera Connect
You can upload images imported to your smartphone via the mobile app Camera Connect to the image.canon cloud. Camera Connect is used with integration with the image.canon app.
-Auto forward images and movies to other storage services
Connect image.canon to your Google Photos, Google Drive, Adobe Photoshop Lightroom, Frame.io or Flickr account and automatically transfer your compatible images and movies. 
-Share and play with images
Access your image.canon images from the app and any compatible web browser. The library of reduced resolution images is ideal for sharing with friends and family over messenger and social media apps or printing with Canon portable printers. 
[Notes]
*A thumbnail is a compressed image of up to 2,048 px for display in the app.
*If this service is not used for 1 year, all of the images will be deleted regardless of their expiration date.
[Compatible platforms]
iOS 17/18/26

bluejetty:00155199:ios.summary:
Pode Morar é o aplicativo que facilita a vida dos clientes do Grupo Direcional. Os moradores dos empreendimentos Direcional e Riva encontram, nessa ferramenta, tudo o que precisam na palma da mão. 
O aplicativo possui interface intuitiva
bluejetty:00155199:ios.description:
Pode Morar é o aplicativo que facilita a vida dos clientes do Grupo Direcional. Os moradores dos empreendimentos Direcional e Riva encontram, nessa ferramenta, tudo o que precisam na palma da mão. 
O aplicativo possui interface intuitiva e moderna, e conta com a funcionalidade de uma agenda exclusiva, ideal para que você possa agendar e organizar todos os seus compromissos. É mais praticidade para você falar com a Direcional e ficar por dentro de tudo sobre o seu imóvel. 
O que você encontra por aqui?
Na página principal, o cliente poderá acessar os seguintes menus: Meu Perfil, Meu Imóvel, Solicitações, Financeiro, Me Ajude.
Além de ter acesso rápido ao Extrato, Meus Boletos, Antecipar Parcelas, Novas Solicitações, e Documentos. O cliente pode selecionar o seu imóvel, ter acesso às fotos e ao andamento da obra e um calendário com seus agendamentos. Também conterá um banner de indique e ganhe, e as notificações financeiras e de solicitações referentes ao seu imóvel.
Na seção Meu Perfil, ao clicar em editar, o cliente poderá atualizar os seus dados cadastrais, alterar o seu e-mail, trocar sua senha e incluir sua foto.
No menu Meu Imóvel, é possível acessar os documentos, linha do tempo, notícias e vídeos referentes ao seu apartamento.
Já em Solicitações, o cliente poderá realizar a abertura de solicitações/agendamentos, cancelamentos e acompanhamento das solicitações/agendamentos.
No menu Financeiro, é possível gerar boletos, extratos e demonstrativo de imposto de renda referente ao seu imóvel. Além de poder acompanhar também as parcelas pagas e pendentes de pagamentos.
A seção Me Ajude é para sanar todas as dúvidas e oferecer informações adicionais para os nossos clientes.
Fique por dentro de tudo!

bluejetty:00129124:ios.name: Difland: find differences game
bluejetty:00129124:ios.summary:
Play the famous Find the Difference game with a completely new mechanic - differences disappear just after you find them! We’ve made something special - big levels with 75 differences. Will you be able to find them all? 
Take up the challe
bluejetty:00129124:ios.description:
Play the famous Find the Difference game with a completely new mechanic - differences disappear just after you find them! We’ve made something special - big levels with 75 differences. Will you be able to find them all? 
Take up the challenge and find all the differences between two colourful pictures. The game is completely free and has no timer. Just relax and enjoy the game to the full extent. 
Why to play the game: 
- Various number of differences: 15, 30, 50, 75. Choose the difficulty you feel like fits you most. Easy levels with 15 differences or the trickiest ones with 75? 
- NO time limits. Take your time just enjoying the game. 
- Many categories to choose from. Immerse yourself into the big universe of diverse pictures.
- ZOOM. Enlarge the picture to make it clearer. 
- HINTS. No worries if you have some difficulties. Hints are always here to help!
- Objects disappear as soon as you find the difference. 
- Unique content from our designers. 
- Regular seasonal events.
- New levels daily. No time to be bored!
- Your own gallery of levels. The levels you’ve completed or that are still in progress.
- Hide completed levels option. 
Dive into the world of bright differences with your friends and family! The game is good for your mental health: reduce stress and anxiety by focusing on details. Exercise your brain and improve short-term memory. 
Join our fascinating journey to the amazing world of differences! Welcome to our family!

bluejetty:00126730:ios.description:
This class schedule will replace your old paper timetable! 
Complete the application with all of your classes/tutorials/practical courses, and display your class schedule! 
For each subject, fill in your classes/tutorials/practical courses with the classroom number, the teacher's name, time, duration, frequency and display color. It's very simple and fiendishly practical, you’ll have your schedule with you no matter what! You can access a summary view of all classes/tutorials/practical courses and modify them easily. 
Homework for your next tutorial? No problem, the application can manage it all for you! Note the homework on the timetable with an end date and you can update the status of it once it’s finished. You can also easily display all of the homework to be done, sorted either by date or by status. 
The student timetable is fully customizable: 
• No work on Saturday or Sunday? No need to display them in the schedule! 
•You never start before 10am? Same thing! 
•You have a 15-minute course? No problem! 
An application designed for all students!

bluejetty:00039097:ios.description:
【TANZAM(タンザム)の特徴】
▼イメージ記憶で楽しく学習
すべての単語にイラストと例文がついているので、ストーリーと一緒に覚えることができ、楽しく学習を続けられます。プロのイラストレーターによる楽しいイラストで、英語がもっと身近になります。
▼忘却曲線に基づいた復習設計
覚えた単語は忘れる前に自動で出題されるため、効率的に長期記憶に定着させることができます。
▼TOEIC・英検・TOEFL・IELTS・英会話等に対応した豊富な単語帳
中学生から社会人まで使える、レベル別の単語帳を多数ご用意しています。
▼毎日続けたくなる仕掛け
目標設定や学習カレンダー、応援メッセージ、習得数の可視化など、継続のモチベーションを支える工夫が充実しています。
【機能詳細】
▼イラスト×例文による記憶定着
単語ごとに用意された楽しいイラストと例文で、視覚と文脈の両方から単語が自然と頭に入ります。
▼忘却曲線に基づく復習＋自動習得管理
記憶が薄れるタイミングで復習できる仕組みに加え、一定回数以上学習した単語は自動で「習得済み」となり、今後の出題対象から除外されます。効率的な学習が可能です。
▼「おまかせ」「新単語のみ」など複数の学習モード
その日の気分や目的に応じて、最適なモードを選んで学習が可能。自分のペースで続けられます。
▼「お気に入り」単語帳のカスタマイズ機能
苦手な単語を「お気に入り」に登録することで、自分だけの単語帳を作成可能。ピンポイントで復習できます。
▼リスニング対応（視聴モード／音声再生）
すべての単語と例文に音声付き。視聴モードで聞き流しやシャドーイングの練習もできます。
▼暗記モード（赤シート機能）
単語帳一覧で日本語訳を隠し、英単語だけを表示。タップで答えを確認し、覚えていればその場で「習得済み」や「お気に入り」に登録可能。記憶チェックに最適です。
【対応単語帳一覧】
・TOEIC対策：4,300語
・英検対策（1級から5級）：7,200語
・TOEFL対策：4,300語
・IELTS対策：3,400語
・大学受験対策：2,500語
・NGSL（New General Service List）：2,700語
・NAWL（New Academic Word List）：800語
※英単語に加え、一部イディオムや熟語も含まれます。
※収録語数は今後も拡張予定です。
【こんな人におすすめ】
TANZAMは、小学生から社会人まで、さまざまなレベル・目的の英語学習者におすすめできる英単語アプリです。
実際に、東大・MIT合格者や、英検準1級合格の高校生、共通テストで目標達成した受験生など、多くの成功事例が生まれています。
▼英検対策をしたい小学生・中学生・高校生の保護者の方へ
・大学受験を控える高校生
・TOEIC対策を進めたい大学生・社会人
・TOEFL／IELTSで海外大学・大学院進学を目指す方
・英会話力を高めたい社会人・初中級者
・語彙力を伸ばしたいすべての英語学習者
【TANZAM Proの違い】
TANZAMは無料でもすべての単語帳を利用できますが、Proにアップグレードすることで、さらに快適かつ効率的な学習体験が可能になります。
▼無料プラン
・新規単語は1日10語まで
・復習単語は無制限で利用可能
・学習モードは「おまかせモード」のみ
・学習セットごとに広告が表示される
・視聴モード（自動再生）中にも広告あり
▼Proプラン
・新規単語の設定数が無制限に
・復習単語も引き続き無制限
・「新単語のみ」「お気に入りのみ」など複数の学習モードが選べる
・学習中に広告が一切表示されない
・視聴モードも快適に利用可能（広告なし）
【代表メッセージ】
英語が大の苦手だった私が、何度も単語学習に挫折しながら、海外MBAを目指す中でたどり着いた結論。
それは、「楽しく続けられる仕組み」こそが、人生を変えるということでした。
単語を一つずつ覚え、努力を積み重ねる中で、英語が少しずつ「できる」ようになる。
その小さな変化が、やがて大きな自信につながり、新しい世界への扉を開いてくれるのです。
TANZAMは、そんな実体験から生まれたアプリです。
だから、誰でもすぐに始められて、毎日コツコツ続けられるように、
すべてのコンテンツを無料で学べる設計にこだわりました。
英語の単語一つひとつが、留学、キャリア、新しい出会いのきっかけになる。
TANZAMは、単語を覚えるだけで終わらせず、
「英単語のその先」へと、一緒に歩んでいく存在でありたいと思っています。
まずは、1日10語の小さな一歩から始めてみませんか？
代表インタビューはこちら：https://tanzam.net/column/recruit/words-can-change-your-life/
【その他】
▼利用規約・プライバシーポリシー
利用規約：https://tanzam.net/tanzam%e5%88%a9%e7%94%a8%e8%a6%8f%e7%b4%84/
プライバシーポリシー：https://tanzam.net/privacy-policy/
▼ユーザーサポート
アプリ内のお問い合わせから、お気軽にお問い合わせください。
TOEIC and TOEFL are registered trademarks of Educational Testing Service (ETS) in the United States and other countries. This app is not approved or endorsed by ETS.・

単語ごとに用意された楽しいイラストと例文で、視覚と文脈の両方から単語が自然と頭に入ります。

▼忘却曲線に基づく復習＋自動習得管理
記憶が薄れるタイミングで復習できる仕組みに加え、一定回数以上学習した単語は自動で「習得済み」となり、今後の出題対象から除外されます。効率的な学習が可能です。

▼「おまかせ」「新単語のみ」など複数の学習モード
その日の気分や目的に応じて、最適なモードを選んで学習が可能。自分のペースで続けられます。

▼「お気に入り」単語帳のカスタマイズ機能
苦手な単語を「お気に入り」に登録することで、自分だけの単語帳を作成可能。ピンポイントで復習できます。

▼リスニング対応（視聴モード／音声再生）
すべての単語と例文に音声付き。視聴モードで聞き流しやシャドーイングの練習もできます。

▼暗記モード（赤シート機能）
単語帳一覧で日本語訳を隠し、英単語だけを表示。タップで答えを確認し、覚えていればその場で「習得済み」や「お気に入り」に登録可能。記憶チェックに最適です。

【対応単語帳一覧】
・TOEIC対策：4,300語
・英検対策（1級から5級）：7,200語
・TOEFL対策：4,300語
・IELTS対策：3,400語
・大学受験対策：2,500語
・NGSL（New General Service List）：2,700語
・NAWL（New Academic Word List）：800語

※英単語に加え、一部イディオムや熟語も含まれます。
※収録語数は今後も拡張予定です。

【こんな人におすすめ】
TANZAMは、小学生から社会人まで、さまざまなレベル・目的の英語学習者におすすめできる英単語アプリです。
実際に、東大・MIT合格者や、英検準1級合格の高校生、共通テストで目標達成した受験生など、多くの成功事例が生まれています。

▼英検対策をしたい小学生・中学生・高校生の保護者の方へ
・大学受験を控える高校生
・TOEIC対策を進めたい大学生・社会人
・TOEFL／IELTSで海外大学・大学院進学を目指す方
・英会話力を高めたい社会人・初中級者
・語彙力を伸ばしたいすべての英語学習者

【TANZAM Proの違い】
TANZAMは無料でもすべての単語帳を利用できますが、Proにアップグレードすることで、さらに快適かつ効率的な学習体験が可能になります。

▼無料プラン
・新規単語は1日10語まで
・復習単語は無制限で利用可能
・学習モードは「おまかせモード」のみ
・学習セットごとに広告が表示される
・視聴モード（自動再生）中にも広告あり

▼Proプラン
・新規単語の設定数が無制限に
・復習単語も引き続き無制限
・「新単語のみ」「お気に入りのみ」など複数の学習モードが選べる
・学習中に広告が一切表示されない
・視聴モードも快適に利用可能（広告なし）

【代表メッセージ】
英語が大の苦手だった私が、何度も単語学習に挫折しながら、海外MBAを目指す中でたどり着いた結論。
それは、「楽しく続けられる仕組み」こそが、人生を変えるということでした。

単語を一つずつ覚え、努力を積み重ねる中で、英語が少しずつ「できる」ようになる。
その小さな変化が、やがて大きな自信につながり、新しい世界への扉を開いてくれるのです。
TANZAMは、そんな実体験から生まれたアプリです。

だから、誰でもすぐに始められて、毎日コツコツ続けられるように、
すべてのコンテンツを無料で学べる設計にこだわりました。

英語の単語一つひとつが、留学、キャリア、新しい出会いのきっかけになる。
TANZAMは、単語を覚えるだけで終わらせず、
「英単語のその先」へと、一緒に歩んでいく存在でありたいと思っています。

まずは、1日10語の小さな一歩から始めてみませんか？

bluejetty:00036991:ios.description:
Embark on an exciting adventure in Find The Dogs, where your keen eye and quick reflexes will be put to the test! In this delightful hidden object game, you'll explore various vibrant and beautifully illustrated scenes, each filled with playful and adorable dogs waiting to be found.
• Explore Diverse Locations: Travel through different environments such as bustling city parks, serene countryside farms, cozy suburban neighborhoods, and even magical fantasy lands. Each location is meticulously designed with intricate details to immerse you in the search for hidden dogs.
• Find the Dogs: Your main objective is to locate all the hidden dogs in each scene. Some dogs might be cleverly camouflaged, peeking out from behind objects, or blending into the background. Use your observation skills to spot them all!
• Challenging Levels: As you progress, the levels become more challenging with more dogs to find and less time to do so. Can you find all the dogs before time runs out?
• Hints and Power-Ups: Stuck on a level? Use hints to reveal the location of a hidden dog or power-ups to extend your time. Collect coins and rewards to unlock these helpful tools.
• Collectible Dogs: Discover and collect a variety of dog breeds, each with unique characteristics and personalities. Complete your dog collection and learn fun facts about each breed.
• Engaging Storyline: Follow a heartwarming storyline that unfolds as you advance through the game. Meet interesting characters, solve puzzles, and uncover secrets that will keep you engaged and entertained.
• Daily Challenges and Events: Participate in daily challenges and special events to earn exclusive rewards and bonuses. Compete with friends and players worldwide on the leaderboards to see who can find the most dogs!
Features:
• Stunning graphics and charming animations
• Relaxing background music and sound effects
• Intuitive touch controls for easy gameplay
• Suitable for all ages, perfect for dog lovers
• Regular updates with new levels and content
Join the fun and start your adventure in Find The Dogs today! Can you find all the hidden dogs and become the ultimate dog detective?

bluejetty:00065496:ios.summary:

FOLLOW PEOPLE
Follow a fr
bluejetty:00065496:ios.description:
Roasters is a map of 30,000+ specialty cafés and roasters in over 100 countries. But the best part is the people. Follow the ones whose taste you trust, see where they go, and keep your own record as you go along.
FOLLOW PEOPLE
Follow a friend, a barista you like, someone who travels a lot. Their check-ins show up in your Community feed, and on Explore you'll see which cafés they loved. Much better than guessing from star ratings.
THE COMMUNITY FEED
See what people are drinking in your city and everywhere else. What they ordered, whether they liked it, a photo, a few words. If it's written in another language, tap Translate.
FIND A GOOD CUP NEARBY
Open the map wherever you are. Each café has photos, opening hours, which roasters they serve, and how many people checked in and loved the coffee. At the bottom you'll find similar places close by.
CHECK IN
Takes a few seconds. Was the coffee Loved, Fine or No? Add a photo or a note if you feel like it. Public or private, your call. You can also share a check-in to your Instagram story or send it to a friend.
YOUR COFFEE MAP
Every check-in ends up on a globe of all the shops, cities and countries you've been to. Some of us are a bit obsessed with ours. You can also set a goal for the year and track it from a home screen widget.
LISTS
Save cafés to your To visit list for the next trip. Make your own lists too.
ALSO
Roasters get their own pages, and can claim and edit them. Shops post coffee jobs and events. And if you shake your phone, there's a little game where you work a 60-second shift behind the bar. The app is in English, German, Spanish, French and Portuguese.
FREE OR PRO CLUB
Everything above is free, you just need an account (Apple, Google or email). PRO Club is for the extras: Open now, Nearest and Newest filters, Best near me, unlimited map searches and alerts when a new café opens in your cities.
Great coffee inside. Go and find your people.
Privacy Policy:

Terms of Service:
https://g2.getterms.io/view/IlGR1/tos/en-us

Get ready for the thrill of experiencing the controlling and flying a commercial airplane aircraft in Airplane Pilot Simulator 3D and in big airbus cockpit!

This airplane game delivers everything that a dedicated flight simulator plane pilot could wish for if you love airplane games, takeoff and landing planes on different airfields then you need to try this newest flight simulator plane 3D game for sure. If you’ve ever wanted to get into a non-combat flight simulator then Flight Simulator Airplane 3D is one you need to try out. After all the price is nothing and flying planes is so much fun of course.
FEATURES:
-Realistic airplane cockpit environment. All of the necessary controls to make the gaming experience more realistic 
-Accelerometers used to make easy to play tilt controls
-Interact with functional instruments used in real-life airplanes 
-Different type of airplanes for airplane driving in this plane game
- Turbulence
- Plane crashes and smokes effects.

bluejetty:00119565:ios.description:

To Do and Call Management

bluejetty:00065742:ios.description:
Vivino helps you discover, choose, and buy the right wine.
Join over 70 million wine lovers who use Vivino to scan labels, track their tastes with ratings, and buy wines directly in the app.
From casual sippers to seasoned collectors, Vivino makes it easy to explore the world of wine with millions of ratings and reviews across 16 million wines, 245,000 wineries, and over 500 shoppable merchants.
Scan, Search, and Find Your Next Favorite
• Snap a photo of any wine label to unlock ratings, reviews, tasting notes, and food pairings
• Scan full restaurant wine lists to quickly spot the best bottles for your taste
• Search by grape, region, style, or dish – from Cabernet to Caldo Verde
Buy the Right Wine
• Shop for wine directly in the app from Vivino’s vetted network of top-rated wine merchants
• Get personalized wine picks based on your taste and insights from 70 million wine lovers
• Get money off your first order just for giving us a try
Understand your Tastes
• Record which styles, grapes, and regions you love (or loathe!)
• Get personalized suggestions based on your wine ratings and preferences
• See a ‘Match for You’ score for whether you’ll like the wine or not
Your Personal Wine Journal
• Keep a record of every wine you’ve tried, with your own ratings, reviews, and notes
• Mark wines as favorites and track the memories tied to each bottles
Track Your Collection
• Add bottles to your cellar to keep track of what you own and when to drink them
• Sort by quantity, vintage, or drinking status to manage your collection over time
Join the World’s Largest Wine Community
 • Learn from 70 million wine lovers who share real reviews, photos, and insights
 • Follow friends and experts to discover new favorites
 • Share your own experiences through ratings, photos, and tasting notes
Stay in the Know
 • Get alerts for discounts, personalized picks, and order updates
 • Receive weekly highlights with new wines that match your profile
From scanning to sipping, Vivino is your one-stop shop for discovering, learning about, and enjoying the right wine for every occasion.
 • Privacy policy: https://www.vivino.com/privacy
 • Terms of use: https://www.vivino.com/terms
Please note that we’re unable to respond to questions or comments left in App Store reviews. For support or assistance, contact us at support@vivino.com.

bluejetty:00120679:ios.description:
Vietnamese Dictionary PEnglish is an English Vietnamese Dictionary and Vietnamese Translator designed for Vietnamese speakers, Vietnamese families, students, travelers, and anyone who wants to learn and communicate in Vietnamese and English.
Look up Vietnamese and English words, translate words and sentences, learn vocabulary, improve pronunciation, and practice everyday language—all in one convenient app.
## 1. English Vietnamese Dictionary
Quickly look up words with a comprehensive English Vietnamese and Vietnamese English Dictionary.
* More than 750,000 English and Vietnamese words.
* English to Vietnamese and Vietnamese to English definitions.
* Search for words, phrases, and sentences.
* Clear and detailed meanings.
* Real-life example sentences.
* Images that make new words easier to understand.
* Synonyms and antonyms.
* American English and British English pronunciation.
* Fast and easy word search.
Find the right English or Vietnamese word whenever you need it.
## 2. Vietnamese Translator
Translate English and Vietnamese words, phrases, and sentences quickly and easily.
* Translate English to Vietnamese.
* Translate Vietnamese to English.
* Understand Vietnamese words and expressions.
* Find the meaning of unfamiliar English vocabulary.
* Translate useful phrases for everyday communication.
* Helpful for school, work, travel, and daily life.
PEnglish makes it easier to understand English and Vietnamese wherever you are.
## 3. Learn Vietnamese Vocabulary
Build your Vietnamese vocabulary through practical topics, examples, and interactive learning.
* Learn useful Vietnamese words for everyday life.
* Explore vocabulary by different topics.
* Learn new words with images and examples.
* Save your favorite words for later review.
* Create your own vocabulary lists.
* Practice vocabulary with flashcards and games.
* Review words with Spaced Repetition.
Turn every dictionary search into an opportunity to learn Vietnamese.
## 4. Learn English Vocabulary
Improve your English vocabulary while using the dictionary and translator.
* More than 200 vocabulary topics.
* Everyday English vocabulary.
* TOEIC, IELTS, and TOEFL vocabulary.
* English vocabulary for school and work.
* Professional vocabulary for technology, law, accounting, banking, and marketing.
* Learn with flashcards, games, images, and real-world examples.
Learn new English words and understand how to use them in real conversations.
## 5. Improve English & Vietnamese Pronunciation
Listen and practice pronunciation to communicate more naturally.
* American English pronunciation.
* British English pronunciation.
* Native speaker audio.
* Listen to words and example sentences.
* Practice pronunciation while learning new vocabulary.
* Improve your confidence when speaking English and Vietnamese.
## 6. Learn Language Through Everyday Communication
Learn useful words and expressions for real-life situations.
Explore language topics related to:
* Family and relationships.
* Food and restaurants.
* Travel.
* Shopping.
* School.
* Work.
* Daily conversations.
* Everyday life.
## 7. Learn English & Vietnamese Offline
Access essential dictionary features wherever you go.
* Look up vocabulary without an Internet connection.
* Review saved words anytime.
* Learn new vocabulary on the go.
* Convenient for travel and everyday use.
## Why Choose PEnglish?
* Comprehensive English Vietnamese Dictionary.
* Vietnamese English Dictionary and Translator.
* More than 750,000 words.
* English to Vietnamese and Vietnamese to English translation.
* Learn Vietnamese vocabulary through practical topics.
* American and British English pronunciation.
* Flashcards and Spaced Repetition.
* Offline dictionary access.
* Real-world examples and useful vocabulary.
* One app for English and Vietnamese language learning.

Privacy Policy: https://ppclink.com/apps/privacy-policy/

• Control: Regular monitoring can help prevent potential treatment complications.
• Communication: Patients receive specific notifications and advice from their practitioner via the app, and can send messages, too.
• Motivation: Patients see their treatment progress with a before/after comparison, and stay motivated throughout their treatment with achievement statistics.

• Control: Remotely monitor the evolution of patients’ treatments, track potential issues and set clinical goals for complete monitoring of treatment progression.
• Time optimization: Prevent unexpected clinical situations by getting accurate notification according to your customized protocol
• Workflow optimization: Use only one workflow and apply to all patients for increased efficiency, while ensuring an outstanding patient experience.
• Patient compliance: Regular follow-ups lead to higher treatment adherence!

bluejetty:00149358:ios.name: Noona for USA
bluejetty:00149358:ios.summary: Noona is an application for patients undergoing oncology or hematology treatment used by your clinic to communicate with patients. Noona connects you with your care team, ensuring your treatment journey is as informed and supported as possi
bluejetty:00149358:ios.description:
Noona is an application for patients undergoing oncology or hematology treatment used by your clinic to communicate with patients. Noona connects you with your care team, ensuring your treatment journey is as informed and supported as possible.
Noona enables continuous management and follow up of your health by your care team. Using Noona helps your oncology or hematology care team make informed decisions and provide you with more personalized care.
Please note that Noona should not be used in place of emergency medical services.
With Noona you can:
• Report symptoms to your care team in real-time
• Send images to provide more information about symptoms 
• Complete questionnaires sent to you by your clinic
• Ask questions directly to your care team through the Noona app
• View your appointments, lab results, medical records, and clinical documents
• Access educational materials sent by your clinic about your disease and treatment 
• Keep a personal diary to track your wellbeing with pictures and notes 
Noona can be used from any smartphone, tablet or desktop connected to the internet.
How to get started using Noona?
Step 1: Ask your nurse or doctor if Noona is available for you. 
Step 2: After your clinic has enrolled you in Noona, you will receive an invitation via SMS text message and/or email with instructions on how to activate your Noona account.
Step 3: After you have activated your account, you will be able to download the Noona App on your mobile device and start using it. You also can access Noona via a web browser on your computer by going to the link in the email.
Important: Please do not download the Noona app until after your care team has sent you an invitation and you have activated your Noona account and set up your password.
Developed by Varian Medical Systems, Inc., Noona prioritizes your privacy. Your Personal Health Information (PHI) is securely stored on a cloud server, accessible only to you and your clinicians. No PHI is stored locally on devices.
VARIAN and NOONA are trademarks of Varian Medical Systems, Inc., pending or registered U.S. Pat. & Tm.

bluejetty:00091035:ios.summary: Prove yourself as a master bridge builder in Build Bridge! Test your construction skills as you build bridges over deep valleys, canals and rivers. The stress simulator will tell you if the bridge you build can withstand the weight of cars
bluejetty:00091035:ios.description:
Prove yourself as a master bridge builder in Build Bridge! Test your construction skills as you build bridges over deep valleys, canals and rivers. The stress simulator will tell you if the bridge you build can withstand the weight of cars and trucks, or if it will collapse.
As the chief designer, you can choose from a variety of materials for each bridge, such as wood, steel, cables or concrete piers, but you must also stay within budget to build the perfect bridge. With a variety of materials to choose from, you can build each bridge in many different ways - your budget is the only limit. Let your imagination and creativity run wild in this fun building simulation! And if you do get stuck, the all-new help system will give you valuable tips!
Game Features:
1. Build and drive:
Build Bridge gives you the chance to be the master of both building and driving. Use your engineering skills to create perfectly constructed bridges and ramps. These structures are crucial to successfully completing your objectives. But that's not all - you can also drive the vehicles yourself, navigating them through the challenging courses you've created.
2. Spectacular stunts and destruction:
Prepare to be amazed by the spectacular stunts you can perform in Build Bridge. From daredevil jumps to somersaults and wrecks, this game is a thrilling experience for adrenaline junkies. Leave a trail of destruction across the level as you strive to beat the high score and show off your skills.
3. Improved construction mode:
Building structures has never been easier with the improved Construction Mode in Bridge Constructor Stunts. You have access to a range of building materials with different properties. Additionally, numerous improvements have been made to simplify the construction process. Convert a beam into a road with a simple tap, and vice-versa. You can also reposition your structures without starting from scratch, saving you time and effort.
4. Sandbox Mode
In Sandbox Mode, you can create your own levels using the free sandbox level editor.
5. Level Shop
In Build a bridge : Craft & Construct & Drive , the level shop contains thousands of levels for you to unlock.
Conclusion:
Build Bridge offers an exciting combination of building, driving, and performing stunts. With improved construction mode, diverse levels, spectacular stunts, and the ability to share your best moments, this game is sure to keep you entertained. So, get ready to unleash your creativity, showcase your driving skills, and conquer the challenges that await you in Build Bridge!

bluejetty:00174656:ios.name: TuneLab Piano Tuner
bluejetty:00174656:ios.summary: This app is for professional piano technicians. This is a professional tool that produces a custom piano tuning for any piano. It is part of the TuneLab line of piano tuning programs for smartphones, tablet computers and laptops that piano
bluejetty:00174656:ios.description:
This app is for professional piano technicians. This is a professional tool that produces a custom piano tuning for any piano. It is part of the TuneLab line of piano tuning programs for smartphones, tablet computers and laptops that piano technicians have been using since 2001.
Notable features:
* Measures and uses inharmonicity of the piano to construct a custom tuning.
* Provides an over-pull mode for more accurate pitch-raises.
* Can store hundreds of tuning files for individual pianos.
* Tuning files can be stored locally and in the Cloud on Dropbox. 
* Provides many historical temperaments for period music.
* Switches notes automatically when you play the next note.
* Provides a strobe-like Phase Display for fine-tuning.
* Provides a versatile frequency spectrum display.
TuneLab lets you customize a tuning by sampling the inharmonicity for a few notes of the particular piano. You can choose the kind of tuning stretch you want by specifying different intervals for the bass, the treble, and the mid-range of the scale. These intervals can be octaves, 12ths, double octaves, etc. Good defaults are in place if you are not sure which settings you prefer.
After a custom tuning has been created from inharmonicity measurements you can store this tuning by name. The next time you need to tune that piano, or one very much like it, you simply load that same tuning file and start tuning. There is essentially no limit to the number of tuning files that you can store. TuneLab comes with some sample tuning files and an "Average" tuning file so you can start tuning right away without bothering to measure inharmonicity.
TuneLab covers the normal piano range from A0 to C8 (88 notes). The automatic note-switching feature makes it possible to enjoy hands-free operation. There is also easy one-touch manual note switching.
TuneLab has two different displays that are visible at the same time. One is the strobe-like Phase Display. This is a band where black squares move left or right depending on whether the note is sharp or flat. Tune the note to make the pattern stop moving. The other is the Spectrum Display. This is a graph of the frequency spectrum around the desired note that shows a peak in the audio frequency spectrum for every pitch present in the sound. The object in using this display is to tune the note until the peak in the graph is positioned at a central red line. The Spectrum Display makes it possible to do a rough pitch-raise without mutes since each string of a unison produces its own peak in the graph. Having both the Phase Display and the Spectrum Display visible at the same time gives you a more complete picture of the tuning than any single spinner-type or needle-type display. The Phase Display displays a selected partial at each note, but it can optionally display the tuning of up to four different partials at once in multi-partial mode.

Baby Bubble School provides the most wonderfully bubbleful educational experience for kids! 
Teaching names and recognition of LETTERS, NUMBERS, SHAPES, COLORS, TOYS, ANIMALS, FRUITS, VEGETABLES and more. 
================================ 
* 10 Educational Learning Categories (full version) 
* 220 Interactive First Words Flash Cards (full version)
* 3 Engaging Game Modes 
================================ 
Baby Bubble School is a colorful, wonderfully bubbleful educational experience for curious young minds. Teaching names and recognition of LETTERS, NUMBERS, SHAPES, COLORS, TOYS, ANIMALS, FRUITS, VEGETABLES and more, Bubble School makes learning awesome for all TODDLERS and PRESCHOOLERS. The application was developed by an award-winning education studio, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling Abby Basic Skills app in cooperation with educational experts to ensure the application is suitable for this very special age category. 
***** 10 Educational Learning Categories (full version) ***** 
* Uppercase Letters 
* Lowercase Letters 
* Numbers 
* Shapes 
* Colors 
* Toys 
* Farm Animals 
* Zoo Animals 
* Fruits 
* Vegetables 
Baby Bubble School offers the following THREE ENGAGING GAME MODES in which you can play all of the aforementioned learning categories: 
EXPLORE 
Let’s Pop: Children will love this free exploratory learning mode! Full of bubbles with objects whose name is pronounced once the child pops the bubble, Let’s Pop is a fun little game where children can explore on their own pace. 
LEARN 
Let’s Learn: In Let’s Learn, children systematically learn the names of objects by browsing through them in either alphabetical or random order. 
PLAY 
Let’s Play: In this mode, children test their skills by tapping on bubbles filled with objects whose name is called. 
APP FEATURES: 
* 10 Educational learning categories (full version)
* 220 Interactive first words flash cards (full version) 
* 3 Engaging game modes 
* Appealing, child-friendly interface with adorable animated animal characters 
* Possibility to choose uppercase / lowercase / or capitalized words 
* Hints option for Let’s Play mode to help parents tailor difficulty for their child 
* Option to turn on / off sounds and music 
* All pronunciation done by professional voice-over actors 
Bubbly bubbles are fun and the app’s interface is simple enough even for the youngest learners -- as simple as popping a bubble! With appealing design and broad educational content, this bubbleful app is sure to provide an experience your children will love.

bluejetty:00064295:ios.description:
Do you want to earn Bitcoin by playing games? Play Turbo 84 and you are entered into a free to enter prize draw to win a Bitcoin prize!
- HOW TO PLAY -
Drive as fast as you can through this insane lane changing game! Drive through as many obstacles as you can, picking up speed as you go. Players are judged on their Top Speed and Furthest distance driven.
As you drive, collect tokens you find on the road. Use them to buy more cars and upgrade your engine!
- HOW TO EARN BITCOIN -
This game contains a prize draw in which you can win bitcoin/satoshi via a raffle, paid over The Lightning Network. You must be 18 or over to enter the draw.
To enter the draw you collect THNDR Tickets. Each one counts as an entry to the daily draw in which you can win a bitcoin prize. If you win you can cash out instantly to one of these supported Bitcoin wallet apps with 'Lightning Network' support; ZEBEDEE, Wallet of Satoshi, Breez, Blue Wallet, Bitcoin Lightning Wallet and Zeus.
Note: THNDR Tickets are a virtual currency, not a cryptocurrency. They have no monetary value, cannot be purchased nor are they transferable.
The game contains no crypto currency, wallet or related technology. All prizes are paid from THNDR LTD to the winner, upon you tapping the 'claim all' button on the prize screen. THNDR LTD will send the small amounts of Bitcoin winnings (known as satoshi) via The Lightning Network.
Please note: Apple is not a sponsor nor is involved in any way with this prize draw. The promoter is solely responsible for organising the prize draw and providing the prize if won by an eligible entrant. The prizes won are not products of Apple nor are they related to Apple in any way.

bluejetty:00033318:ios.summary:
