Relax yo
bluejetty:00033318:ios.description:
Solitaire - The classic Card Games never gets old
Unwind with a timeless classic like never before! Solitaire: Classic Cards Games in your fingertips with modern features and addictive challenges to keep you coming back for more.
Relax your mind with Solitaire: Classic Card Games
- Many beautiful card decks and backgrounds stimulate your vision.
- Daily challenges: Test your skills with new puzzles and goals every day
Rules of Solitaire - Classic Cards Games：
1. Set up the game: Deal 28 cards face down in seven columns, with 1 card in the first column, 2 in the second, and so on, until there are 7 cards in the seventh column. 
2. Move cards
The goal of the game is to move all of the cards to four foundation piles, one for each suit. The foundation piles are built in ascending order, starting with an Ace and ending with a King, just like in a sequence game. You can move cards in the following ways:
- You can move a single card from one column to another column, as long as the card is one higher or one lower in rank than the card on top of the column you are moving it to.
- You can move a group of cards from one column to another column, as long as all of the cards in the group are in sequence and have the same suit.
- You can move a single card from a column to a foundation pile, as long as the card is the ace of the suit.
3. Win the game
You win the game when you have moved all of the cards to the foundation piles. If you run out of moves, you can click on the stock pile to deal more cards. If the stock pile runs out, you can click on the empty space to deal again.
Additionally, you can also play freecell mode in the game. FreeCell Solitaire adds strategic elements to the classic Solitaire card game. Plan each move as you use the four blank spaces as placeholders to solve the moving card puzzle! Arrange all 52 cards from a standard deck to win!
Solitaire is a challenging but rewarding game. With a little practice, you'll be winning games in no time!
Regular updates and new features: We're constantly working to make Solitaire even better, so stay tuned for exciting additions! Completely free to play, so let's enjoy all the core features of Solitaire without spending a dime.
Download Solitaire: Classic Cards Games and enjoy the free puzzle game anytime, anywhere and rediscover the magic of this timeless classic!

bluejetty:00182796:ios.name: Godfather of Mafia City
bluejetty:00182796:ios.summary: Enter the dangerous world of crime, power, and loyalty in the ultimate mobster game built for iPhone. Step into the shoes of a rising gangster, build your empire, and fight your way to the top in a gripping mix of action, strategy, and surv
bluejetty:00182796:ios.description:
Enter the dangerous world of crime, power, and loyalty in the ultimate mobster game built for iPhone. Step into the shoes of a rising gangster, build your empire, and fight your way to the top in a gripping mix of action, strategy, and survival. This is more than a battle game; it is a true test of skill, alliances, and ambition where every choice determines your future.
Rise as a Mafia Boss
Begin as a small-time hustler and climb through the ranks of the underworld. Form your mafia family, gather loyal allies, and expand your influence across the city. In this world, respect is earned through cunning and strength. From intense gangster battles to massive clan wars, your path to becoming a feared mafia boss is paved with victories.
Whether you dominate in a city takeover or defend your turf against rivals, every move matters. Strategy is key, and survival belongs to those who can outthink as well as outfight.
Battle Strategy That Defines the Game
This is not just another free game. It is a carefully designed battle strategy game that blends action and tactics. Command your gang in team battles, prove your skill in PvP battles, and crush your enemies in competitive battle arenas.
Key Features:
Turn-Based Strategy: Outsmart opponents with calculated moves.
Hero Strategy and Collection: Unlock and upgrade powerful heroes to lead your gang.
Gangster Card Battles: Use strategy to build the perfect deck and dominate the battlefield.
Clan Wars and Team Battles: Join forces or wage war against rival gangs.
City Takeover Missions: Expand block by block until the entire mafia city belongs to you.
With elements of strategy card games, fighting games, and classic wargames, it offers endless replay value for fans of both action and tactics.
Build, Collect, and Conquer
Every victory brings rewards. Earn resources, recruit unique heroes, and unlock VIP advantages. Daily challenges, seasonal events, and constant updates ensure there is always something new to fight for.
Strengthen your mafia clans with top heroes.
Claim rewards for battles, missions, and takeovers.
Unlock exclusive VIP bonuses and dominate rivals.
Prove your strength in global war strategy games.
Your progress does more than build an empire; it secures your place as a legend in the world of gangster wars.
A Living Game World
The underworld is never quiet. Rival gangs fight for power, alliances rise and fall, and only the strongest survive. Whether you are defending your town, conquering a kingdom, or plotting a total war, every decision changes the game.
Explore different modes including survival challenges, idle progression, defense missions, and epic clan battles. No matter your playstyle, from quick fun games to long-term strategy battles, there is always action waiting.
The Ultimate Mafia Experience
Inspired by classic underworld tales, this game captures the heart of mafia games. Whether you want the style of a Godfather game, the mystery of solving a mafia mystery, or the thrill of leading a gangster strategy, the choice is yours. Build your reputation in the mafia city, fight legendary battles, and write your story in the criminal empire.
Why Players Choose This Game
A true blend of battle games and deep strategy.
Packed with funny games, cool games, and nonstop action.
One of the most popular games in the strategy and mafia genre.
Perfect for fans of free games, online mafia battles, and fighting games.
Designed for iPhone players who want both quick fun and deep gameplay.
Take Your Place in the Grand Mafia
Your time has come. Lead your family, expand your empire, and fight your way to the top. From clan wars to gangster battles, from hero collection to war strategy, everything is here to test your power.
Do you have what it takes to survive the last war, conquer the streets, and earn the title of ultimate mafia boss? Download now and step into the world of crime, strategy, and conquest in the most intense mafia battle game on iPhone.

bluejetty:00176867:android.name: Nutty Puzzles: Screw and Solve
bluejetty:00176867:android.summary: In "Nutty Puzzles: Screw and Solve," you will take on the role of a brave explorer embarking on an adventure filled with mysteries and challenges. On a mysterious island, the explorer accidentally discovers many ancient treasure maps, which
bluejetty:00176867:android.description:
In "Nutty Puzzles: Screw and Solve," you will take on the role of a brave explorer embarking on an adventure filled with mysteries and challenges. On a mysterious island, the explorer accidentally discovers many ancient treasure maps, which seem to hold clues leading to the ultimate treasure. However, these maps are obscured by complex mechanisms and screws, and only by skillfully turning the screws can they be unlocked.
Game Features:
Unlock treasure maps, reveal treasure clues:
In each level, you need to rotate the screws to unlock the obscured treasure maps. As you progress through the levels, you will gradually piece together the clues to the treasure, slowly approaching the ultimate prize. The unlocked treasure maps not only reveal new puzzles but also bring you one step closer to the mysterious treasure.
Global competition, vying for the highest honor:
In the game, your score will depend on the number and speed of the levels you unlock. Those who pass more levels will earn higher scores, and your achievements will be ranked in real-time against players from all over the world. See if you can rank among the top on the global leaderboard and become a true puzzle master!
Time-limited levels, earn generous rewards:
During the adventure, you will also encounter thrilling time-limited levels. Passing these levels not only earns you a lot of points but also unlocks special treasure maps, providing you with key treasure clues. Each time-limited challenge is an important step towards victory!
The story takes place on a distant island where an explorer discovers ancient and mysterious treasure maps. However, although he found these maps, he could not decipher the secrets they held alone. In desperation, he issued a bounty to the world, inviting all brave adventurers to help him solve these puzzles. In return, he promised to share the treasure equally with the final winner. Although the ultimate reward remains unknown, this has not deterred people from all over the world from flocking to the island, hoping to get a share of the spoils in this adventure.
Join "Nutty Puzzles: Screw and Solve," become a puzzle master, embark on a mysterious journey to explore the treasure, and see if you can be the one to uncover the ultimate treasure's secret!

Through uplifting statements and quotes, you'll believe in yourself with these one-a-day affirmations for daily motivation.
Hold down the large gray button to reveal your daily affirmation and effectively use the app by repeating the statement out loud. Saying the affirmation in front of a mirror is even better. bluejetty:00123807:ios.description:
Crescent Solitaire Classic - relax with something original! Created for those who enjoy a challenge, its intuitive design and simple controls make it a joy to play.
Using two decks of 104 cards, this card game is an original, hard brain teaser similar in difficulty to Forty Thieves Solitaire or Spider Solitaire. It tests your skills and occasionally your patience, but that makes it even more rewarding! To win a round, clear the table of all the cards by placing them in sequence on the foundations. Move the cards between the columns of the crescent, or shuffle them when you are stuck. 
Multiple features are included to aide you along the way. There’s a handy hint system to give you a helpful nudge in the right direction. The unlimited undo will let you have a chance at fixing your mistakes. There’s also a concise tutorial for those new to the game.
We’ve included multiple score bonuses to help you collect those all-important points and our score builder mode rewards dedicated players.
Features:
* A hard game for players who want to enjoy something unique.
* Multiple ways to score working in tandem with our Score Build mode similar to our other card games - e.g. Magic Towers and Pyramid Solitaire Ancient Egypt.
* Beautiful animations with a hint of glamor on green velvet.
* Intuitive controls and smooth card play.
* A universal app designed for both mobile phones and tablet devices
We hope you’ll agree that this rarity of a card game is the best version of Crescent Solitaire on the app store.

Step Into a World Where Your Choices Shape the Story
With Beast AI, you don’t just read a story—you live it, shape it, and see it unfold in breathtaking art that’s as unique as your imagination. Whether you’re seeking an epic fantasy adventure, a heartwarming romance, or a thrilling drama, your choices will paint the next chapter of your personalized journey.
Be the Hero (or Star) of Every Tale
Dare to dream with an AI that not only follows your lead but also dances in tandem with your creativity. Choose from an extensive library of genres—romantic love stories, high-stakes fantasy quests, gripping mysteries, and more—and watch your decisions ripple through the narrative, creating a unique story where you're the undisputed hero, star, or even the misunderstood villain.
Visual Feasts Tailored to Your Story
Immerse yourself in stunning visuals that bring your story to life. Select from a myriad of art styles to match the tone of your tale—whether it’s whimsical Anime, dramatic Cinematic, charming Comic Book, or enchanting Digital Art. Each aesthetic enhances your experience, ensuring every moment feels alive and uniquely yours.
Discover Cultures, Chase Passions, Earn Triumphs
Embark on journeys that transcend boundaries, realms, and the space-time continuum. Whether you're exploring ancient civilizations or unraveling modern romances, your progress is celebrated with meaningful rewards—not just in experience points, but through achievements that honor your imagination and creative spirit.
Romance, Adventure, or Both? Your Story, Your Choice
From rekindling childhood sparks at a summer fair to navigating the tension of being stranded with a rival, Beast AI lets you dive into scenarios where emotions and choices collide. Seek love, pursue power, or conquer kingdoms—the possibilities are as endless as your creativity.
Pause and Resume – Your Story Never Ends
Life calls? Simply pause your escapade and return to your tale whenever you’re ready, without missing a beat. Your story waits for you, always ready to welcome you back into its embrace.

bluejetty:00022528:ios.description:
This adventure game will make you relax! Explore the Ocean, become Ocean King. Start as a small Angel fish , you should try to become bigger by eat smaller fishes as fast as possible. The ocean is big and full of surprises, try not to come across big fish that they could bite you immediately. Be patient while growing up and you can take down the bigger fish!
In Let Me Eat: Big fish eat small, you control a hungry marine predator intent on munching as many other fish as possible. During the course of the game's 40 levels, you will switch off between 5 marine animals. The last level is where they attempt to dethrone a large shark, the "Ocean King", using Orcinus the Orca.
Explore underwater worlds filled with delicious and exotic creatures!
Collect and evolve the fish to become new powerful Predator!!!
FEATURES:
• Many Ocean secrets, items, skills of player to try.
• Free to play
• Amazing graphics
• Very excited gameplay
• Easy and smooth controls included 2 type : JoyStick & Swipe.
HOW TO PLAY:
• In Let Me Eat : Feeding Frenzy, you must control a hungry marine predator intent on munching as many other fish as possible.
• During the course of the game's 40 levels, they will switch off between 5 marine animals
The last level is where they attempt to dethrone a large shark, the "Shark King", in the form of Orca predator.
• The player takes on the role of different aquatic species each trying to move up the food chain. As smaller fish are eaten, the player's own fish grows in size and becomes capable of eating somewhat larger fish.
•By the end of each level, the fish is sufficiently large enough that it can eat almost anything on-screen. Players must be vigilant for hazards which include depth charges, larger predators, naval mines, radiation-poisoned fish, and jellyfish.

bluejetty:00184599:ios.name: Turnado
bluejetty:00184599:ios.summary: Turnado is a revolutionary multi-effect tool, crafted especially for massive real-time audio manipulation. It combines unique and dynamic effects with the most intuitive and immediate control you can imagine. Just turn it on and crank it up
bluejetty:00184599:ios.description:
Turnado is a revolutionary multi-effect tool, crafted especially for massive real-time audio manipulation. It combines unique and dynamic effects with the most intuitive and immediate control you can imagine. Just turn it on and crank it up.
Take it to the stage and unleash Turnado’s true power. With instant access to eight effects and immediate control over key parameters, Turnado is guaranteed to cause devastation on the dance floor, shredding beats and crunking breaks to insane proportions. 
Features at a Glance:
• Audio Unit v3 Plugin & Standalone App
• 4 XY-Pads to control 2 Effects simultaneously (X,Y)
• Integrated Player (Music Library, Factory Loops)
• Integrated Recorder (options: Start/Stop/Sync/Length)
• Live Modus (Inputs & Outputs selectable)
• Auria Plug-In
• AudioCopy / AudioShare import
• AudioCopy / AudioShare / Soundcoud / Dropbox export
• Full Midi Support (Virtual, Network, Extern)
• Midi Clock Sync
The idea is simple: 
Turn a knob and the effect is on. 
Turn the knob further to adjust effect parameters and apply modulations. 
Turn the knob down and the effect is off. 
With its instantaneous, one-knob, multi-parameter modulation features, Turnado will lay waste to the audio landscape. Giving you the power to crunch, chop, twist, mash and elevate your music to new levels, Turnado will have you creating wicked new sounds that will blow any crowd away. 
Unlocking the power of your MIDI controller each effect requires only one knob to control it. Underneath this simplicity lies a matrix of effect parameters and modulation engines, all controlled by the main knob. This control matrix provides serious depth to the plugin and gives you the ability to create original and truly unique effect programs. 
If the power of one-knob action still doesn’t rock your boat, the awesome "Dictator" mode will sink your battleship. It allows you to animate all the main knobs and run that animation with just one fader. That’s one fader, controlling up to 8 different effects, with potentially hundreds of parameter changes! 
Turnado’s primary focus is on beat manipulation, so you will find lots of loopers, slicers and grain tools in the rack. Alongside these beat-mashing effects are an arsenal of distortions and filters as well as first-class delays and reverbs. With extensive modulation possibilities each effect can produce millions of unbelievable variations that can be morphed and twisted into something new every time you tweak those knobs. 
Turnado will inspire you again and again, delivering completely new variations of your original sounds and grooves every time, so what are you waiting for…turn it on.

Choose your class from Warrior, Cle
bluejetty:00079550:ios.description:
Azmar Quest is a text-based RPG adventure, with turn-based battles and old-school vibes. It's inspired by the fantasy settings of D&D, TTRPGs, and CRPGs, but in its own unique (and sometimes quirky) way.
Choose your class from Warrior, Cleric, Warlock, or Archer, and play the main story. Decide your path through dialogues with multiple choices, and fight countless enemies!
You can also fight in PvP and play Dungeons (online only)
• Is this game for you?
Do you know that feeling when you start with just one basic attack, like in the old games, and slowly unlock new skills that actually make you stronger? 
When finding an Armor just slightly better than the previous one, because it has +2 Stamina, feels like a real upgrade? 
Well, if you're after games that give you every skill from the start and shower you with legendary loot right away, then Azmar Quest probably isn't for you.
But if you're not afraid to take on early enemies with just 1-2 abilities and no armor, and see real progress as you level up, then this may be exactly what you're looking for!
• Main Features:
- Single Player Story (playable offline too)
- Turn Based Battles.
- PvP battles (1v1 and 2v2) and Co-op Dungeons (online)
• Gameplay:
- Choose 1 of the 4 character classes available: Warrior, Cleric, Warlock or Archer, each with their own strategy.
- Customize your character's build: 24 unique skills per class, 4 armor slots and 4 potion slots to create your build and enhance your character.
- Follow Azmar's story through a dangerous fantasy world in this text based RPG adventure, make choices that matter with multiple endings, fight 100+ unique enemies in turn based battles, and reach level 30!
The single player story should last at least 20 hours.
• Does the game have anything else to offer? Of course it does!
- Face new single player quests and challenges every day, fight in the 2v2 Arena with your companion, or fight in 3v3 party based battles in the Veiled Realm, and reach Mastery 100!
- Play online in Dungeons, 1v1 or 2v2 battles, or play rated battles, and reach rank 1000 in PvP!
• Developer Notes:
- Azmar Quest is designed to be accessible and playable for blind users too, through the use of VoiceOver.
- Azmar Quest is completely free to play, with no content locked behind paywalls or timers. It only has a few optional ads and optional in-app purchases.
- The game is currently available in English only. I can't promise anything yet, but I'd like to add more languages in the future.
- This is a one-person indie game project. I'm constantly developing and improving it. It just takes a lot of time, have patience.

bluejetty:00155521:ios.description:
Moorr is the only app you need to manage your financials.
It’s an all-in-one platform that helps with:
• Giving you a simple and easy snapshot of your Finances
• Goal Setting with Central Time-line Tracking (MyGoals) 
• Property Investment Management (MyPROPERTY)
• Property Research & Market Insights (MyRESEARCH)
• Money Management & Budgeting (MoneySMARTS) 
• Spend Tracking and Bill Reminders (MoneySMARTS) 
• Wealth Management (WealthSPEED, WealthCLOCK) 
• Historical Wealth Charting & Tracking (WealthTRACKER) 
• Transaction Tracking & Categorisation (Transactions)
• Cashflow Modelling (MoneySTRETCH – web version) 
• Peer Review Comparison (MoneyFIT – web version) 
• 120+ Educational Resources - Videos, calculators, reports and workshops (MyKNOWLEDGE) 
• Alerts and Notifications via Opti (Moorr’s Built-in Smart Assistant) 
With new features being released regularly!
If you're not convinced, here are a few reasons you should check out this app:
— Introducing: WealthSPEED® & WealthCLOCK® —
Learn what your current WealthSPEED result is, based on a full assessment of all your Income, Assets, Expenses and Liabilities. Think of it like your car’s speedometer that measures how fast you are traveling. Your WealthSPEED does the same, except it measures how fast your wealth is being built (as a guide).
WealthCLOCK provides a guided measure of your wealth in real-time! So in other words, how much wealth you've got in that exact second. Using the car analogy again, your WealthCLOCK is like your odometer which measures the distance you have traveled in your wealth creation journey and your current wealth-building momentum.
Both financial tools provide terrific insight into your ‘current state of financial well-being’ and best of all, they are simple to use, easy to understand and bring attention to the #1 question – Is your money working hard enough for you?
— Exclusive access to MoneySMARTS —
Gain access to a unique and proven money management system within the Moorr platform which has over 40k free users. 
It’s a budgeting tool that’s more advanced than standard spreadsheet tools and apps in today’s market. It is designed to: 
• Help you track and capture more of your surplus money,
• Keep you accountable, and 
• Ensure you don't "unconsciously" overspend - ever again!
With built-in reporting that lets you know if you’re ahead of schedule to achieve your financial goals, it only requires less than 10 minutes a month to manage. 
— Residential Property Insights —
Moorr has rich property data insights including historical capital growth, rental yield, valuation, equity, Loan to Value Ratios position, and heaps more.
New insights are continually being released as we strive to make Moorr the preferred platform for Property Investors and their personal finances.
— Easy Set Up & Secure —
Sign up securely in minutes, record your financial data, and automate your bills from anywhere. It’s money and wealth management on the go, from anywhere.
When it comes to security, our platform uses Two-Factor Authentication and optional biometric security measures for maximum protection.
— Curious About Us? —
We are made up of subject matter experts specialising in property, finance and money management. Leading the team is Ben Kingsley and Bryce Holdaway, best-selling authors, co-hosts of The Property Couch podcast and partners of the multi-award-winning Property and Wealth Advisory business Empower Wealth Advisory. 
Established in 2004, our mission is to help more aspiring Australian households make smarter money & investment decisions to help them achieve financial peace.

listings.name: Moorr: Money. Property Invest.
listings.description:
Moorr is the only app you need to manage your financials.

It’s an all-in-one platform that helps with:

• Giving you a simple and easy snapshot of your Finances
• Goal Setting with Central Time-line Tracking (MyGoals) 
• Property Investment Management  (MyPROPERTY)
• Property Research & Market Insights (MyRESEARCH)
• Money Management & Budgeting (MoneySMARTS) 
• Spend Tracking and Bill Reminders (MoneySMARTS) 
• Wealth Management (WealthSPEED, WealthCLOCK) 
• Historical Wealth Charting & Tracking (WealthTRACKER) 
• Transaction Tracking & Categorisation (Transactions)
• Cashflow Modelling (MoneySTRETCH – web version) 
• Peer Review Comparison (MoneyFIT – web version) 
• 120+ Educational Resources - Videos, calculators, reports and workshops (MyKNOWLEDGE) 
• Alerts and Notifications via Opti (Moorr’s Built-in Smart Assistant) 

With new features being released regularly!

If you're not convinced, here are a few reasons you should check out this app:

— Introducing: WealthSPEED® & WealthCLOCK® —
Learn what your current WealthSPEED result is, based on a full assessment of all your Income, Assets, Expenses and Liabilities. Think of it like your car’s speedometer that measures how fast you are traveling. Your WealthSPEED does the same, except it measures how fast your wealth is being built (as a guide).
 
WealthCLOCK provides a guided measure of your wealth in real-time! So in other words, how much wealth you've got in that exact second. Using the car analogy again, your WealthCLOCK is like your odometer which measures the distance you have traveled in your wealth creation journey and your current wealth-building momentum.

Both financial tools provide terrific insight into your ‘current state of financial well-being’ and best of all, they are simple to use, easy to understand and bring attention to the #1 question – Is your money working hard enough for you?


— Exclusive access to MoneySMARTS —
Gain access to a unique and proven money management system within the Moorr platform which has over 40k free users. 

It’s a budgeting tool that’s more advanced than standard spreadsheet tools and apps in today’s market. It is designed to: 
• Help you track and capture more of your surplus money,
• Keep you accountable, and 
• Ensure you don't "unconsciously" overspend - ever again!

With built-in reporting that lets you know if you’re ahead of schedule to achieve your financial goals, it only requires less than 10 minutes a month to manage. 


— Residential Property Insights —
Moorr has rich property data insights including historical capital growth, rental yield, valuation, equity, Loan to Value Ratios position, and heaps more.

New insights are continually being released as we strive to make Moorr the preferred platform for Property Investors and their personal finances.


— Easy Set Up & Secure —

Sign up securely in minutes, record your financial data, and automate your bills from anywhere. It’s money and wealth management on the go, from anywhere.
When it comes to security, our platform uses Two-Factor Authentication and optional biometric security measures for maximum protection.


— Curious About Us? —
We are made up of subject matter experts specialising in property, finance and money management. Leading the team is Ben Kingsley and Bryce Holdaway, best-selling authors, co-hosts of The Property Couch podcast and partners of the multi-award-winning Property and Wealth Advisory business Empower Wealth Advisory. 

Established in 2004, our mission is to help more aspiring Australian households make smarter money & investment decisions to help them achieve financial peace.  

Moorr is designed to be a simple and user-friendly app that anyone can use. Because money does not need to be so complicated.

Achieve More with Moorr®

Relax your body and mind with one of our guided meditations, dedicated to increase oxygen supply to the brain and to stimulate the parasympathetic nervous system, which elicits a relaxation effect.
WANT TO GET STRONGER?
«Power Body» collection is designed to strengthen your whole body, to build strong muscle groups, and to boost energy. Sequences are comprised of postures focusing on arms, legs, and spine workout, together with some stretching and twisting exercises.
READY FOR WEIGHT LOSS?
The series of «Weight Loss I» and «Weight Loss II» are designed to improve digestion, increase metabolism, tone targeted problem areas, and to provide a long-lasting weight loss effect.
MOTHER-TO-BE?
«Perinatal Yoga» collection is a safe choice to calm your nervous system, to relax your body, and to make you feel simply better.

– 5-90 minutes thoroughly guided yoga videos

– practice by the scheme

– Ultimate stress resistance
– Positive mind
– Inner peace & balance

A multiplayer Baseball game for everyone!
Enjoy thrilling matches against your opponent!

Single tap for multiplayer matchmaking and start the game!
Don't wait to finish all 9 innings. Play only 1 inning of fierce competition!

Choose your location, select your pitch, and throw!
Wait for the throw and tap to hit!
Wow! Playing a multiplayer Baseball game was never so easy!

Takes less than 1 minute to learn to play!
You just need to practice to get the perfect timing and master the mental game of Baseball!
You’ll never get bored. Baseball Clash remains challenging even after a full day of gameplay!
▶ Enter Higher Leagues!
Collect trophies and join higher leagues! 
Better players await at higher levels of play!
Maybe you'll enter the MLB or even the WBC someday!

Burrito shop owner? Insurance Salesman?
Remarkable skills presented by players of diverse backgrounds!
Collect unique players to create your very own dream team!
▶ Friendly & Fun Baseball for All!
Are you a Baseball fan? We are too! 
Experience a Baseball game enjoyable for everyone!
** Notice regarding real-time matchmaking **
League play matches players of the same league together in real-time.
However, if real-time players aren't available to match, players will be matched with a player-like computer instead.
Such computers play at a similar level to players of each league.
We are doing our best to make sure they are well balanced in regards to difficulty, making sure games are not too easy nor too difficult.
This game includes optional in-game purchases (includes random items).

bluejetty:00149554:ios.description:
Welcome to a new approach to managing your health care needs that’s more personal, straightforward and convenient. With Harvard Pilgrim MyConnect, you can connect with your care team who will guide you through your benefit coverage, coordinate your care, help you with claim inquiries, connect you with a lifestyle coach, give you access to a curated library of health care resources and so much more.
We take your privacy seriously. This app is fully HIPAA compliant.
Harvard Pilgrim MyConnect is powered by Wellframe and is designed for use with specific health plans. If you were not directed to this app by your plan, please download the Harvard Pilgrim Mobile app instead.
With its companion Harvard Pilgrim Mobile app, you’ll always have access to your health information, resources and support by your side.
Harvard Pilgrim MyConnect works with Apple Health for certain care programs, such as those that provide a step count task.
Seek a doctor’s advice before making any medical decisions. This app is designed for education and to provide support between provider visits. If you're enrolled in an eligible care program you may connect a glucometer to share readings with your care management team, but should continue to check with your doctor before making any changes to diet, exercise, or treatment plan.

bluejetty:00084862:ios.summary:
Do you want to design furniture for your home in 3D? Make something for your workshop? or create DIY furniture plans that you can share with family and friends?
Whether you are a beginner or an experienced DIYer, you can use MakeByMe softw
bluejetty:00084862:ios.description:
Do you want to design furniture for your home in 3D? Make something for your workshop? or create DIY furniture plans that you can share with family and friends?
Whether you are a beginner or an experienced DIYer, you can use MakeByMe software to quickly create your furniture design in 3D , view your furniture in the context of your home then easily bring your ideas to life with automatically generated DIY plans that helps make DIY stress free. 
Supported languages are currently English, French and Spanish. More to come soon!
**Design your next DIY furniture project**
Easy and intuitive to use, MakeByMe allows you to design any DIY project using real material, tools and joinery methods. Simple add from the library of standard DIY materials such as 2x4 or plywood, then drag, rotate and snap your material quickly into position. Some design features are;
- Add standard material like 2x4 lumber, plywood, metal tubing, glass
- Drag and drop material and snap into place
- Use common join methods such as pocket holes, hinges, drawer rails and dados
- Realistic animated behaviour such as doors and drawers
- Cut straight or miter cuts with the cut tool
- Add detailing using holes and common shape cut tool
- Add colour and style to your design
**Make with auto generated cut list plans**
With MakeByMe, DIY plans have never been simpler. Interactive 3D assembly steps, stock materials, cut list and cut list diagrams are automatically updated as you design to help you start making and building your furniture. Some plan features are;
- Visualise the DIY build sequence with 3d steps
- Buy only the material you need with optimised materials lists
- Visualise and plan your cuts with cut diagrams and cut lists
- Make sure you have the right tools with a tools list
**Share your furniture project and plans**
Once your design is finished, you can add your project to a HomeByMe room to visualise or render or share your DIY projects and plans and inspire the MakeByMe community to start designing and making their own projects. 
MakeByMe is also available as a web/desktop app allowing you to access your data in the way most convenient way to you, whether on your phone, tablet or laptop. Try it today! and let us know how you get on.

By Day 3, you'll notice cleaner teeth with less plaque.

bluejetty:00178188:ios.summary:

Nikoli, the Japanese puzzle house, named and popularis
bluejetty:00178188:ios.description:
OUR NEWEST PACK – CLASSIC VOLUME #2!
Classic sudoku is where it all began, and there is still lots of skill to be deployed to solve classic puzzles, and new techniques to be explored.
Nikoli, the Japanese puzzle house, named and popularised sudoku from 1984, and we have commissioned 20 puzzles from them for this Classic Sudoku 2 app. We have also created 20 ourselves, and sourced 20 more from Sam Cappleman-Lynes, the brilliant British sudoku expert. The result is a wonderful 60-puzzle pack which will delight and challenge you.
--------------------
Welcome to the brand new Sudoku app from the most popular Sudoku channel, Cracking The Cryptic.
Unlike other Sudoku apps, we feature handcrafted and curated puzzles from the world’s best Sudoku constructors. Each collection features puzzles made by various authors that are now familiar names to those who follow the channel. Authors like Phistomefel, Clover, Sam Cappleman-Lynes, Christoph Seeliger, Richard Stolk, jovi_al, Qodec, Prasanna Seshadri and of course, Simon and Mark!
Downloading Cracking the Cryptic will give you access to our first free collection – a variety pack by Prasanna Seshadri featuring 7 puzzles inspired from our previous Sudoku apps; Sandwich, Classic, Chess, Thermo, Miracle, Killer and Arrow Sudoku. We also have purchasable packs designed for all skill levels and featuring many unique variants not seen previously.
We’ll be releasing more free and paid packs in the future so keep an eye on the app for more Sudoku content from Cracking The Cryptic!

bluejetty:00187703:ios.description:

• TV and Radio Live Streams
• Video on demand (Television Programs)
• Audio on demand (Radio Programs)
• News
• Program schedule
FREE: RSV-Bible text with entire Gospel of Mark audio (99 minutes) featuring Blair Underwood as Mark - plus full text of the RSV-CE Bible and access to EWTN Live content. At anytime you can purchase the complete New Testament audio.
The EWTN Bible is powered by the Truth & Life Audio Bible a celebrity-voiced "radio drama" of the entire RSV-CE New Testament. More than 70 actors help bring the scriptures to life in this 22-hour audio production, complete with movie-quality sound effects and an original music score. This award-winning audio New Testament is endorsed with an Imprimatur from the Vatican and including a foreword by Pope Benedict XVI. Voiced by internationally-renowned actors including: Neal McDonough, Stacy Keach, Kristen Bell, Sean Astin, Michael York, Blair Underwood,Malcolm McDowell, Brian Cox, Julia Ormond, John Rhys-Davies and many more. 
70 actors - 20 audio engineers - 10 studios over 3 continents - more than 100 media development experts - and 10,000 production hours were needed to create this world-class audio New Testament.
In addition to this amazing audio, the iPhone/iPad app features:
• Complete text of RSV-CE synchronized with audio for the New Testament.
• Go directly to any verse and hear and see the Bible instantly.
• Use the built in playlist to hear the New Testament in 40 days or in Chronological order.
• Create your own playlist of verses.
• Remembers where you left off.
• Sleep timer 
• Airplay support 
• Support for headphone pause and play buttons 
• Easily fit entire 22 hours of audio on your iPhone/iPad.
“The Truth & Life Dramatized audio Bible is entirely faithful to the text of the Holy Scriptures. The manner in which the text is performed, beautifully assists the listener in understanding the meaning of the divinely inspired words within their context. The background music and sound effects helps the listener to imagine the setting of each particular text of the Holy Bible. I am happy to give my wholehearted endorsement to the audio New Testament.”
--Cardinal Raymond L. Burke,
Perfect of the Apostolic Signature of the Holy See
“This is the way Scripture is supposed to sound. Revealing and passionate performances from world class actors, a lyrical translation, and sound effects that put you in the middle of the action. Whether you’ve read the Bible a hundred times or are making the first contact, this is an experience you will not forget and one you will want to repeat often.”
--Laura Ingraham,
Radio Talk Show Host, New York Times Bestselling Author
“We learn by hearing as well as reading. Those who desire to become true disciples of Jesus will want to learn from His words in every way. For anyone interested in beginning or continuing their adventure of faith, I highly recommend this faithful and powerful presentation of the Word of God.”
--The Most Reverend Charles Chaput,
Archbishop of Philadelphia, PA

bluejetty:00098414:ios.description:
Welcome to Dream Tile - A Relaxing 3D Triple Match Puzzle Game!
This emotional 3D matching puzzle game turns every level into a meaningful rescue. Match three identical fruits to clear the scene, earn Stars of Hope, and help repair broken homes, fix drafty windows, light warm fires, and rebuild lives. It’s a heartfelt triple matching puzzle game that combines emotional stories with relaxing fruit-matching gameplay.
GAME FEATURE
Addictive 3D Fruit Matching
Enjoy relaxing 3D fruit-matching gameplay. Tap fruits in the scene to collect them into your basket, match three identical fruits, and clear the scene. Plan your moves carefully and manage your basket space to complete each puzzle.
Thousands of Story-Driven Levels
Solve 3D fruit-matching puzzles and triple match challenges to unlock emotional story moments. Every level brings progress, warmth, and meaningful changes. Explore colorful scenes, discover matching opportunities, and complete challenging fruit puzzles as you move through each story.
Offline & Relaxing
This 3D matching puzzle game works offline. Play anytime, anywhere—no Wi-Fi needed. Enjoy colorful fruit scenes, relaxing visuals, and easy-to-learn matching gameplay designed for peaceful moments.
Brain Training
Train your brain with strategic fruit matching, careful move planning, and logical puzzle challenges. Decide which fruits to collect, look for matching opportunities, and manage your basket space as you work toward clearing each scene. Easy to learn, with deeper strategy as the puzzles become more challenging.
Special Events
Join limited-time events, triple match challenges, bonus levels, and special activities with exclusive rewards. Explore different and interesting match puzzle experiences made for daily stress relief.
Why You’ll Love It - Relaxation, Challenge, and Purpose
1. Colorful 3D fruit scenes with interactive matching
2. Strategic basket management and triple fruit matching
3. Increasing difficulty with new matching challenges
4. Powerful boosters: Smart Hints, Magic Clears, Time Rewind
Easy to learn, relaxing to play, and perfect for fans of 3D matching puzzles and triple match games.
Solve triple matching puzzles to uncover hidden pasts, emotional twists, and inspiring comebacks. From abandoned girls to mysterious palace secrets, each story chapter starts with relaxing fruit-matching challenges that keep you emotionally invested.
Join limited-time events, races, and adventures—relax with beautiful matching themes and colorful 3D scenes. With multiple difficulty modes, Dream Tile is suitable for beginners, casual players, and triple match masters alike. Play this offline matching puzzle game anytime, anywhere.
Download Dream Tile: Triple Match Games now and change lives - one triple match at a time!

bluejetty:00187538:ios.description:
TOP JOB APP FOR LOCAL HOURLY JOBS & FLEXIBLE WORK!
Looking for the best job app to find local hourly jobs, flexible work, or part-time gigs? Juvo Jobs is the easy way to find jobs fast. Perfect for teens, students, and anyone searching for local full time or part time jobs. Forget the hassle of resumes—connect, get hired, and make money with Juvo Jobs today!
WHY JUVO JOBS?
Forget the old ways of job apps (like Indeed, Monster, or ZipRecruiter), Juvo Jobs focuses on hourly and flexible work. Juvo Jobs makes finding local, hourly jobs simple and stress-free. We designed Juvo Jobs for anyone needing flexible, easy to find work- whether you’re a teen, stay at home parent, or someone tired of long distance gigs and commuting.
FEATURES THAT MAKE THE JOB SEARCH EASY
NO RESUMES NEEDED
Get a job in 30 seconds! Skip traditional resumes and upload a short video to showcase your personality and work experience. Perfect for teens, first time job seekers, and anyone who wants to get hired fast. Whether you’re looking for temp jobs or full time positions, Juvo makes it easy!
FIND LOCAL JOBS NEAR YOU
Search local jobs hiring near me using our map or list feature. Juvo Jobs highlights businesses hiring in your area, making the job search easy and efficient. Whether you're looking for temp jobs, flex jobs, or career building roles, Juvo connects you fast.
GET PAID THE SAME DAY
Need cash quickly? Look for jobs marked “Same Day Pay” and get paid before payday! Juvo Jobs has partnered with earned wage providers to make accessing your pay simple and fast.
EASY, FLEXIBLE JOB APP
Filter by job type, including customer service, general labor, and food service. Show only jobs that fit your schedule and pay requirements. If you're looking for a work day shift, it's easy to find jobs that work for you!
CONNECT WITH ONE TAP & CHAT WITH EMPLOYERS
Juvo’s one tap “Connect Me” button gets you in front of local employers! Chat with hiring managers in app to get your next job quickly—perfect for those needing a fast, local job.
KEEP THE APP FOR EXTRA CASH
Already working full time or part time? Instead of side gigs, our job finder makes it simple to pick up extra shifts whenever you need flexible jobs for additional income.
ARE YOU HIRING? FIND GREAT EMPLOYEES FAST!
Employers can post jobs, receive instant connection requests, and chat with job seekers directly. Upload a company video to attract potential hires even faster. Whether you’re looking for part time help or full time employees, Juvo Jobs is here to make hiring easy.
TOP INDUSTRIES WITH JUVO JOBS
- Restaurant & Food Service
- Construction & Warehouse
- Healthcare & Caregiving
- Retail, Customer Service & Fitness
- Animal & Pet Care
Our users find it easy to connect with jobs hiring when and wherever they need them. Juvo Jobs is the job app where finding work is simple, local, and tailored to your needs.
WHAT OUR USERS SAY
"It’s an easy app to find jobs fast!" – G. Hill
"Highly recommend for a quick job search to earn extra cash." – T. Dickerson
"Needed a job quickly—Juvo had multiple jobs hiring in my area. Found two part time jobs faster than I could have on my own!" – L. Young
WHERE WE’RE FEATURED
Juvo Jobs is active across the USA, with featured job markets in Atlanta, Dallas, Austin, Los Angeles, Tampa, and Nashville. New jobs are added daily, so be sure to check back for the latest openings near you.
POPULAR JOB CATEGORIES
- Teen Jobs & Daily Paid Roles
- Caregiver Roles
- Cleaning & Maintenance
- Retail & Host Jobs
- Customer Service
Forget job boards that complicate your search. Juvo Jobs is here to make your job search fast, easy, and local, or, “near me”—try us today! Need more information? Contact us at support@juvo360.com or visit juvojobs.com.

bluejetty:00123236:ios.description:
The TD MySpend app helps you to stay on top of your spending. For the best TD MySpend experience, download the TD Canada app for iPhone.
By clicking "Get", you consent to the installation of the TD MySpend app provided by the TD Bank Group* and to any future updates/upgrades. You are also acknowledging that you understand that the TD MySpend app and any future updates/upgrades will/may perform the function described below. You may withdraw your consent at any time by deleting or uninstalling this app.
The TD MySpend app is free to download, however standard wireless carrier message and data rates may apply.
TD MySpend helps you keep track of your money so you can improve your spending habits. As a TD customer, download the TD MySpend app, and your TD personal bank account and TD Credit Card Account transactions are automatically available in TD MySpend to monitor your spending.
• Daily Digest – receive a summary of the previous day's transactions and choose when you want to be notified (between 7:00 and 11:00 a.m. each morning).
• Stay on top of your finances with real-time notifications every time there's an eligible debit or credit transaction on your account(s).
• Transactions are automatically categorized for you so you know exactly where your money goes.
• Use the Spending Insights Meter to get a glimpse of how you're spending compared to your historical activity.
• Review and compare your current spending with Money Path to see if there are spikes in your spending habits.
• Use TD MySpend to track your cash flow across accounts and see the whole picture.
• Create a wishlist of savings goals and get insights to help you make these goals happen.
IMPORTANT DISCLOSURES ABOUT THE TD MYSPEND APP
If you have an iPhone, TD MySpend works best with the TD Canada app. However, you do not need to download the TD Canada app to use TD MySpend.If you require assistance call 1-866-222-3456, mail TD CASL Office, Toronto Dominion Centre, PO Box 1, Toronto ON, M5K 1A2, or email at customer.support@td.com.
*The TD Bank Group means The Toronto-Dominion Bank and its affiliates, who provide deposit, investment, loan, securities, trust, insurance and other products or services.

bluejetty:00125955:ios.description:
Scan any document in seconds and seamlessly export, share, or email it as a PDF or JPG – all at no cost. This app is designed to be your go-to solution for document management, offering advanced features that are and always will be free.
Key Features:
• Multi-Page Scanning: Effortlessly scan multiple pages into a single document.
• Flexible Document Editing: Rearrange pages before exporting to ensure everything is in order.
• Various Export Options: Choose to export or share your document as a single PDF or multiple JPGs.
• Easy File Importing: Import image files from your gallery or iCloud Drive, and even open PDFs directly from iCloud.
• Smart OCR Technology: Extract text from any page using our state-of-the-art Optical Character Recognition (OCR).
• Precision Border Detection: Automatically recognize document edges with options for manual adjustments.
• Instant Printing: Print your documents directly from your phone in just a few taps.
All-in-One PDF Toolbox:
PDF Scanner also includes a built-in PDF toolbox, offering the following powerful tools:
• Merge PDFs: Combine two or more PDFs into a single file.
• Split PDFs: Divide a PDF into multiple files effortlessly.
• Extract Pages: Select and export specific pages from a PDF.
• Encrypt PDFs: Add a password to protect sensitive files.
• PDF to Long JPG: Convert an entire PDF into one continuous JPG image.
• Create Posters: Turn your PDF into a poster by selecting the number of columns.
PDF Scanner is built on trusted technology, including OCR support from SwiftyTesseract, available under the MIT license (see details: https://github.com/SwiftyTesseract/SwiftyTesseract).
Get scanning with PDF Scanner today – the only scanning app you’ll ever need!
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

From snacks to staples and gourmet goods—snack bars, seafood, dairy, and more—purchase a wide array of products affordably online and display them proudly on your aisles. Enlarge your marketplace, enhance i
bluejetty:00083562:ios.description:
Run your very own retail empire!
From snacks to staples and gourmet goods—snack bars, seafood, dairy, and more—purchase a wide array of products affordably online and display them proudly on your aisles. Enlarge your marketplace, enhance its appeal, and deliver unmatched customer service. Craft captivating promotions and price your products competitively to ensure swift sales. As your business grows, consider revamping the interior with fresh paint, stylish fixtures, and modern decor. All these tasks unfold in a dynamic, open-world supermarket simulation boasting stellar, lifelike 3D graphics. Dive in, enjoy the ride, and carve your path to retail dominance. Don't let bankruptcy be your endgame—strive for success instead.
Start small and scale up, transforming a humble corner store into a thriving Super Market. Excel as an outstanding manager:
Inventory Management: Keep your shelves brimming with goods. Source products, haggle over prices, and keep up with consumer trends to draw in shoppers.
Customize Your Space: Personalize your supermarket aesthetically—from themes and colors to decorations—creating an atmosphere that reflects your unique flair.
Broaden Your Offerings: Gradually introduce exciting new items, services, and features to cater to a diverse clientele.
Team Leadership: Hire, train, and inspire your workforce to ensure peak customer service and operational prowess.
Customer Relations: Stay attuned to shopper preferences and react to their input, maintaining high standards of service to secure a loyal customer base.
Unlock a variety of exciting products including exotic sushi, crunchy snack mixes, and more! Revel in the adventure and evolve your small shop into a grand marketplace!

Tut World: Candy School is a simulation management game full of dreams and sweetness, creating a colorful and vibrant campus world for players. Here, you will experience a complete campus life from kindergarten to university, experiencing different stages of growth and challenges.
Core gameplay
As a campus manager and participant, you need to build and manage various campus facilities, meet the needs of students and faculty, and enhance the reputation and influence of the campus. By planning the campus layout reasonably, we aim to create a unique and vibrant campus.
Game Scene
kindergarten
Colorful kindergartens are a playground for children's growth. The classroom is filled with various toys and learning tools. Accompanied by the teacher, the children play and learn to their heart's content, with innocent smiles on their faces. This is their first step towards the future, filled with endless joy and hope.
classroom
A quiet and bright classroom is a temple of knowledge. Write a wise chapter on the blackboard, the teacher diligently imparts knowledge on the podium, and the students listen attentively and actively interact. This is the place where dreams set sail, a paradise for seekers of knowledge, witnessing the growth and progress of countless students.
stadium
A fully equipped gymnasium is a stage for sports competition. Basketball dances on the court, sweat is shed in the air, and athletes interpret the spirit of sports through hard work. This is the collision of strength and passion, the cradle of health and vitality, allowing students to release stress and exercise their bodies through sports.
library
A peaceful library is a treasure trove of knowledge. The tall bookshelf is filled with various books, and readers immerse themselves in the world of books, absorbing the nutrients of wisdom. This is a habitat for the soul and a paradise for seekers of knowledge, providing students with a good learning atmosphere and rich knowledge resources.
Game features
Rich life experience: from campus to daily life, from learning to entertainment, simulating real life scenes in all aspects.
Free construction and management: Plan the campus layout according to your own ideas and create a unique campus.
Diverse social interactions: Communicate and interact with various characters to experience the fun and complexity of socializing.
Continuous growth and development: As the game progresses, unlock more scenes and features, and experience the continuous development and growth of the campus.
Come to Tut World: Candy School and embark on your campus simulation journey, creating your own exciting stories!

bluejetty:00169390:ios.summary:
Bible Color – Free Bible Coloring Book Games with Prayer & Art
Step into a world where faith meets creativity with Bible Color, an enriching Bible coloring app that combines scripture, prayer, and inspiring art. This free Bible coloring bo
bluejetty:00169390:ios.description:
Bible Color – Free Bible Coloring Book Games with Prayer & Art
Step into a world where faith meets creativity with Bible Color, an enriching Bible coloring app that combines scripture, prayer, and inspiring art. This free Bible coloring book lets you relax your mind, deepen your faith, and experience the Word of God in a fresh, interactive way. All line art is hand-drawn by a professional team of artists, ensuring every Bible illustration carries unique detail and soul. With the simple Color-by-Number system, each page transforms into a vibrant expression of faith and creativity.
“Let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us.” (Psalm 90:17, KJV)
High-Quality Bible Coloring Images
Discover a rich collection of Bible illustrations, crafted for Picsart-style digital coloring, pixel-level detail, and high-precision finishing. Each artwork is ideal for Color-by-Number coloring, letting you paint, color, and draw with joy. Whether you explore classic stories or modern interpretations, the professional-quality art and coloring games provide a fully immersive experience.
Diverse Bible Books & Stories
Color pages inspired by different Bible books—from Genesis creation to parables and Psalms. Bring landscapes of Eden, majestic prophets, or inspiring verses to life. Each Color-by-Number page is a coloring game that combines faith, creativity, and art. Difficulty tags, number guidance, and bookmarks help track progress and favorites.
Prayer & Mindful Reflection
Bible Color includes a prayer and notes feature. Pause to reflect, write down thoughts, or pray while coloring. All personal notes are stored locally to protect privacy.
“In every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.” (Philippians 4:6, KJV)
Creative Expression & Sharing
Unleash your creativity with Color-by-Number games. Choose vibrant or subtle colors, complete your Bible-inspired art, and save or share it. With every finished piece, you experience the joy of faith, art, and coloring. The app supports exporting your creations and tracking completed artworks in your Bible coloring book.
Download Bible Color today to enjoy Bible art, free coloring games, Picsart-quality illustrations, pixel-precise painting, Color-by-Number challenges, and faith-inspired coloring. Transform numbers into colors, lines into art, and moments into reflection.
Subscription pricing and terms：
In Bible Color we offer you the following two subscription options:
1. A weekly subscription costs $4.99 (or equivalent in your currency) per week.
2. A monthly subscription costs $9.99 (or equivalent in your currency) per month.
3. A yearly subscription costs $59.99 (or equivalent in your currency) per year.
After buying the subscriptions, you will remove the non-optional banner and interstitial adverts from the game. In addition, you'll get unlimited hints, and remove watermarks from all completed pictures.
Terms of Service and Privacy Policy please go to the following link:
Terms of Use:
https://home.xlearning.group/terms_of_services.html
Privacy Policy:
https://home.xlearning.group/privacy_policy.html
Immerse yourself in the world of "Bible Color" and redefine your coloring experience. Download now and embark on a journey where creativity knows no bounds!

bluejetty:00171776:ios.name: Driver: Dash Cam & Trip Log
bluejetty:00171776:ios.summary:
Turn your phone into a dual-camera dash cam. Auto-record trips, back them up to Driver Cloud, and share a link when you need proof.
4.6 stars from 19,000+ drivers on the App Store who skipped a bulky camera and used the phone they already
bluejetty:00171776:ios.description:
Turn your phone into a dual-camera dash cam. Auto-record trips, back them up to Driver Cloud, and share a link when you need proof.
4.6 stars from 19,000+ drivers on the App Store who skipped a bulky camera and used the phone they already carry.
WHAT YOU GET
• Dash cam recording on a mount, with dual camera (road + cabin) on iPhone XS and newer
• Pocket Drives when your phone stays in your pocket — trip log, speed, and events without video
• Clip Capture saves a 1-minute clip from your trip for easy access
• Uploaded trips come off the phone after they reach Driver Cloud, so they don't fill your storage
• AI coaching that flags hard braking, speeding, stop signs, and near-misses
• DriverScore and trends so you can see habits improve week after week
• Driver Cloud backup and a shareable trip link for insurance, work, or family
• Driver Rewards: limited by location and membership. After an approved application, eligible trips can earn Points you redeem for gift cards, deposit, or merch
• Apple CarPlay, so you can record while you navigate and listen to music
HOW IT WORKS
1. Mount your phone, or leave it in your pocket
2. Driver records the trip and adds location, speed, and events
3. Footage and logs upload to Driver Cloud — open any drive later, even from another phone
“This does the job effectively, with a device I already own.” — App Store review
DRIVER PREMIUM
• HD cloud lookback (up to 90 days)
• 24/7 roadside assistance in the U.S.
• Camera and video customization
TIPS
• Connect CarPlay to record alongside maps and music
• Use a landscape dash mount
• Plug in on longer drives
• Avoid direct sun on hot days
Driver is ad-free. Download free and keep every trip within reach.
We will charge your iTunes account when you purchase a Premium subscription plan. Your account will automatically be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current subscription period unless you disable auto-renew. You can turn off auto-renewal at any time by going to your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://www.drivertechnologies.com/how-we-protect-your-privacy
Terms and Conditions: https://www.drivertechnologies.com/terms-and-conditions
============
Note: GPS is required. Like other GPS-based apps, continued use of GPS running in the background can hurt your device’s battery life. Other factors, such as temperature, battery health, and other apps running in the background can also affect battery performance.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00016817:ios.description:
My Movies by Blu-ray.com is an app for the members of Blu-ray.com. Membership is 100% free meaning everyone can use this app. 
Some of the features:
* Download your movie and game collection and bring it with you. Filter your collection by a multitude of attributes and combine these to create custom filters. Use hashtags in the comment field when the available attributes are not enough.
* Scan bar codes and get detailed information about the movie and add it to your collection.
* Rate movies, just after you've seen it at the cinema.
* Rate games.
* Get the best deals.
* See current theatrical releases.
* A release calendar showing old, new and coming releases.
* A collectables calendar showing release dates of desirable editions, such as SteelBooks, DigiBooks, etc.
Movie collections supported:
* 4K Ultra HD, Blu-ray, DVD
* Digital movies such as: iTunes, Movies Anywhere, Ultra Violet, etc. 
* Theatrical movies
Game collections supported:
* PS5, PS4, PS3, PS Vita
* Xbox SX, Xbox One, Xbox 360
* Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, Wii U, Wii, Nintendo 3DS, Nintendo DS, 
* Steam, PC Games
Music collections supported:
* iTunes music albums

* Xbox SX, Xbox One, Xbox 360
* Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, Wii U, Wii, Nintendo 3DS, Nintendo DS, 
* Steam, PC Games

Music collections supported:
* iTunes music albums

bluejetty:00168196:ios.description:
VPN PRO – reliable protection for your iPhone and internet traffic.
Want to protect your personal information, speed up your internet connection, or get rid of annoying spam calls? VPN PRO is the app that will solve all of these issues in just a few clicks.
Spam Call Blocking 
Forget about unwanted calls. With an easy-to-use interface, you can quickly block any number. Simply add the number to the block list, write a note, and turn on the block. That's it – no more disturbing calls!
IP Address and Internet Speed Check 
Sometimes it's important to know what's going on with your internet connection. We provide an easy way to check your IP address, internet speed, and ping. With just one tap, you'll get all the information about your current connection, whether you're on a public Wi-Fi network or at home.
Fast and Secure VPN 
Our powerful VPN servers ensure complete protection of your personal information online. All your data is encrypted, making it impossible for anyone to intercept or track your activities. With VPN PRO, you can safely and quickly browse the internet, hiding your location and protecting your privacy.
Main Features: 
- Spam call blocking with the option to add notes. 
- Simple and intuitive interface for ease of use. 
- Accurate internet speed check and IP address information. 
- High-speed VPN servers with multiple locations worldwide. 
- Easy to use: setting up the VPN and blocking calls requires no complex actions.
Premium Features: 
- Secure call blocking. 
- Option to add notes to blocked numbers. 
- Convenient toggling of call blocking. 
- Complete information about your IP address and internet speed. 
- Fast and secure VPN servers.
Subscription Terms: 
- The app offers subscriptions. 
- Payment for the subscription will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of the purchase. 
- Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
- The renewal will be charged within 24 hours before the current period ends, and the renewal price will be indicated. 
- You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal after purchase in your App Store account settings. 
- Subscriptions can be canceled anytime in your Apple ID settings. All prices include applicable local sales tax. 
- If a free trial is offered, the subscription will automatically renew after the 3-day trial period unless canceled before the trial period ends. 
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited upon subscription purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://sagrantapp.com/policy.html

bluejetty:00148587:ios.name: Inbox Pro - Email for Gmail
bluejetty:00148587:ios.summary: Secure Mail is the ultimate email client for iOS, designed to provide you with the highest level of privacy and security when accessing your Gmail account. Say goodbye to worries about your sensitive email data falling into the wrong hands
bluejetty:00148587:ios.description:
Secure Mail is the ultimate email client for iOS, designed to provide you with the highest level of privacy and security when accessing your Gmail account. Say goodbye to worries about your sensitive email data falling into the wrong hands in case of a lost or stolen phone.
Key Features:
Data-Free Security: Unlike conventional email clients, Secure Mail doesn't store your emails or attachments on your device. All your data is accessed directly from Gmail's secure servers. This means that even if your phone is lost or stolen, your emails remain inaccessible to unauthorized users.
Fingerprint/Face ID Lock: 
We understand the importance of an extra layer of security. Secure Mail allows you to set up biometric authentication (Face ID or Fingerprint) to ensure that only you can access your email client.
Encrypted Communication: Secure Mail uses advanced encryption protocols to secure the communication between your device and Gmail's servers. This ensures that your email data is protected at all times.
Passcode Protection: In addition to biometric authentication, you can set a unique passcode to further enhance the security of your email client.
Gmail Integration: 
Secure Mail seamlessly integrates with your Gmail account, giving you access to all your emails, attachments, labels, and folders, just as you would expect from a Gmail client.
User-Friendly Interface: 
With an intuitive and user-friendly design, Secure Mail ensures that you can easily manage your emails, compose new messages, and stay organized with your Gmail account.

bluejetty:00029305:ios.description:
Obscura V is a camera app packed full of features to help you take incredible photos. Obscura pairs a stunning design with intuitive controls that make taking photos a delight.
—
Over its 10+ years on the App Store, Obscura has been featured numerous times around the world, including as Editors’ Choice and App of the Day.
—
Design
Obscura squeezes a bunch of powerful features into simple controls anyone can master. The interface balances aesthetics, ergonomics, and intuitiveness. You won’t want to use anything else. Controls can be reached with one thumb, and gestures and haptics combine to create a tactile experience that lets you stay focused on your subject.
—
Capture Modes & Formats
Obscura captures photos, videos, Live Photos, and portraits. Photos can be captured in RAW, ProRAW, HEIC, and JPEG (on supported devices, see http://obscura.camera/compatibility).
Capture images in multiple different aspect ratios, or apply filters live in camera for a wide variety of styles.
—
Camera Settings
Obscura gives you control over exposure, focus, white balance, ISO, shutter speed, and flash, with intuitive controls that make you feel in control of your device’s camera.
—
Live Filters
Obscura includes a bunch of great filters to give your photos instant style but you can also create your own and use them live in-camera. It’s very cool and very powerful.
—
View Options
Obscura lets you display a grid, a spirit level, a histogram, focus peaking, a focus loupe, and exposure clipping highlights to help you understand every detail of what you’re shooting.
—
Photo Library
Obscura has its own interface for browsing, rating, editing, and sharing images, but it’s fully integrated with your system photo library, so images captured with Obscura are available everywhere.
—
Obscura Ultra
Obscura is free to use, with an annual subscription for premium features. See http://obscura.camera/ultra for full details.
—
I hope you love using Obscura as much as I’ve loved designing and building it. If you do, please consider subscribing to Ultra, leaving a review, or just sharing with a friend.
All the best,
Ben
————
Privacy Policy: http://obscura.camera/privacy
Terms of use: http://obscura.camera/terms

bluejetty:00158138:ios.description:
→ Take control of your home energy use, in real time.
Sense turns your home's electrical activity into real-time insight, so you can use energy more efficiently, spend less, and stay ahead of your electric bill.
→ Save energy. Save money.
Most people only find out what they used once the bill arrives, when it’s too late to change anything. Sense shows you how much energy your home is using right now and how this month compares with the last, straight from your phone. You’ll see what’s driving your bill, get tips that fit your home, and start reacting less and planning more.
→ Find your home’s energy hogs. Minimize what you waste.
A lot of devices in your home draw power even when they're off: some by design, some because they've grown less efficient over time. Sense helps you find what's quietly running in the background, so you can decide what's worth unplugging, fixing, or replacing.
→ Get real-time notifications. Keep your home running the way it should.
Peace of mind starts with knowing. Worried about heavy rain? Get notified if your sump pump stops running. Forgot the oven was on? Sense will tell you. Customize your alerts so the people and things you care about stay looked after.
→ Check in from anywhere. Know what's happening at home.
Whether you're at the office, running errands, or spending time with family, the Sense app keeps you connected: what's on, what it's costing, and whether anything needs your attention.
→ Small changes. Real impact.
Understanding your home's energy use is one of the clearest ways to cut waste and lower your footprint. Sense gives you the visibility to make smarter choices, so saving energy and doing right by the planet can be the same thing.
→ Customer support
Website: https://help.sense.com

- Powerball (including Double Play)
- Mega Millions
- Millionaire for Life
- Lotto (including Lotto Plus)
- Cash 5
- Pick 3 (Midday and Evening)
Powerball, Mega Millions, Millionaire for Life, Lotto, Cash 5 and Pick 3 also include a full breakdown displaying the number of winners and amount paid out for each prize level. 
The following features are also included:
Ticket Checker
----------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customizable Notifications
----------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest lottery results and prize breakdowns become available. The App allows you to customise notifications for specific lottery games and you can also choose which days of the week you play. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!
Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.
Settings
----------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.
Support
----------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at contact@lottery.net.

bluejetty:00019421:ios.description:
Smarter moves. Bigger scores. Less effort.
Snap Cheats is the fastest and easiest way to find winning Wordfeud plays when you’re stuck. Just take a screenshot of your game and let Snap Cheats do the heavy lifting — no manual typing, no guesswork.
Snap Cheats helps you spot high-scoring words in seconds so you can play with confidence and stay competitive.
---How it works---
1. Snap a screenshot of your Wordfeud board
2. Automatic board detection reads your letters instantly
3. Discover top-scoring word plays in seconds
It’s that simple.
---Key Features---
-Screenshot Importing
Instantly reads your Wordfeud board from a screenshot — just snap and go.
-Quick & Effortless
Minimal setup, clean interface, and lightning-fast results.
-Accurate Wordfeud Dictionary
Uses a carefully tuned dictionary so you won’t see words rejected by Wordfeud.
-Word Definitions Built-In
Look up definitions without leaving the app.
-Supports Multiple Board Types
Works with both standard and random Wordfeud boards.
-Language Support
• English (USA)
• English (International)
• Dutch
• Danish
• Finnish
• French
• German
• Norwegian (Bokmål)
• Portuguese
• Swedish
Why players love Snap Cheats
-Saves time
-Finds bigger plays
-Easy enough for anyone to use
Whether you’re chasing triple-word scores or just need help when the board gets tough, Snap Cheats gives you the edge.
Snap Cheats is an unofficial helper app and is not affiliated with Wordfeud.
Terms of Use:
http://www.firecrackersw.com/terms-service

bluejetty:00160557:ios.description:
Turn any blurry, old, or low-quality photo into a stunning high-definition image with the power of AI. AI Photo Enhancer: Face Rater by RePixel offers a complete suite of AI-powered tools to enhance photos, restore damaged images, and analyze facial beauty with impressive accuracy. Whether you're working with selfies, portraits, or vintage family photos, this app provides everything you need to elevate your images.
Features:
AI Photo Enhancer and Image Unblur
Upgrade any image by removing blur, sharpening details, and increasing clarity. Perfect for photos taken in poor lighting or low resolution, this tool transforms your pictures into crisp, clear visuals in just one tap.
Face Rater and Beauty Score
Discover how your face is rated by advanced AI. Get a detailed beauty score based on facial symmetry and clarity, plus personalized tips for enhancement. Ideal for those curious about AI-based beauty analysis or looking to improve their selfies.
Photo Restoration for Old and Damaged Images
Restore faded, discolored, or damaged photos with professional-level AI tools. RePixel brings aged memories back to life by removing scratches, correcting colors, and rebuilding lost details.
HD Image Upscaler
Increase the resolution of any photo while preserving quality. Whether you're printing, sharing, or editing, this feature delivers high-definition results without pixelation.
AI Cartoonizer
Transform your photos into vibrant cartoon-style avatars. Choose from multiple cartoon filters to turn selfies into artistic portraits with a creative twist.
Face Retouching and Beautification
Smooth skin, remove blemishes, whiten teeth, and enhance facial features with smart beautification tools. Achieve polished, natural-looking portraits effortlessly.
Clarity and Sharpness Enhancer
Improve image sharpness and definition for a more professional finish. Ideal for both everyday photos and artistic photography, this feature enhances fine details and texture.
Scratch and Imperfection Removal
Clean up physical imperfections from scanned or old photos. Remove scratches, dust, and creases to restore the original quality of your treasured images.
AI Colorization
Convert black-and-white images into full color using intelligent color prediction. This feature helps bring history to life with realistic, vivid results.
Why Choose RePixel
One-tap enhancement powered by AI
Easy-to-u

bluejetty:00074029:ios.name: Depression Test⁺
bluejetty:00074029:ios.summary: Feeling down? Take a free, confidential depression test and get your result in minutes. This app uses the PHQ-9 (Patient Health Questionnaire-9), the same nine-question screening tool used by doctors and therapists worldwide, to help you me
bluejetty:00074029:ios.description:
Feeling down? Take a free, confidential depression test and get your result in minutes. This app uses the PHQ-9 (Patient Health Questionnaire-9), the same nine-question screening tool used by doctors and therapists worldwide, to help you measure the severity of your depression symptoms.
HOW IT WORKS
• Answer 9 simple questions about how you have felt over the past two weeks
• Get an instant score with a clear severity level
• Understand what your result means and find helpful resources
• Retake the test regularly to track how your symptoms change over time
GO DEEPER WITH A PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
Premium is an optional auto-renewing annual subscription with a 7-day free trial. The following features require this separate purchase:
• A library of 60+ mental health assessments, covering anxiety, ADHD, bipolar disorder, PTSD, OCD, autism, self-esteem, and many more
• Your full results history across all assessments in one place
ABOUT DEPRESSION
Clinical depression is a mood disorder in which feelings of sadness, loss, anger, or frustration interfere with everyday life for weeks or longer. Depression is common — and it generally responds well to treatment. If your results concern you, reaching out to a professional is a strong first step.
DISCLAIMER: This self-test is a screening tool, not a diagnosis. Please consult a physician or licensed mental health professional if you are concerned about your mood. This app is not a replacement for professional treatment or guidance.
Privacy Policy: https://inquiryhealth.com/testappprivacypolicy
Terms of Service: https://inquiryhealth.com/testapptermsofservice
