bluejetty:00015405:ios.name: Liberation Philology Latin
bluejetty:00015405:ios.summary:
Learning a language is a complex and multi-layered process, which no computer can automate, but the study of Latin also involves extensive memorisation, which is where Liberation Philology Latin can help.
Liberation Philology Latin drills
bluejetty:00015405:ios.description:
Learning a language is a complex and multi-layered process, which no computer can automate, but the study of Latin also involves extensive memorisation, which is where Liberation Philology Latin can help.
Liberation Philology Latin drills you on Latin vocabulary and grammar, through a continuous multiple-choice test that's instantly available wherever you have your phone and a free moment. Your answers are immediately confirmed or corrected, and reinforced through repetition.
• Vocabulary: 200 levels of basic vocabulary, each testing the translation of 10 words between Latin and English. Additional sections cover the vocabulary of Book I of the Aeneid in sequence (148 levels), intermediate vocabulary (300 levels), and Cicero's In Catilinam I and Pro Caelio (82 and 66 levels). Interspersed among these are cumulative levels reviewing what has been learned earlier (giving a total of 898 levels).
• Nouns: Tests your ability to parse and decline all classes of Latin nouns.
• Adjectives & Pronouns: Tests your ability to recognise and decline Latin adjectives, pronouns, and pronominal adjectives.
• Verbs: Tests your ability to parse and conjugate regular and irregular Latin verbs.
• Participles: Tests your ability to recognise and decline Latin participles.
A further Reference module allows you to review the vocabulary word-list and paradigms.

bluejetty:00126754:ios.summary:
Jupyter notebooks are a powerful tool used in education and research. You can write small snippets of Python code and observe the result on screen, combine with paragraphs of text, using Markdown.
Carnets provides a complete, stand-alone,
bluejetty:00126754:ios.description:
Jupyter notebooks are a powerful tool used in education and research. You can write small snippets of Python code and observe the result on screen, combine with paragraphs of text, using Markdown.
Carnets provides a complete, stand-alone, implementation of Jupyter notebooks. Everything runs on your device, using the embedded Python interpreter; you do not need an internet connection. Compared to the standard version (Carnets), this app adds several packages targeted for scientific computation and learning: scipy, sklearn, seaborn and coremltools. You can switch between standard notebooks and the more modern jupyterlab using the Settings app. 
Of course, all the packages included with the standard app are present too: numpy, simply, matplotlib... To see the full list of installed packages, type "%pip list" in a code window. You can add more packages using "%pip install packageName", but only if they are pure Python.
You can share your notebooks with other apps and also open notebooks or directories managed by other apps. 
Partial list of installed packages: astropy, babel, bokeh, cartopy, cryptography, cvxopt, Fiona, geopandas, geopy, gym, inequality, libpysal, lxml, mapclassify, matplotlib, networkx, nltk, numpy, openCV, pandas, parso, pillow, pyFFTW, pyproj, qutip, rasterio, regex, Rtree, scikit-learn, scipy, seaborn, segregation, shapely, soupsieve, spopt, statsmodels, sympy, wordcloud.

bluejetty:00069735:ios.description:
1Contact – Smart Contact Manager
Overview
1Contact is a comprehensive contact management application that helps you organize, clean, back up, and maintain your contacts efficiently. With powerful AI-driven features and intuitive tools, 1Contact transforms how you manage your address book.
Main Features
Contact Management
 • Add, edit, delete, and search contacts with ease
 • Smart organization and categorization
 • Quick access to frequently contacted people
 • Advanced search with multiple criteria
Contact Cleaning & Optimization
 • Remove contacts with missing or incomplete information
 • Delete outdated or unused contacts
 • Clean up duplicate phone numbers and email addresses
 • Optimize your contact list for better performance
Duplicate Detection & Merging
 • AI-powered detection by name, phone number, or email
 • Smart merging with conflict resolution
 • Batch merge multiple duplicates
 • Preview changes before applying
Backup & Restore
 • Secure local backups
 • Cloud backup integration (iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox)
 • Automatic scheduled backups
 • One-click restore functionality
 • Export contacts in multiple formats (vCard, CSV)
Sharing & Communication
 • Share multiple contacts via Email, SMS, or messaging apps
 • Bulk sharing with custom groups
 • QR code generation for easy sharing
 • Export contact lists for professional use
Additional Smart Features
 • Business card scanner with OCR technology
 • International phone number formatting
 • Contact analytics and insights
 • Custom contact groups and labels
 • Birthday and anniversary reminders
 • Import contacts from various sources
Privacy & Security
 • Local data processing for enhanced privacy
 • Encryption for sensitive information
 • No unnecessary permissions required
 • GDPR-compliant data handling
Performance & Usability
 • Fast and responsive interface
 • Offline functionality
 • Cross-device synchronization
 • Dark mode support
 • Accessibility features
Why Choose 1Contact?
1Contact combines powerful tools with an intuitive design, making it ideal for both personal and business use. Our AI-powered features help keep your contact list clean and organized while ensuring important data is always safe and accessible.
Perfect for:
 • Business professionals managing large contact lists
 • Individuals wanting to declutter their address book
 • Anyone needing secure backup and restore options
 • Users who frequently share contact information
If you enjoy using 1Contact, please share it with your friends and leave a review on the App Store. Your feedback helps us improve and supports our continued development.
Thank you for choosing 1Contact.

Your pets deserve nothing but the best. That’s why Pet Supplies Plus offers the best prices, selection and service—guaranteed. And now, you have the power to get everything pets need, including grooming appointments, with a few taps on your phone or tablet. 
With our app, you can shop our nearest neighborhood store whenever or wherever you want. Getting the best deals on the best food, treats, toys and pet care essentials has never been easier. Plus, you can get your order delivered right to your door or have it waiting for you at our store. Whether you have dogs, cats, fish, bird, reptiles or small pet animals, we’ll help you be the best pet parent you can be. 
SHOP YOUR WAY
Save time and money with our app. Because you’re ordering directly from your local store, you can get your online purchase with FREE same-day delivery or 1 hour curbside pickup. We even make reordering simpler with our My Online Purchases feature! And to ensure you never run out of your pet’s food and supplies, use the app to manage your Autoship repeat deliveries. So now, it’s even easier to adjust the delivery schedule of the products your pets use every day. 
ENJOY THE BENEFITS OF REWARDS
Our Rewards members always save more. With every purchase, you’ll earn points toward money-off Reward coupons you can use on future purchases. Use our app to sign up and start receiving a $5 Reward coupon for every 1,000 points earned, members-only pricing, customized content and birthday/gotcha day gifts for your pet! You can even track your points and Rewards with the app. 
EASILY BOOK GROOMING APPOINTMENTS
Whether it’s a full-service groom, bath & brush or quick services like nail trims and teeth cleanings, our salon offers everything pets need to look and feel their best. Use our app to book an appointment with one of our professional, safety-certified groomers today!
FILL YOUR PET’S PRESCRIPTIONS 
Access our online pharmacy through the app to save on flea & tick preventatives, allergy medications, veterinary diets, supplements and more. Vetsource, our pharmacy partner, gets your pet’s prescriptions approved by your veterinarian, fulfills the order and delivers it right to your home. Plus, you get free shipping on orders of $35 or more.

bluejetty:00122744:ios.description:
Conveniently access and manage your finances anytime with the FHB Mobile app. The app gives you access to your accounts to check balances, make deposits, transfer money, pay people you trust, pay bills, etc. Download the app on your smartphone or tablet to enroll in mobile banking and benefit from the latest features available.
FEATURES
• Accounts- View balances, transactions, and images of cleared checks
• eStatements*- Enroll and access statements digitally
• Transfers**- Move money between your FHB accounts or accounts at other banks**
• Secure Messages- Securely send and receive messages with FHB 
• Bill Pay***- Manage and pay all your bills in one place; set up AutoPay for convenience
• Mobile Deposit****- Snap a photo of your check and deposit it from practically anywhere
• Find Locations- Locate nearby branches and ATMs
• Face recognition or Fingerprint unlock- Quickly and securely log in with biometrics
Disclosures:
* Learn how to enable eStatements at www.fhb.com/estatements
** You must be 18+ to use External Transfers. See www.fhb.com/onlineterms
*** Bill Pay enrollment required; fees may apply. See www.fhb.com/onlineterms
**** Mobile check deposit requires a mobile device with internet access and rear-facing auto-focus camera

bluejetty:00073220:ios.description:
Jewels Castle is a fantastic match 3 puzzle game! Match colorful jewels to progress through levels and earn numerous rewards! Jewels Castle, which contains numerous challenging puzzles, is a game suitable for all ages.
This game has thousands of levels, and each level features unique obstacles. Challenge yourself to overcome these obstacles with various items and special gems to advance to the next level! Daily missions and special events are also prepared to provide a different kind of fun!
Jewels Castle creates an immersive world that you won't forget with stunning graphics and beautiful music. Explore the beautiful castle and sparkling stars, challenge and clear new puzzles, and unlock numerous rewards!
Download Jewels Castle now and explore the captivating castle!
Gameplay:
• Match three or more gems in a row to remove them.
• Combining four gems creates a powerful missile that removes all blocks in a horizontal or vertical row.
• Combining five gems in an L or T shape creates a super bomb that can explode gems in a wide range.
• Combining five gems in a row creates a mirror ball that removes all gems of the same color.
• Combining two special items creates an incredible magical effect as their effects interact with each other.
Notes:
• Jewels Castle can be played without an internet connection.
• Jewels Castle includes full-screen ads, videos, and house ads.
• Jewels Castle can be played on smartphones and tablets.
• Jewels Castle is free, but in-app items like coins can be purchased.
Support:
Do you have any problems or suggestions? We want to hear from you!
Please contact us at the following address: pivotgameshelp@gmail.com
Privacy Policy: http://www.pivotgames.net/conf/Privacy_Agreement-En.html
Terms of Service: http://www.pivotgames.net/conf/Terms_of_Service-En.html

bluejetty:00120442:ios.name: Papo Town Amusement Park
bluejetty:00120442:ios.summary:
Welcome to Papo Town, where kids could create their own stories!
Explore in the Papo Town amusement park! Merry-Go-round, ferris wheel, pirate ship, roller coaster and every project kids want to play are in here! Let’s start a happy journey
bluejetty:00120442:ios.description:
Welcome to Papo Town, where kids could create their own stories!
Explore in the Papo Town amusement park! Merry-Go-round, ferris wheel, pirate ship, roller coaster and every project kids want to play are in here! Let’s start a happy journey with Purple Pink and friends!
Exploration & Discovery 
Papo Town: Amusement Park simulates the real scenes from the ticket office to the amusement facilities, even an ice cream or a cotton candy stall! There are 5 indoor attractions to explore: circus, playroom, dinosaur themed restaurant, souvenir shop and a mystery haunted house. Interact with the 13 lovely Papo friends! Dray and place them into the scenes and start creating a world of your imagination!
Amusement Park 
Play merry-go-back with your friends, travel high in the Ferris wheel, take a thrilling rollercoaster ride, and experience the pirate boat! Treat yourself with a delicious ice cream while resting or make a sweet cotton candy for your friends!
Circus 
Welcome to the circus! You wouldn’t want to miss the clown performance and the magic show! There are more wonderful projects like jumping circles, riding monocycle and acrobatics! You can dress up as a clown and perform on the stage, too! 
Game Room 
Kids’ favorite place! The game room! There are so many fun and classic games like whack a mole, dancing machine and a trampoline! Challenge the highest score! Take funny photos with friends in front of the photo board will be hilarious, too!
Dinosaur Themed Restaurant 
Feel like grabbing a bit? Come to the Dino Restaurant! It serves different food and dishes! Use the vending machine to get something to drink! There is an open kitchen where you could cook. Hey it’s fun to feed the dinosaurs! 
Gift Shop 
Choose some souvenirs for your friends in the gift shop! There is a wide range of choices from costumes to toys! So get a cup of coffee and a chocolate cake and take your time!
Mysterious Haunted House
Get clues and hints from the game, gather diamonds to unlock the mysterious haunted house! 
Features
• Classic amusement projects!
• Play with 13 cute animals!
• Many costumes to choose from!
• Support multi-touch, you can play with friends! 
• Open Exploration!
• No rules, no limit!
• Discover hidden rewards!
• Hundreds of interactive props!
• Inspire imagination and creativity!
• No Wi-Fi needed. It can be played anywhere!
This version of Papo World Amusement Park is free to download. Get 2 free trials every day or get the full version through in-app purchase. Once complete the purchase, it will be permanently unlocked and bound with your account. 
If there are any questions during the purchase and playing, feel free to contact us via contact@papoworld.com
[About Papo World]
Papo World aims to create a relaxed, harmonious and enjoyable game play environment to stimulate children's curiosity and interest in learning. 
Focused on games and supplemented by fun animated episodes, our preschool digital educational products are tailored for children. 
Through experiential and immersive gameplay, kids could develop healthy living habits and arise curiosity and creativity. Discover and inspire talents of every child!

bluejetty:00174678:ios.description:
Mobile recording studio in your hands. Use your device as a real microphone to record and edit any sound you want!
◆ THIS SOUND STUDIO INCLUDES:
• Various microphones with original sound and specifications
• Up to 10 tracks recording: each sound on its own place
• Notes for lyrics with auto scroll
• Pop Filter for removing unwanted overtones
• Audio signal’s visualization: too loud - red alert
• Volume mixer
• Simple audio editor: fast editing without any other apps
• Real-time pitch changer
• 2x volume booster & amplifier
◆ FEATURES WHICH MAKE THIS APP THE ONE YOU NEED
• Possibility to add multiple files to one track
• Increased allowed length of audio files
• All editing tools: copy, paste, cut, reverse easily
• Undo and redo functions can be applied to a single track or entire project
• Select audio files and drag the edges to change size
• Easily move your audio and transfer it between tracks
• Duplication in headphones: you can clearly hear what you’re recording
• Active noise cancellation during recording
• Built-in mic’s recording choice: bottom, front or rear
• 3D surround effect
• Demo tracks: try all features
• Unlimited audio recording: only HQ
• iTunes / Files uploads: add any sound from your library
• Projects saving: come back to recording anytime
• Informative knowledge base for exploring the various functions of the app
◆ UNDOUBTEDLY COOL AUDIO EFFECTS
• 12 bands equalizer with presets
• Reverb + a bunch of «spaces» presets
• Delay
• Compressor
• Destroyer
• Pitch & Speed
• Choir effect
• Stereo Expander
◆ ULTIMATE BEAT LIBRARY
A large library of constantly updated beats and sounds with different selections and popular music genres. Here you will find various instrumentals for your improvisations and singing, as well as voice-overs, podcasts, meditations, etc.
◆ ACCESSIBILITY FEATURES
We're making our Microphone Live app more inclusive and comfortable for everyone, and now we have:
• VoiceOver Support
Confident and intuitive navigation with spoken interface feedback. 
• Voice Control Integration
Hands-free recording and app control using only voice.
◆ APPLE WATCH SUPPORT
• Remote recording & playback control
Start, stop, and control playback directly from your wrist—manage recordings on your iPhone remotely without ever touching it, keeping your hands completely free.
• Remote metronome control
Manage metronome settings directly from your wrist.
Audiobus support: Now you can stream live audio directly to other Audiobus-compatible apps!
Fast and easy way to record, edit and boost audio.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

* The length of the subscription is 1 month, this subscription is auto-renewing. You can stop the subscription at any moment;
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the and of the current period, and identity the cost of the renewal.

Whether you're into novels, manga, comics, or gr
bluejetty:00179479:ios.description:
The ultimate reading tracker for book lovers and comic collectors. Build your personal library, track your reading progress, and discover your next favourite read — all in one beautiful app.
Whether you're into novels, manga, comics, or graphic novels, Storylines helps you organise your collection and reach your reading goals across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.
YOUR COMPLETE READING COMPANION
• Build Your Library — Track books, comics, manga, and graphic novels. Create custom reading lists and organise your TBR (to-be-read) collection your way.
• Powerful Search — Instantly find any title with rich details, summaries, and cover artwork. Add to your bookshelf in seconds.
• Discover New Reads — Explore curated recommendations and stay updated on new releases in the Discover tab.
• Never Miss an Issue — Automatically track new comic releases from series you follow. Get notified when new issues drop.
• Share Your Journey — Create stunning shareable cards showcasing your current reads, progress, and reviews. Perfect for Instagram, Twitter, and BookTok.
• Reading Goals & Challenges — Set custom reading goals and challenge yourself to read more. Watch your progress grow throughout the year.
• Beautiful Statistics — Dive into your reading life with detailed stats. Track your reading pace, completed series, favorite genres, page counts, and more.
• Rate & Review — Share your thoughts with star ratings and reviews. See what other readers think before picking up your next book.
SYNC EVERYWHERE
Your library syncs seamlessly across all your Apple devices with iCloud. Start on iPhone, continue on iPad, check progress on your Mac, or update from your Apple Watch — your collection is always with you.
APPLE WATCH
Track your reading journey from your wrist. Update progress with a tap and see your current book at a glance.
---
Note: Storylines is a reading tracker, not an e-book reader.
STORYLINES+ SUBSCRIPTION
Unlock unlimited library size, advanced statistics, and premium features with Storylines+.
Your subscription automatically renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscription in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://storylines.software/terms
Privacy Policy: https://storylines.software/privacypolicy

bluejetty:00155924:ios.description:
EscapeGame Puppies' Daily Life
Can you escape from this house? The puppies are just living their daily lives, but for some reason, the protagonist can't leave the house anymore. Take on the role of the protagonist and escape, while being entertained by the adorable fluffy puppies.
Square Head Factory 2023 Summer New Escape Game
In-game language: Japanese/English
Features:
• This escape game is themed around living with dogs, making it perfect for dog lovers and those who want to be healed by fluffy puppies.
• Enjoy a beautiful graphic escape game in 3D CG.
• Recommended for those who love escape games and a cute atmosphere.
• There is one ending, but you might not want to escape after all?
• When you get stuck, there are hints and answers available, making it suitable for escape game beginners.
• In some areas, you can use the screenshot function, so be sure to use it as a memo to aid in your escape.
How to play:
• You can play the game for free until the end.
• The game is operated with taps only.
• Hints and answers are available, making it suitable for beginners.
• The game includes an auto-save feature.
• Select an item with one tap and tap on the place you want to use it to use the item.
• Double-tap an item to see its enlarged image.
• Some items can be combined when using them in the opened state of the enlarged item.
Regarding advertisements:
• The production of this app is supported by ad revenue. Thank you for your understanding.
Sound Materials: 
OtoLogic: https://otologic.jp/ 
Sound Effect Lab: https://soundeffect-lab.info/ 
Yufuruka: https://wingless-seraph.net/ 
DOVA-SYNDROME: https://dova-s.jp/

bluejetty:00100435:ios.description:
WalkCash - Walk to Earn, Get Rewards Easily!
Are you looking for a pedometer that motivates you to stay healthy while earning rewards? WalkCash is the perfect choice to keep you and your entire family active! WalkCash automatically and accurately tracks your every step, empowering your health goals. Best of all, every step you take converts into real Coin rewards!
WalkCash Core Advantages
- Free Counting & Earning: A 100% free pedometer app—earn Coins just by walking.
- Ultra-Low Battery Consumption: Powered by the latest optimization technology, ensuring minimal power usage while running in the background.
- Rich Reward Redemption: Accumulated Coins can be redeemed for generous rewards, including gift cards from top brands.
Key Features at a Glance
1. Smart Step Tracking
- Automatic & Free: Enjoy all step-tracking features for free without needing to manually start the app.
- Precise Statistics: Accurately calculates your daily, weekly, and monthly steps, calories burned, and walking distance.
- All-Scenario Coverage: Automatically records indoor and outdoor activities, whether you are running, walking the dog, or just moving around daily.
- Privacy Protection: Does not use GPS tracking, maximizing your phone's battery life.
2. Steps to Rewards
- Walk for Wealth: Earn Coin rewards for every step you take, with a daily cap of up to 10,000 steps!
- Motivation Mechanism: Offers rich rewards to effectively motivate you to keep walking and achieve your fitness goals.
- Easy Redemption: Quickly redeem for gift cards or cash rewards—making health an asset, not a cost.
3. Social Interaction & Daily Games
- Join the Fun: Participate in the in-app "Mini PowerBall" activity to challenge yourself and win extra rewards.
- Share & Connect: Share your fitness insights and health tips with other WalkCash users.
Important Notes
- Purpose: WalkCash aims to track and encourage a healthy work and lifestyle. This may help individuals with certain chronic diseases or conditions live better lives.
- Medical Disclaimer: WalkCash is not intended to diagnose acute or chronic diseases or other health conditions, nor is it used for their treatment or prevention. You should seek a doctor's advice before starting any new lifestyle or fitness program.
- Usage Rules: WalkCash is currently available globally. When using the app, please enable relevant permissions on your device to avoid being flagged as "high risk" by our risk control system, which could affect your ability to redeem rewards. Please avoid using VPNs, proxies, or emulators, otherwise, your account may be restricted.
- Device Compatibility: Use of devices that do not meet specifications and standards may result in restrictions.
- Affiliation: The gift card information within WalkCash is solely for redemption purposes and user obligation fulfillment; it does not imply any affiliation with the respective companies in any way.
Support Team: Support@focusonsharing
Official Website: [https://www.walkcash.fit](https://www.walkcash.fit)
Download WalkCash now and start your journey to health and wealth! This is the simplest and easiest way to hit your daily health goals through walking while transforming your exercise into practical rewards!

bluejetty:00131513:ios.summary:
The new CenterWell Pharmacy™ mobile app makes it easier to keep track of your prescriptions. The new app has the same easy-to-use features, plus upcoming features focused on you.
1. Simplified refill ordering

bluejetty:00131513:ios.description:
The new CenterWell Pharmacy™ mobile app makes it easier to keep track of your prescriptions. The new app has the same easy-to-use features, plus upcoming features focused on you.
1. Simplified refill ordering
2. Easy prescription transfers
3. Check your order's status at a glance
COMPLETE MEDICATION LIST
- Stay organized with a full list of all your prescriptions filled at CenterWell Pharmacy, including those you no longer need and medication for your dependents.
QUICK REFILLS
- Easily refill your prescriptions as soon as you sign in, straight from your home screen.
PRESCRIPTION DETAILS
- View important details about your prescriptions, such as available refill dates, doctor information, images of your meds, and related educational videos.
ORDER STATUS
- Know where your order is once it’s processed with color-coded order status messages.
SHIPMENT TRACKING
- Track shipments once they’re shipped to estimate when your medication will arrive.
SNAP-TO-FILL
- Submit a photo of your current prescription label to easily fill your prescription at CenterWell Pharmacy.
TRANSFERS
- Quickly transfer your current prescriptions to CenterWell Pharmacy by viewing your prescription drug claims information from Humana.
SPECIALTY MEDICATIONS
- Request a refill of an existing CenterWell Specialty Pharmacy™ prescription and order it at the same time as all your other medication.
AUTO-REFILLS
- Automatically receive your next set of refills so you’re sure to have your medication on time. NOTE: auto-refills are not available for Medicare customers.
PAYMENT OPTIONS
- Change or update your credit card information and make payments securely from the app.
PREFERENCES
- Set or update your preferences, such as how you want to be communicated (by phone, email or text) or if you’d like to receive an alert when your total charge is over your price limit.
SHOP PRODUCTS
- Shop over-the-counter (OTC) products with the Health and Wellness credit that may be part of your Humana member benefit. NOTE: available to Medicare customers only.
Download the CenterWell Pharmacy mobile app now to manage all your mail-delivery medications with ease!
Note: The CenterWell Pharmacy mobile app is available only to Humana members.
For issues with this app, please email cwpmobilefeedback@centerwell.com.

► MANUAL CONTROLS
Unlock DSLR-like precision for crystal-clear photos and video. Full manual, semi-auto, or smart Auto modes let you adjust exposure, ISO, white balance, and more, while auto ISO & shutter speed limits let you fine-tune motion blur and noise, just like the big cameras.
► PROFESSIONAL TOOLS
ProShot adjusts to your changing world. Fly through camera settings with its unique Dual Dial system. Record video instantly with the press of a button. Paint with light trails or stargaze via Bulb mode. Fine-tune your experience with remappable controls, histograms, focus peaking, compass, Night UI to preserve vision, and so much more.
► PRIVACY BUILT-IN
Zero data harvesting - your images and info stay secure, because that’s the way it should be.
There is so much more to ProShot. Below is a list of some of the many features waiting for you. ProShot is under constant development, so great new things are always on the horizon!
► PHOTO FEATURES
- Auto, Program, Manual, and two Custom modes, just like a DSLR
- Shutter priority, ISO priority, Automatic, and Full Manual control
- Adjust exposure, ISO, shutter speed, flash, focus, torch intensity, white balance and more
- Set max ISO and max shutter speed options
- ProRAW, RAW (DNG), HEIC, and JPEG formats
- Option for zero processing for pure images without AI filters
- Live Photo support
- Unlimited shutter speed (Bulb) with Live Photo support for gorgeous night videos
- Portrait mode
- Black and White mode
- 16:9, 3:2, 4:3, and 1:1 aspect ratios
- Light Painting with special modes for capturing water and light trails
- Timelapse (intervalometer and video), with full manual control
- Zero-lag bracket exposure up to ±3 EV
- Manual focus assist and focus peaking with customizable color
- Front-facing camera support with full manual control
- Zoom up to 15X using just one finger
- Grid, histogram, compass, noise reduction and many more options
- Customizable accent color and UI layout to fit your style
- Dedicated Night UI to preserve your night vision
- Camera roll seamlessly integrated into the viewfinder
- Lock Screen widgets
► VIDEO FEATURES
- All Photo mode controls are also available in Video mode
- 4K video with extreme bitrate options
- Adjustable frame rate from 24 FPS up to 240 FPS
- Support for H.264, H.265 and ProRES formats
- Timelapse video up to 4K
- Industry-standard options for 180 degree rule
- Support for external microphones
- Monitor audio level and video file size in real-time
- Change any camera parameter, even during video recording
- Capture full resolution still frames during video recording
- Support for simultaneous audio playback (like Spotify) while recording
- Video light with adjustable intensity
Leave the heavy DSLR at home, ProShot's got your back.

bluejetty:00039850:ios.description:
The first all-in-one super app—do everything in one fast, familiar place.
Feels like Facebook-style friends, Instagram-worthy posts, TikTok-like clips, Pinterest-style boards, WhatsApp-style messaging, Reddit-style communities, X-style micro-updates, LinkedIn-style professional profiles & jobs, Tinder-like matching, Coinbase-style wallet tools, and Craigslist-style classifieds—plus recipes and games—in one app.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Social & Video: Share posts, photos, links, and short videos in feeds you control. Create friendships or follow accounts—and switch between Friends and Following feeds to tailor what you see.
• Live Streaming: Go live to followers, groups, or communities with instant chat.
• Chat & Groups: 1:1 and group messaging, audio/video calls, communities, and mod tools.
• Professional Profiles & Jobs: Create a professional profile, make business connections, follow companies, apply to roles, or post openings.
• Business Pages: Launch pages, showcase products or services, and grow an audience—no extra tools required.
• Marketplace: Buy & Sell locally with listing chat and trusted profiles.
• Earn & Monetize: Sell items or services in Marketplace and receive tips on posts and live streams.
• Go Local: See nearby posts, listings, jobs, and events with a location-focused feed.
• Events: Create events, RSVP, and share with friends or groups.
• Q&A: Ask questions, crowdsource answers, and highlight the best responses.
• Recipes & Boards: Save, organize, and share recipes with visual, board-style collections.
• Games: Play thousands of casual games and collect your favorites.
• Bluesky Client (AT Protocol): Connect your Bluesky account to browse and post via Faxo—switch between Timeline/Clips/Boards views.
• Dating: Match, chat, and meet new people.
• Wallet & Payouts: Track balances, receive tips, and manage crypto earnings.
CHOOSE YOUR FEED STYLE
• Timeline for posts & photos (Facebook-like)
• Clips for full-screen discovery (TikTok-like)
• Boards for saving and organizing ideas (Pinterest-like)
Toggle Friends or Following on Faxo feeds anytime, and switch views on any feed—including your connected Bluesky feed.
SAFETY & CONTROL
• Block and report tools to keep your experience in your hands
• Content filters and moderation features for creators and group owners
• Privacy controls for profiles, posts, and groups
WHY FAXO
• All-in-one convenience: social, video, live, chat, marketplace, local, events, Q&A, professional profiles, jobs, business pages, recipes, games, groups, Bluesky client, earnings, and crypto—together at last.
• Familiar by design: feels like what you already know, without juggling multiple apps.
• Built to end app fatigue: one download, endless possibilities.
Download Faxo and do more with one app.
Share a moment, start a live stream, sell a guitar, post a recipe, join a community, play a game, go local, build your career, host an event, earn from your work, or grow a brand—all in one app.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00082753:ios.name: Interval Timer X Workout Timer
bluejetty:00082753:ios.summary: Crafted with precision and simplicity, this interval/workout timer is designed for individuals who want to take control of their daily routines and achieve optimal results. Whether you're looking to build a custom workout routine or streaml
bluejetty:00082753:ios.description:
Crafted with precision and simplicity, this interval/workout timer is designed for individuals who want to take control of their daily routines and achieve optimal results. Whether you're looking to build a custom workout routine or streamline your daily tasks, this interval timer is the perfect tool to help you reach your goals.
Interval Timer features:
• Customizable Routines: Setting up and saving your own routines has never been easier with our customizable function.
• Multiple Functions: For simpler routines, access standalone interval timer/counter functions that can track every aspect of your workout.
• Combination of routines: By combining existing routings, the combination feature has got you covered for all your interval tracking needs.
• Warning Sound Setting: Stay on track during your workout with a warning sound that can be customized for circuit training, boxing, sprints, and more.
• Intuitive Interface: The interface is simple and attractive with light and dark modes available to suit your preferences. Large display and colored progress bars enable you to track your workout from a distance.
• Landscape Mode: The landscape mode provides an optional main display and a full-screen progress bar, making it even easier to track your progress.
• Alarm Sounds: Choose from multiple alarm sounds including beep, boxing bell, singing bowl, and voice, to stay motivated throughout your workout.
• Background Usage: Our app works seamlessly even when running in the background or when background music is on.
• Summary after workout: Get a clear and simple summary of your sets and time when your workout is finished.
• Calendar and Notification Feature: Use the calendar and notification function to plan your workouts in advance.
• History: Help you track and improve your workouts.
• Multiple Languages: The app supports multiple voice languages to cater to our global user base.
Interval Timer Premium Features:
• Export and Import: Easily export and import your custom routines and calendar.
• Unlimited Routine Combinations: The premium version offers unlimited routine combinations, so you can create and save as many custom routines as you like.
• Advanced Timer Settings: With more custom timer settings, including preparation time, cycle interval time, warning sound time, sound type for each event, and the ability to add short notes, you can fully customize your workout to suit your individual needs.
• Customizable Notifications: The premium version also allows you to customize notification titles and content.
This Interval Timer app is the perfect tool for anyone looking to optimize their daily routine and achieve their goals, whether you're into physical exercise, workouts, yoga, or meditation. Here are just a few examples of how our app can benefit you:
- Physical Exercise: Keep track of your gym workouts, interval running, CrossFit training, and more with ease.
- HIIT and Tabata: The app is specifically designed to track high-intensity interval training and Tabata workouts, helping you stay on track and achieve your fitness goals.
- Yoga and Meditation: Use the app to time your yoga sessions or meditation practice and stay focused and motivated throughout your practice.
- Productivity: Stay focused during your study sessions, reading time, or cooking with our Pomodoro clock functionality.
- Personal Routines: Whether you're looking to optimize your daily routine or create a custom interval training plan, our app has got you covered.
Take your workouts to the next level and achieve your goals with the Interval Timer X Workout Timer app. Try it today and experience the benefits for yourself!

bluejetty:00155970:ios.name: Refill My Soul
bluejetty:00155970:ios.summary: Do you have eight minutes a day? This meditation app is designed to help strengthen your relationship with your Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ and bring increased peace, promptings, and a renewed perspective to the busy lives of members o
bluejetty:00155970:ios.description:
Do you have eight minutes a day? This meditation app is designed to help strengthen your relationship with your Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ and bring increased peace, promptings, and a renewed perspective to the busy lives of members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, or anyone who is seeking closeness with God.
This app was created to enable you to “be still… and refill” for a few minutes during your day. The hope is for you to feel refreshed and refocused in a short amount of time as you listen to meditation segments. These segments cover multiple gospel topics based on the teachings of prophets and scripture while incorporating pondering and relaxed breathing. There are over 130 meditation segments and more on the way! Many other meditation apps take you through topics or segments that may not meet your spiritual needs. The power of this app comes from listening to meditation moments on a doctrinal topic you select based on how you are feeling, what you need, or what you are experiencing at any given moment.
The meditation segments range from 7 to 12 minutes. Some of the meditation topics include: Adversity, Be Still, Faith, Pain, Peace, Prayer, Jesus Christ’s Atonement, Covenants, Daily Discipleship, Fear, Forgiving Others, Gratitude, Hope, Joy, Individual Worth, Loneliness, Obedience, Perfection, Personal Revelation, The Living Christ, and Waiting on the Lord. At the end of each segment, there will be a mantra you will repeat in your mind during a minute of silence. The world is filled with fear and negativity. The mantra can be repeated in your mind throughout the day to help you re-center and bring your thoughts back to a positive and faith-filled place. References, talks, quotes, and scriptures used are listed with each meditation.
President David O. McKay taught, “We pay too little attention to the value of meditation, a principle of devotion. In our worship, there are two elements: One is spiritual communion arising from our own meditation; the other, instruction from others, particularly from those who have authority to guide and instruct us. Of the two, the more profitable introspectively is meditation. Meditation is the language of the soul. It is defined as ‘a form of private devotion, or spiritual exercise, consisting in deep, continued reflection on some religious theme.’ Meditation is a form of prayer…” (Teachings: David O. McKay - Chapter 4)
Refill My Soul combines “spiritual communion” on a religious theme with teachings from prophets and apostles — a powerful combination! Joshua 1:8 says, “…but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein; for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.”
You can access 7 meditation segments for free. If you feel this app would meet your needs, you can unlock all meditation segments by subscribing for $1.99 (USD) a month, or $19.99 (USD) a year. First-time subscribers now receive a free 14-day trial when signing up for a new subscription plan.
Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime from the App Store.
For more information, see our terms of service (https://refillmysoul.com/terms-of-service/) and privacy policy (https://refillmysoul.com/privacy-policy/).

 · Import a guest list from a spreadsheet.

bluejetty:00186299:ios.name: Poly Metronome
bluejetty:00186299:ios.summary: Poly Metronome is a precise, modern practice tool for musicians who want more than just a click. Set any time signature, shape odd meters with accent groupings, layer polyrhythms, then save your setups as presets and setlists — or build up
bluejetty:00186299:ios.description:
Poly Metronome is a precise, modern practice tool for musicians who want more than just a click. Set any time signature, shape odd meters with accent groupings, layer polyrhythms, then save your setups as presets and setlists — or build up speed with practice sessions that track your progress.
A clean interface scales from iPhone to iPad, with a live pulse ring that shows every voice and accent at a glance — and stays in sync with the sound on the speaker, headphones, AirPods or AirPlay.
FREE FEATURES
• Studio-grade timing engine, 1–800 BPM
• Any time signature: 1–32 beats per bar, counted in quarter or eighth notes — 5/4, 7/8, 9/8, 12/8 and more
• Accents and groupings such as 2+2+3 for odd meters
• Two-voice polyrhythms such as 3:2 or 4:7
• Count-in before playback
• Tap tempo and manual BPM entry
• Vibration and LED flash on the beat (iPhone)
• Foot pedal and Bluetooth keyboard control
• Siri and Shortcuts: start, stop and set the tempo hands-free
• Lock Screen, Dynamic Island and Control Center controls
• AirPlay and Bluetooth speakers, with a latency notice
• Searchable user guide with live examples
• Ad-free, with dark, light or system theme
PRO FEATURES — one-time purchase, Family Sharing supported
• Up to 5 polyrhythm voices, each with its own sound, color, accents and pattern
• 18 sound banks (10 metronome + 8 polyrhythm)
• 16 built-in rhythm patterns and a custom pattern editor with real notation — even a different subdivision on every beat
• Presets: create, edit and duplicate, with notes such as the key or capo shown on stage
• Setlists: songs in order, each with its own tempo, notes and auto-advance on the downbeat — the app reopens on the same song if it closes mid-gig
• Practice sessions: Coach mutes bars to test your inner time, Automator ramps the tempo by bars or seconds, and session goals keep you on track
• Practice log: day streak, minutes per day and your top-tempo progress
• Siri and Spotlight for your presets, practices and setlists
• iCloud sync across all your devices
Ideal for drummers, guitarists, pianists, singers, dancers and any musician serious about timing.

Find the perfect name with Baby Names by BabyCenter!
Choosing a name for your baby is one of the most important decisions you'll make as a parent – but no pressure, right? Whether you're starting to feel overwhelmed with the decision, or just want a fun way for you and your partner to share your top baby names, you can find the perfect name with help from the Baby Names app by BabyCenter.
Baby Names by BabyCenter is the only baby name generator that combines powerful data analysis with names gathered from millions of BabyCenter members. Our baby name app makes it easy and fun for you and your partner to find name ideas you both love. 
ENJOY A CUSTOMIZED BABY NAMING EXPERIENCE
As you rate names, our app learns what you like and gives you more names you'll love. What's your style? Do you prefer popular baby names or unique baby names? Are you all about name meanings? Our baby name creator will suggest baby names for you.
SWIPE TO RATE NAMES YOU LIKE (OR DON'T LIKE)
An easy swipe right or left lets you quickly rate each name, providing our baby name finder the data needed to offer you more baby names you’ll like. When you see a name that's one for your short list, swipe up to save it!
INVITE A PARTNER AND FIND BABY NAMES TOGETHER
Connect with your partner to share your baby name ideas. When you and your partner both love the same name, it's a match!
Baby Names by BabyCenter is a quick, easy, and fun way for you to discover that perfect name. And it’s free (from us, with love)!
Features
● Just swipe right, left, or up in an easy and intuitive interface
● Get customized suggestions based on your ratings and preferences
● Choose girl names, boy names, or both
● Add your baby's last name to get a better feel for the name
● Don't see a favorite name? Manually add it to your list
● Use your personal code to connect with a partner
● Make a baby name match with your partner when you both love a name

bluejetty:00014740:ios.description:
SMARTMD gives you access to a suite of secure, HIPAA compliant solutions for medical professionals. The SMARTMD App for iPhone and iPad integrates with the EHR and workstations you are currently using. It is the fastest, easiest way to document a patient visit, dictate a letter, or produce an IME report. 
Traveling to see patients in SNFs, ALFs, Hospice, or at home? Get signed consent forms, scan facesheets, capture charges, and record MIPS quality measures without ever opening your laptop. Best of all, our app continues working even when you’re offline.
The mobile App is free and lets you get started with absolutely no setup fees or minimum charges. Record your encounters any way you please and let our professional staff take care of the rest with opt in services, including: 
• EHR Schedule integration – see your patients and schedules right from the app. Know how many patients are on the slate for tomorrow and where at a glance.
• Medical transcription – professionally typed letters and reports you can be proud of, faxed directly to referring physicians and attorneys. Generated from your dictation, worksheet, or photo. 
• EHR scribing – your words entered directly into your EHR, so you don’t have to!
• Cloud File Share – safely gather documents while traveling to see patients. HIPAA compliant and accessible to your biller, admins, and peers. 
• Referral management – make sure ever referral turns into a patient. Analyze your network to see who to thank for sending you patients, and sources of leakage which keep patients from showing up for appointments.
Since 1999, SMARTMD has earned the trust of the respected doctors and medical professionals. The SMARTMD App is like having a trusted member of your staff with you throughout your busy day.
In 2017, SMARTMD was named second in the United States for “Trust, Accountability, and Transparency,” by Black Book Research for Medical Transcription, Technology, and Services.

bluejetty:00174370:ios.description:
Introducing our newly-renovated ‘Subway Korea’ app
‘Subway Korea’ app, a must-have free app for subway travel in Korea, has completely reborn with new features and newly-designed UI that supports iPhone 8, iPhone 8 plus, iphone X and iPad pro 3. Subway users will experience with upgraded usability, real-time transit information, vector-based map that can be zoomed at any zoom level, dashboard that provides useful information at a glance, and bookmark for frequently-used routes/stations/exits.

Provides the latest subway map of Seoul, Busan, Daegu, Daejeon, and Gwangju

Vector-based maps that provide a clear image quality at any zoom level

Route finder that allows you to find the easiest and quickest transfer route.
Area guide helps to find nearby stations from your location.
Set an alarm on your route and ready to go with no worries!
Bookmark allows you to get frequently-used routes, stations and exits information quick and easy.
Dashboard provides useful travel information at a glance.

Analyze

Are you using another app to track your sleep? Read from the Health app to automatically set the date of your sleeps.

Currenzy is a beautiful currency converter app for daily currency conversion needs. Its unique feature automatically converts currencies on a web page through its safari extension.

When you are on apps like mail or notes, select the text and share it with the Currenzy app extension to see the conversion. You can use your iPhone camera to convert prices on a price tag or a hotel menu while traveling abroad. 
Currenzy is also privacy-conscious, so none of your data leaves your device.
• Supports all major currencies. (Over 150+ World Currencies. Digital Currencies - BTC, ETH)
• Safari Extension Support - the ability to currency convert in your browser
• Action Extension Support helps convert currencies in all apps where text selection is possible.
• Home Screen widgets
• Apple Watch Support
• Bookmark List
• Historical Chart
• Built-In Calculator
• Personalized Actions - custom exchange rate, transaction fee,
• Support for custom exchange rate

• Supports Dynamic Type
• Functional and easy to use
• Clean Interface & Natural Gestures
• Universal App - iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch
• Custom App Icon support for a personalized touch
• Handoff support, start on one device and resume on another
• iCloud sync
• Dark and Light modes with multiple color accents
• Universal purchase for all your devices
• Family Sharing support
• Localized in French, German, Italian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Spanish
Currenzy is designed to make currency conversion as simple as possible. For any feedback and suggestions, please e-mail us at hello@waplestuff.com."

bluejetty:00026894:ios.name: Pillow: Sleep Tracker
bluejetty:00026894:ios.summary:
Sleep trouble? Sleep better with Pillow, your smart sleep tracker. Pillow can analyze your sleep cycles automatically using your Apple Watch, iPhone or iPad.
Use Pillow as a smart alarm clock to wake up at the lightest possible sleep stage
bluejetty:00026894:ios.description:
Sleep trouble? Sleep better with Pillow, your smart sleep tracker. Pillow can analyze your sleep cycles automatically using your Apple Watch, iPhone or iPad.
Use Pillow as a smart alarm clock to wake up at the lightest possible sleep stage and start your day refreshed and relaxed. Record important audio events such as snoring, sleep apnea, and sleep talking. Explore trends about your sleep and compare your sleep quality with many Apple Health metrics that affect sleep.
As seen on: 
The New York Times, Forbes, The Guardian, BuzzFeed, The Washington Post, TechCrunch, MacStories, Daily Mail, and many more. Rated as one of the best sleep tracking apps for the Apple Watch and iPhone. 
Join the millions that have discovered the life-changing benefits of great sleep!
TRACK YOUR SLEEP AUTOMATICALLY
- Simply wear your Apple Watch during sleep. Pillow will automatically detect and analyze your sleep.
- View last night's report right on your Apple Watch, along with the heart rate analysis for the night.
- Switch between manual and automatic mode anytime.
SLEEP CYCLE & HEART RATE ANALYSIS
- Advanced sleep cycle analysis algorithm based on the latest scientific findings in sleep research.
- Detailed heart rate analysis 
- Detailed sleep stage diagram (Awake, REM, Light Sleep, Deep Sleep) and sleep score.
- Home Screen, Lock Screen Widgets and Apple Watch Complications 
AUDIO RECORDINGS USING MACHINE LEARNING
- Snoring, sleep apnea, sleep talking and other nightly sounds.
- All processing is done using on-device intelligence to ensure privacy.
PERSONALISED INSIGHTS & SLEEP TIPS 
- Create a unique personal sleep program to reach your goals
- Regularly updated sleep tips
- Advanced Insights, including optimal bedtime, chronotype and more.
SLEEP TRENDS
- Explore your sleep history with Week, Month, Year, and All Time overviews.
- Compare your sleep quality with many Apple Health categories that affect sleep.
BACKUP & SYNCHRONIZE
- Synchronize and backup your sleep data and audio recordings between your devices.
ALARM PRESETS & NAPS
- Powernap, recovery, and full-cycle nap 
- Customisable alarm presets
MOOD & NOTES
- Track your mood when you wake up
- Discover how your notes affect your sleep quality
SLEEP AID 
- Access an expanding library of Meditations, Bedtime Stories, Soundscapes and Music.
- Use a track from Apple Music or iTunes as an alarm. 
- Siri Wind Down support
PREMIUM FEATURES:
- Unlimited sleep history & analysis
- Advanced sleep analysis
- Sleep trends & Apple Health comparison
- Sleep notes
- Heart rate analysis
- Sound recordings
- Nap modes & Customisable presets
- Access to Sleep aid library
- Access to all wake-up melodies
- Discover: Create a personalised sleep program.
- Wake-up melodies from your iTunes library or Apple Music
- Data export in CSV format 
- Smart Wake-up
Learn more at https://pillow.app
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account as soon as you confirm your purchase. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase. If you start a free trial, you will be charged automatically at the end of the trial period unless you cancel 24 hours before the expiration period.
Your subscription will renew automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The renewal cost will be charged to your account within 24 hours before the end of the current period. When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the existing subscription will not be refunded. If offered, any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.
Terms & Privacy Policy: https://pillow.app/pillow-privacy-policy-en

bluejetty:00095616:ios.description:
Step into the boots of an elite sniper agent in the most thrilling offline shooter experience! Sniper Agent: Offline Shooter is an action-packed 3D FPS game that delivers realistic single player missions where you hunt down high-value targets across diverse battlegrounds. This is the ultimate gun game for sharpshooters who crave intense combat without needing an internet connection!
As a professional sniper agent, you'll take on dangerous missions deep in enemy territory. Armed with powerful sniper rifles and tactical weapons, your objective is clear: eliminate targets with precision, complete critical operations, and prove yourself as the deadliest shooter in this war against crime. Every mission tests your shooting skills, strategic thinking, and nerves of steel! Embark on an extensive single player campaign with hundreds of challenging missions across multiple game modes. Hunt dangerous criminals in elite agent operations, save innocent lives in hostage rescue scenarios, assist police in taking down armed gangs and track wanted targets in manhunt contracts.
Collect and upgrade an impressive arsenal of authentic, powerful sniper rifles with realistic ballistics plus special ammunition and equipment. Each weapon features realistic 3D models, authentic sound effects, and satisfying shooting mechanics that make you feel like a true professional agent! Experience breathtaking 3D visuals with detailed environments, realistic weather effects, and smooth slow-motion kill shots. The game delivers console-quality graphics optimized for mobile devices with intuitive controls that are easy to learn but challenging to master.
This isn't just another shooting game - it's the definitive sniper agent experience! Whether you're a fan of tactical FPS games, realistic gun simulators, or action-packed shooter adventures, Sniper Agent delivers heart-pounding combat situations, strategic planning and execution, satisfying one-shot eliminations, and immersive scenarios. Enjoy fully offline gameplay with no internet required, multiple combat zones in cities, regular special events, and smooth performance on all devices. This free-to-play shooter game offers premium FPS action with optional in-game purchases.
The world needs an elite sniper agent who can complete impossible missions. Dangerous criminals, armed terrorists, and ruthless warlords are waiting to be taken down. Download Sniper Agent: Offline Shooter now and experience the most realistic and action-packed 3D FPS sniper game available! Lock and load your weapon, find your target, take the shot, and become the legendary hitman the world fears. Join millions of players worldwide who've chosen Sniper Agent as their go-to offline shooting game and master your sniper skills today!

bluejetty:00128434:ios.description:
Welcome to Hyper Airways! You're not just a pilot – you're the master of the skies! 
Full Throttle Takeoff 
Fire up those engines and take off into the blue skies! Keep the plane at the perfect speed to prevent a freefall and ensure a smooth ascent! And don't forget to have your landing gear at the ready for any unexpected surprises!
In-Flight Delights 
It's not just about flying; it's about providing exceptional service! Serve your passengers delicious food and beverages tailored to their preferences. Happy passengers make for a happy flight!
Aerial Acrobatics
Take to the skies and navigate your plane through challenging aerial circles! Show off your flying skills as you guide your aircraft with precision through these thrilling maneuvers!
Luggage Logistics
Place your passengers' hand luggage with finesse, and make sure to fit them snugly on the shelves. An organized cabin is a peaceful cabin, and it's all about creating a pleasant flying experience!
Control Air Traffic
As an air traffic controller, it's your duty to design the safest routes for planes to land without colliding! Avoid those mid-air crashes and keep the skies clear and safe!
Flight Deck Fuelling
Get on the flight deck and assist in refueling the planes! Every flight must be ready to soar to new heights!
Crystal-Clear View
Keep the plane clean! Pilots rely on your skills to ensure they have a clear view of the skies ahead. Safety and visibility go hand in hand!
Cable Organizer
Organize and sort the cables of the plane's engine with precision! A tangle-free engine is a reliable engine, and you're the expert in charge!
A Smooth Check-In
Assist passengers with check-in and help them find their seats. Your friendly guidance ensures everyone's journey begins stress-free!
Ready to command the skies in Hyper Airways? Take the pilot's seat, provide top-notch service, and become the aviation ace of the friendly skies!

bluejetty:00019538:ios.description:
Train at home or in the gym with one of the world’s largest women’s fitness communities! Get the fitness motivation you need with Sweat, a personal training app featuring co-founder and elite head trainer, Kayla Itsines. 
Sweat offers a broad suite of challenging, yet achievable programs with workouts you can do anywhere, anytime to progressively build your fitness. New programs give you more ways to push yourself and get you closer to reaching your goals. Stay accountable with virtual community challenges and feel supported by like-minded women everywhere.
Join Kayla and Sweat’s other world-class trainers: Kelsey Wells, Britany Williams, Cass Olholm — and more! — on your journey to discovering fitness confidence.
All new members get exclusive access to a free trial.
Find a training style you enjoy with easy-to-follow beginner, intermediate and advanced workouts, including:
- HIIT (High-intensity interval training)
- Circuit Training
- Bodyweight exercises
- Powerbuilding
- Strength training
- Yoga
- Barre
- Pilates
- Recovery
- Cardio
- Pregnancy and postnatal
Train your way — follow a program or work out on demand. Choose workouts that suit your lifestyle with no equipment, free weights or machines and express workouts when you are short on time. 
Sweat’s features make it simple to stay on track and keep on top of your progress. Features include:
- Exercise descriptions and video demonstrations
- Exercise substitutions to make movements harder or easier
- Trainer audio cues
- Log weights used during gym-based programs
- Planner to schedule your workouts and track your weekly progress
- Share “sweaty selfies” with your friends and the Sweat Community to keep motivated
- Comprehensive education section covering fitness, nutrition and wellbeing
- Over 200 fresh & fast meals for every lifestyle
- Daily step and hydration trackers
- 24/7 access to the Sweat Community
Enable Apple Health with your Apple Watch to keep track of all your activity in the Sweat app.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Sweat is free to download. Ongoing use requires an active subscription, available on a monthly or yearly basis. New customers who choose a monthly subscription are eligible for a free trial period. Yearly subscriptions are billed the total annual fee from purchase date. Monthly subscription users are billed per month.
Payment will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. There is no increase in price when renewing.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after purchase. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. Read our full Terms and conditions & Privacy Policy:
https://www.sweat.com/pages/terms-and-conditions
https://www.sweat.com/privacy

bluejetty:00070415:ios.summary:
***** #1 Puzzle Game in over 20 Countries! *****
***** "This quirky puzzle game bends the limits of space and reality to make you create structures that, in theory, should be impossible to replicate." - Pocket Gamer 8/10 *****
***** "As s
bluejetty:00070415:ios.description:
***** #1 Puzzle Game in over 20 Countries! *****
***** "This quirky puzzle game bends the limits of space and reality to make you create structures that, in theory, should be impossible to replicate." - Pocket Gamer 8/10 *****
***** "As soothing as it is challenging, this grown-up puzzler opened our minds. Time flew by as we recreated sculpture after sculpture in increasingly difficult configurations. The game’s 3D graphics invite focus and sharpen problem-solving skills, making it an entertaining brain-builder. M.C. Escher would be impressed by the twisty, physics-defying structures." - App Store Notes *****
kubic is a unique optical illusion puzzle game based on M.C. Escher's art, impossible objects and other geometric designs. The object is to construct the goal configuration from a number of pieces.
Presented in a simple, clean design and minimalistic art, kubic is a premium game with over 60 escher-esque puzzles.
When you click on a piece, it pops to the front-most layer, and may overlap other pieces. When you combine the pieces, they do not merge. If there are extra pieces, you may hide them behind the others. You can also lock layers and drag pieces without changing their layer order. You can also use two finger pinch to zoom in and out and drag the view for a better control.
If you are stuck on a puzzle you can simply skip it and re-visit at a later time. Rest assured, all puzzles can be solved but beware, some puzzles are hard! Just take your time...Tip: It helps to plan ahead and build figures from back to front.
If you truly get stuck, there is a in-game hint system. You can use it to get started or even get the whole puzzle solved.
Levels divided in 6 groups:
• Ocean - "2D" Shapes are basically two-dimensional arrangements.
• Desert - "3D" Shapes appear to be three-dimensional, but remember to think in two dimensions.
• Mountain - "Convex/Concave" These optical illusions are inspired by Escher's famous "Convex and Concave" lithograph.
• Sky - "Up/Down" These optical illusions are inspired by the Penrose Triangle featured in Escher's lithograph "Waterfall”.
• Escher - Based on letter designs that spell out MC ESCHER.
• Print - Based on the printable magazine version of Convex-Concave puzzles.
Kubic is localized and supports 12 languages including English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (simplified), Chinese (traditional), Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, and Turkish
Game supports iCloud for progress syncing between devices.
Convex Concave puzzles from the Heaven and Earth game are included with permission. The puzzles were designed by Scott Kim, Puzzlemaster (scottkim.com), and the Heaven & Earth team.
Enjoy!

bluejetty:00152808:ios.description:
Dive into a world of wild experiments! You're the new recruit in a secret lab where crazy ideas come to life every day. Build insane contraptions, launch wild experiments, and push the laws of physics to their limits.
In this physics-based sandbox, you can:
- Create your own setups for epic experiments
- Build structures from all kinds of materials
- Blow things up, smash them, and test out wild "what if?" ideas
- Join iconic team and recreate their viral experiments
This sandbox physics game is a crazy experiment simulator where you can enjoy ragdoll physics, destruction gameplay, and creative building. Perfect for fans of sandbox games, physics simulators, experiment games, and building games, it lets you test wild ideas, create custom experiments, trigger chain reactions, and explore a fully interactive physics world inspired by viral experiments.
Step into an open sandbox playground filled with interactive objects, dynamic physics, and endless experiment possibilities. This physics-driven game combines creative building, free-form simulation, and chaotic destruction, letting you design custom test setups, trigger realistic reactions, and explore a true science sandbox inspired by experiments.
Turn your ideas into action inside a creative physics sandbox where every object follows realistic physics rules. This sandbox experiment game lets you combine building elements, destruction mechanics, and interactive simulations to create unpredictable outcomes, test crazy inventions, and enjoy pure free-play gameplay inspired by science chaos.
Enjoy a true physics sandbox simulator with realistic physics, ragdoll interactions, and full freedom of creativity. This experiment game lets you build, destroy, and test anything you imagine, combining sandbox gameplay, building mechanics, and destruction physics in a chaotic world of crazy experiments and viral challenges.
This is a game where you decide what happens next. Become the inventor, embrace the chaos, and make science fun again!
Progress through experiments to unlock new tools, materials, and absurd devices that expand your creative freedom even further. The more you experiment, the more the sandbox opens up, encouraging curiosity, trial and error, and pure playful chaos. There are no wrong ideas here: every explosion, collapse, or unexpected chain reaction is part of the fun. Whether you’re recreating famous experiments or inventing something the world has never seen, this lab rewards imagination, boldness, and a love for physics-driven mayhem.
As your experiments grow bigger and wilder, the lab transforms into your personal playground of chaos. Each new tool unlocks another layer of madness — magnetic cannons, hover platforms, fluid tanks, and more — letting you chain reactions in ways no one expected. Challenge the limits of science and imagination as you combine fire, motion, and raw creativity to craft spectacular moments that defy logic. In this world, every failure is just another step toward the next great discovery — and every explosion is a loud reminder that science was never meant to be boring.
The beauty of this sandbox lies in its endless replay value — no two experiments ever play out exactly the same way. Thanks to the unpredictable nature of realistic physics, even repeating the same setup can lead to wildly different outcomes. You'll find yourself tweaking variables, repositioning objects, and adjusting angles just to see what happens when you change one tiny detail. Stack explosive barrels near a ragdoll, add a swinging pendulum, throw in some bouncing balls, and watch the chaos unfold in ways you never imagined. It's this constant sense of discovery and surprise that keeps you coming back, always asking "what if?" and always ready to blow something up in the name of science.

bluejetty:00062394:ios.name: Learning Games for Toddlers AZ
bluejetty:00062394:ios.developer: Kids Academy Co apps: Preschool & Kindergarten Learning Kids Games, Educational Books, Free Songs
bluejetty:00062394:ios.summary:
*** Fun EDUCATIONAL game for toddlers of AGE 2 and up 
*** SORT, MATCH, CLASSIFY and BUILD by shape, pattern, color and everyday objects 
*** Developed with certified child psychologists 
*** 12 beautiful mini-game boards 
About the game:
bluejetty:00062394:ios.description:
*** Fun EDUCATIONAL game for toddlers of AGE 2 and up 
*** SORT, MATCH, CLASSIFY and BUILD by shape, pattern, color and everyday objects 
*** Developed with certified child psychologists 
*** 12 beautiful mini-game boards 
About the game: 
----------------- 
The game consists of 12 beautiful rooms each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.
The game is designed to enhance the following skills: 
- Sorting and classifying 
- Hand-eye coordination 
- Quantitative perception
- Visual perception
- Concentration 
- Vocabulary 
Game Boards: 
--------------- 
The game consists of 12 boards. The boards were carefully chosen in order to represent basic elements from the child's world. 
Bathroom: Match polycubes by SHAPE. 
Dressing room: Match geometric SHAPES to dress the raccoon.
Living room: Place each everyday object in its LOGICAL place.
Watering Can: Classify geometric SHAPES. 
Playroom: Assemble toys by placing missing parts in their LOGICAL place.
Backyard: Sort fruits by COLOR.
Kitchen: Classify food and kitchen appliances by their purpose.
Dining room: Sort the raccoon’s dinner by matching SIZE and NUMBER.
Vegetable garden: Match fruits and vegetables by MEMORY.
Laundry room: Pair clothing items by SILHOUETTES.
Tent: Match geometric shapes by SHAPE and PATTERN.
Garage: Order different tools by SIZE.
All our products are designed and developed in cooperation with certified child psychologists and experienced educators.
TinyHands Games:
TinyHands Sorting Series
A set of sorting games designed to help children acquire basic concepts such as shape, color, size seasons and animals. Game boards are organized in an ascending difficulty level starting from basic sorting followed by more complex context based sorting and classification environments.
TinyHands Towers Series
A set of stacking games. The game is designed to help children acquire basic concepts such as: big VS. small, before VS. after, and bottom VS. top. Game boards are organized in an ascending difficulty level.
TinyHands What's My Pair Series
A series of three pair matching games. The game challenges the child to match pairs, initially based on visual aspects alone and in more advanced screens based on logic and understanding of card content.
TinyHands First Words Series
A set of vocabulary games for children of age 1.5 and up.
The game consists of 10 boards, each focused on a different theme from the child's world such as shapes, colors, clothes, animals and vehicles.
TinyHands Town Center
Educational game recommended for age 3+. This game includes 10 beautiful boards each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.
TinyHands Connect The Dots
The game consists of 12 mini game boards each presents a beautiful and magical scene. Each board contains several parts. The parts can be completed by connecting the numbered dots in a specific order. Upon completion, each part is dragged to gradually build an object. When all parts are drawn the scene is magically created and revealed. Designed for children aged 3+.
Note for parents:
Like all our games, this game is designed to provide quality playtime for parents and children together. Playing along with your children is highly recommended and will surely make them benefit the most from this app and help them expand their vocabulary.
We are sure that your children will enjoy this exciting educational game that will encourage their thinking and contribute to the development of their basic skills.
About the Team: 
We believe that children learn best through playing. We teamed up with certified child psychologists and experienced educators out of desire to create fun games that will help our children acquire new concepts and improve their skills.

With iA M
bluejetty:00060793:ios.description:
iA Mobile makes it easy for you focus on your goals by always having your information at your fingertips! Take advantage of your group insurance benefits and monitor your retirement savings and investments at iA Financial Group. 
With iA Mobile, you can: 
GROUP INSURANCE
- Submit your claims securely
- Send photos of your receipts, if required
- Track your claims
- Use your health spending account to reimburse the unpaid portion of a claim
- Check the eligibility of healthcare providers
- Check your prescription drug coverage
- Estimate the amount you will be reimbursed for your prescription drugs
- Find pharmacies that offer the prescription drug you are looking for and compare prices*
- Use your smartphone as a group insurance card
- Obtain proof of travel insurance**
- Produce the list of expenses for your income tax return
The functionalities in iA Mobile vary based on the plan chosen by your employer.
** WebRx users outside Quebec can view the price of the medication they are searching for in each pharmacy found. In Quebec, WebRx does not provide prices per pharmacy; instead it provides an average provincial price for each drug being searched.
** Obtain proof of travel insurance if your group insurance plan covers emergency medical care received outside of Canada
GROUP SAVINGS AND RETIREMENT
- See how much you have saved to date
- Track your progress toward your retirement goal 
- See the return on your investments
- Make voluntary contributions to your group RRSP, group TFSA or VRSP
- See your transaction history
- Make sure that your investment asset mix still matches your investor profile
- Designate or change your beneficiaries
INDIVIDUAL SAVINGS AND RETIREMENT
- View your investment balance
- See your personal rates of return for each contract
- Consult your electronic documents
You must be registered for My Client Space to take full advantage of iA Mobile. 
To learn more about iA Mobile, go to ia.ca/iamobile.

Get building materials by smashing old cars to pieces.

- People

bluejetty:00096506:ios.description:
Media Cleaner – Clean, Compress & Convert with Ease
Your useful toolkit for photo & video cleanup, space-saving, and more.
Media Cleaner helps you effortlessly tidy up your media library, save storage, and repurpose your content — all in a simple, intuitive experience.
Cleaning
• Detects and removes duplicate & similar photos and videos
• Cleans up screenshots, screen recordings, and large files
• One-tap removal to free up valuable storage
Efficient Compression
• Reduce file sizes of photos & videos to save space
• Keeps visual quality optimized for sharing and viewing
• Perfect for users running out of space without losing memories
Powerful Conversion Tools
• Photo Merge – Combine multiple screenshots or images into one seamless visual — then delete the originals to free up space.
• Photo Crop: Trim unwanted edges for a cleaner, more focused image.
• Text Extract (OCR): Instantly pull text from images — useful data saved, image discarded.
• Video to Live Photo – Turn favorite video moments into Live Photos.
• Live Photo to Still – Convert Live Photos to standard images to reduce file size.
Privacy First
All processing happens locally on your device. No uploads, no tracking — your data stays yours.
Free up space. Stay organized. Make your media work smarter — all in one app.
Download Media Cleaner now and enjoy a lighter, faster phone.
SUBSCRIPTION INFO:
Media Cleaner provide these subscription options：
- Weekly subscription: unlock all features
- Weekly subscription with 3 days free trial: unlock all features
- Monthly subscription: unlock all features
- Different countries have different prices
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Service：http://www.dreamwaytech.ltd/cleanerterms.htm
Privacy Policy：http://www.dreamwaytech.ltd/cleanerprivacy.htm

bluejetty:00128318:ios.description:

Features of Deluxe Block Jewel:

- Each levels is a new challenge so you can always train your brain
