Play Pusoy, a classic Filipino card game and strategic poker-style game, trusted by a global community of over 2 million players.
Arrange 13 cards into three hands, challenge real online players, and use smart strategy to win round after round. Whether you grew up playing Pusoy with family and friends, love Pinoy card games, or are new to 13-card poker-style games, Pusoy ZingPlay - Chinese Poker is free to play, easy to start, fun to practice, and rewarding to master.
Enjoy the strategy of Pusoy, the familiar feel of classic Filipino and Pinoy card games, and the competitive challenge of 3-stack poker with poker-style hand rankings. No ads. No endless bluffing. Just smart card arrangement, quick decisions, real player competition, daily gold bonuses, and satisfying wins.
Why players love Pusoy ZingPlay - Chinese Poker:
 • Classic Filipino Pusoy gameplay
 • Free-to-play online card game experience
 • No ads for smooth, relaxing gameplay
 • Real online players and live card matches
 • Daily gold bonuses, login rewards, quests, mini games, and Lucky Spin
 • Strategic 13-card arrangement
 • Poker-style hand rankings
 • Easy to learn, challenging to master
 • Fast rounds for quick breaks or daily play
 • Practice your skills and improve every round
 • Super League mode and leaderboards
If you enjoy Pusoy, Filipino card games, Pinoy card games, Chinese Poker, Big Two, poker-style hand rankings, online card games, or strategy card games, Pusoy ZingPlay - Chinese Poker gives you a fresh way to practice your skills and enjoy every hand.
Download now and join over 2 million players worldwide. Relax, challenge real players, and enjoy a smart card game anytime, anywhere.
Note: This game is intended for an adult audience and does not offer real-money gambling or real-money prizes.

bluejetty:00030913:ios.description:
Looking for a sperm donor, egg donor, embryo donor or surrogate? Perhaps someone willing to co-parent? Maybe you can help others start a family? 
Just a Baby is the fastest growing community connecting you with thousands of people worldwide open to discussing surrogacy, donation and co-parenting. 
FREE TO FIND MATCHES AND CHAT 
With Just a Baby, it’s free to find matches and start chatting with potential donors, surrogates or co-parents, bringing you one step closer to achieving your dream of having a baby! 
JUST ONE SWIPE AWAY FROM STARTING A FAMILY 
Finding a match has never been easier. To like someone, swipe right, or swipe left to pass. If someone likes you back, it’s a match and we connect you together through chat. 
Simply swipe, match, and connect until you find the right egg or sperm donor, embryo donor, surrogate or co-parent you’re looking for. 
CONNECT LOCALLY OR GLOBALLY 
Adjust the distance of the people you want to match with, or filter your search results to find surrogates, sperm, egg and embryo donors around the world. 
GROW YOUR FAMILY YOUR WAY 
People have different ways of growing and starting a family. Some want to find a donor to conceive, some want to co-parent and others don’t, it's up to you. You decide how you use Jab to do so. 
OR MAYBE YOU CAN HELP OTHERS? 
Thousands of couples and singles are struggling to conceive or get pregnant. With JaB, you can help others achieve their dream of having a baby by. Let them know privately and confidentially what you have to offer or let it be known on your profile so the right people can find you. 
UPGRADE FOR MORE! 
Subscribe to Just a Baby Plus+ to experience more features like: 
• Unlimited swipes
• No Ads
• See those who you liked and who likes you
• Get free ChattyLikes
• Put people in your "Maybe Pile" and reconsider later
• Swap photos and files
• See when your match was last active
• See history of past matches
• Review recent dislikes 
• Masquerade Mode to change your name and protect your privacy
• Translate profiles of other language
• Have private pics, revealed only to people you like
SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS 
Just a Baby Plus+ subscriptions offered: 
• 1 week (USD$9.99) 
• 1 month (USD$19.99) 
Your iTunes account will be charged upon purchase. Within at least 24 hours before the end of your current subscription, your subscription is auto-renewed. Subscription can be managed and Auto-renewal can be turned off by going to your Account settings. 
IN-APP PURCHASES 
Just a Baby credits are available for purchase within the app. Credits are used to send direct messages to potential donors. 1 credit = 1 message. 
● 1 JAB Credit $1.99USD 
● 5 JAB Credits $6.99USD 
● 30 JAB Credits $9.99USD 
OTHER THINGS YOU NEED TO KNOW 
● Just a Baby is safe and secure. You can view our Privacy Policy at https://www.justababy.io/privacy-safety/ & our Terms of Use at https://www.justababy.io/terms-of-service/ 
● You must be at least 18 years old to download & use this app 
DOWNLOAD FREE TODAY 
Begin your baby journey FREE today and start matching and chatting with Just a Baby! 
We're always excited to hear from you! If you have any feedback, please mail us at info@justababy.com

bluejetty:00122974:ios.description:
Stay connected to your MTB account and services 24/7 with the MTB Neo App, now available for iOS devices. This convenient, free service is offered to all MTB customers registered for the MTB Neo App. With the MTB Neo, you can:
* View account information in real-time
* Transfer funds to MTB or other banks via NPSB/BEFTN/RTGS
* Perform MFS transfers and add beneficiaries
* Recharge mobile phones instantly
* Access credit card details and pay bills (in local and international currencies)
* Opening FDR & DPS products
* Order checkbooks and much more
How do you activate the MTB Neo App on your device?
1. Click on Register to MTB Neo
2. Input your registered mobile number
3. Verify OTP
4. Select your bank account number or card number
5. Set your user ID and password
6. You are ready to log in to MTB Neo
Your Security Is Our Priority
MTB ensures a secure mobile-based banking experience with state-of-the-art security features:
* Registration Required: You must be registered for MTB Neo to access the iOS app.
* Activation Process: App usage requires an activation request from your MTB Neo account.
* Advanced Encryption: The service is secured by SSL encryption and additional proprietary encryption technology from MTB.
* Device Restriction: Only registered devices can access the MTB Neo iOS App.
* Two-Factor Authentication: Every transaction is protected by two-factor authentication for added security.
Need Assistance?
Our 24/7 MTB Contact Centre is here to help:
* Domestic Calls: 16219 or 096040 16219
* International Calls: +880 96040 16219
* Email: customer.service@mutualtrustbank.com
With MTB Neo, enjoy seamless, secure, and convenient banking at your fingertips!

bluejetty:00080384:ios.summary: Upgrade your Portland Parks Golf experience! Book tee times, connect with members, and manage your game with ease. Our app offers electronic scorecards, house account statements, and push notifications. This all in one app give you access t
bluejetty:00080384:ios.description:
Upgrade your Portland Parks Golf experience! Book tee times, connect with members, and manage your game with ease. Our app offers electronic scorecards, house account statements, and push notifications. This all in one app give you access to the following 4 Portland Golf Course: Heron Lakes Golf Club, Colwood Golf Center, Eastmoreland Golf Course and Rose City Golf Club. Download now!
Established in 1918, Portland Parks Golf has a robust history as a core recreational offering for the City of Portland and its residents. In recent years as a multi-course system, over 330,000 rounds of golf are played on Portland Parks’ courses each year. At each of our sites, we take great pride in providing both public and private events, competitions, and lessons from our phenomenal instructors. Our facilities also host several member clubs who play our courses on a weekly basis. 
The golf system’s mission is to support the Portland community’s overall health and wellness by making Portland Parks public golf courses accessible to people of all backgrounds. In order to promote a feeling of community, we are dedicated to fostering a friendly and inclusive atmosphere. We want to encourage and equip people to use our public courses and appreciate the surrounding natural beauty through community participation and education. 
- Municipal golf courses provide affordable access to golfers regardless of socioeconomic status. 
- We offer variable green fee rate structures which provide multiple pricing options in order to accommodate all users. 
- Each one of our courses has a free practicing chipping & putting green, this provides a perfect space for golfers of all skill levels to practice their game. 
- Our maintenance crews are committed to maintaining the highest quality of course conditions, enhancing everyone’s recreational experience.

bluejetty:00021142:ios.description:
Instant mobile refrigerant charge calculator for HVACR applications.
The HVACR Check & Charge™ mobile app from Copeland Climate Technologies provides an on-site refrigerant charge calculator for air conditioning and refrigeration applications. Based on historic sliding cardboard charge calculators, this app allows contractors to easily calculate the correct system refrigerant charge for R-22, R-410A, R-32, R-407C, R-134a, R-452B, R-454B, R-438A, R-422B, R-427A, R-421A, R-404A, R-290, R-449A, R-448A, R-407A, R-600, R-600a, R502, R-514A and R-515B. Contractors can simply choose Superheat, Subcooling, or Airflow and enter the specified system temperatures along with the latent and sensible environmental loads. These values are then used to determine the proper system charge and whether the charge amount needs to be altered based on these conditions. 
• AC & Refrigeration Systems
• Superheat Calculator (non-TXV)
• Subcooling Calculator (TXV)
• Airflow Calculator
• PT Charts (Pressure / Temperature)
• Find a Superheat target using psychometric calculations
• For use with R-22, R-410A, R-32, R-407C, R-134a, R-452B, R-454B, R-438A, R-422B, R-427A, R-421A, R-404A, R-290, R-449A, R-448A, R-407A, R-600, R-600a, R502, R-514A and R-515B.
• Imperial and Metric Support
Assists with calculating proper system refrigerant charge based on operating conditions.
Information on this and other Copeland applications are available at https://www.copeland.com/en-us/tools-resources/mobile-apps

bluejetty:00177378:ios.description:
What are your plans for becoming an Australian national? It's a computer-based test administered by officials in Australia that you must pass if you're interested in becoming an Australian citizen. The questions on the test are centered on the history of Australia, as well as its democratic, religious, and legal institutions. It also includes questions based on the Ten Essential Values of Australians. The guidebook of "Australian Citizenship Test - Our Common Bond" is referenced in the questions. 
If you're planning on taking the Australian Citizenship Test in 2023, this is the software for you. 
There are about 250 questions in this app, which is broken up into four main categories. "Australian Citizenship Test - Our Common Bond" has been taken into consideration in the development of this professional test. If you want to ace the Australian Citizenship Test on your first try, use this software to help you study properly. Some of the app's special features include: 
4 divisions: History of Australia; Democratic; Beliefs; Rights; Liberties; and Laws. - Over 250 questions separated into four sections. 
- The Australian citizenship test can be practiced as much as you desire. 
- Perform a simulation test. 
The unanswered or incorrectly answered questions are kept in a database. 
Based on how many and what kind of questions you have, you may customize your practice test. 
Official "Australia - Our Common Bond" mock test; official "Australia - Our Common Bond" mock test results; official "Australia - Our Common Bond" mock test results

bluejetty:00146371:ios.description:
Level up your fitness with StepSetGo, India's most loved step counter and health app!
Make fitness fun and rewarding. The app accurately tracks your steps, calories, and detailed workout sessions (walks, runs, cycles). Monitor your progress, compete with friends, and unlock rewards simply by staying active.
Now access SSG’s new reward system - Deal Buddies, where you can get guaranteed discounts on 50+ top brands throughout the year. 
Join 10 Million+ Indians to track, challenge, and get guaranteed discounts on top brands with StepSetGo!
TRACK STEPS AND CALORIES - AUTOMATICALLY AND OFFLINE 
- Easily monitor your daily steps and calories and view them on the homepage. 
- The step counter syncs your steps automatically in the background, even when you are offline!
NEW WAY TO REWARD YOUR FITNESS WITH DEAL BUDDIES
- Earn SSG coins and redeem some of them on the Deal Buddies page to get discounted vouchers of Top Brands.
- Save anytime as the offers are live throughout the year.
- Stack the discounted vouchers from Deal Buddies along with ongoing offers from the brand to save more!
LEVEL UP YOUR FITNESS
- Stay consistent on your fitness journey and maintain a streak by reaching your daily step goals to upgrade Levels.
- The higher your Level, the more you need to walk to maintain your streak, and the more active and fit you become!
- The app levels up with you - each Level has a bright, new colour to give you a whole new experience.
RECORD WORKOUT SESSIONS
- Accurately track your walks, runs, and cycling sessions while getting real-time updates on your map route, steps, distance, speed and calories burnt!
- Get personalized training metrics and important data insights like speed, active time, cadence, distance covered, and time splits per kilometre after your walks, runs, and cycle rides.
- Sync with Google Fit and most fitness wearables like Fitbit, Noise, OnePlus, Amazfit, Boat and many more.
VIEW FITNESS REPORTS
- Monitor your walking, running, and cycling activities with daily, weekly, and monthly graphs.
- View daily, weekly, and monthly averages and analyze your progress over time.
CHALLENGE YOURSELF 
- Participate in different fitness challenges ranging from 1 day to 3 months and reach personalized goals.
- Choose a personal goal according to your fitness needs (weight loss, marathon training, long-distance cycling, etc.) for running, walking and cycling.
- Match with StepSetGo users who are on the same level as you and compete with them in exciting Fitness Matches.
- Earn SSG Coins by completing challenges, winning matches, and claiming Daily Rewards.
- Join Fitness Leagues and compete with users from all over India to win premium rewards based on your fitness level, effort, and consistency.
HAVE FUN WITH FRIENDS 
- Follow friends, join the StepSetGo community, motivate yourself, and celebrate each other’s wins.
- Keep your competitive spirit alive by connecting with others!
- Stay updated and motivated through our blog posts on health and fitness topics, your followers' activities, and events around your location.
THE ULTIMATE FITNESS TRACKER FOR WALKING, CYCLING, AND RUNNING.
Whether you want to get in shape, lose weight or keep track of your fitness level, StepSetGo is the perfect health app to stay for you!
StepSetGo includes both a free version and a paid subscription (StepSetGo PRO) with premium features like no ads, exclusive fitness challenges, and more.

bluejetty:00137290:ios.description:
Welcome to the Official app of the Masters Tournament.
Bringing you closer than ever to the beauty and excitement of the Masters Tournament in Augusta, GA, on April 6th-12th, 2026, the official app of the Masters provides the most comprehensive coverage available.
The Official Masters Tournament app includes:
LIVE SIMULCAST OF MASTERS BROADCAST COVERAGE
- Watch the LIVE broadcast simulcast Thursday through Sunday
LIVE STREAMS OF FEATURE CONTENT
- Live play from Amen Corner
- Live play from Hole Nos. 4, 5 & 6
- Live play from Hole Nos. 15 and 16
- Featured Groups channel following key players around the course
- Masters On the Range - Special analysis from a live-streamed Practice Range show Monday, April 8th through Sunday, April 14th
- Masters Green Jacket Ceremony
Beautiful full-screen HDR video viewable with 3G or better and Wi-Fi connections. The multi-stream live video player allows you to watch up to 4 channels at a time. (iPad only)
(Live video is available in the United States, Algeria, Egypt, India, Iraq, Israel, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Morocco, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Tunisia and United Arab Emirates only.)
LIVE ACTIVITIES
- Get real-time scoring updates on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
MY GROUP
- Create a personalized featured group channel
- Watch every shot from the players YOU choose
- Include highlights you want to see, either from your fantasy roster, your favorites or the rest of the field
FANTASY
Build a fantasy roster to compete against friends, family, and the world as the players compete for the Green Jacket. Daily and Tournament-wide prizes are available. (Prizes can only be won by legal residents of the United States who are 18 years or older).
EVERY SHOT, EVERY HOLE
- Watch every shot from every player on every hole over all 4 rounds on the Player Pages
3D SHOT TRACKING FEATURE
- Follow each shot of action on an interactive 3D course model
- Follow any player and view every shot, in real time
- View ball location, shot distances, pin placements, and video of every shot
RANGE TRACKER
- Watch live 3D shot tracking from the Tournament Practice Range
- See individual players’ warm up routine and shot stats
VIDEO EVERYWHERE
- Watch Live Video and Video-on-Demand in the Picture-in-Picture feature while you explore other areas of the app
EXCLUSIVE LIVE SCORING
- Interact with the live Leader Board, the official online source of Masters scoring and results
MINI-LEADER BOARD
- Live score updates for your favorite players are always viewable while you explore the app
APPLE WATCH SUPPORT
- Notifications, scoring and player stats, all available from your Apple Watch
APPLE TV
- Live video multi-stream, Video-on-Demand and scores are available from Apple TV
COURSE OVERVIEW
- Detailed hole information with imagery, stats and layout
MASTERS RADIO
- Live radio coverage of the Masters Tournament starting Thursday, April 9th.
TEE TIMES
- A round-by-round view of each day’s pairings with easy navigation to find the tee time of any player
NEWS
- Latest news and commentary from the 2026 Tournament
- On-demand video highlights, feature clips and player interviews
- Photo galleries of daily Tournament action, rich course imagery and the Tournament’s illustrious historical moments
- Beautiful and data-rich infographics
- Player information, push notification alerts and all the latest news and live text updates from Masters Tournament.

bluejetty:00185551:ios.description:
Watch the best live and on-demand football. 100% legal and official, in the original language and in HD.
Install Fanatiz and start watching the best football from South America and around the world right away: live matches, highlights, statistics, interviews, and documentaries. No cuts or interruptions, on all your devices.
BEFORE YOU SUBSCRIBE: AVAILABILITY BY COUNTRY
Fanatiz operates with broadcasting rights by territory. Not all leagues are available in all countries. Check what content you can watch from your location at fanatiz.com or within the app before subscribing. The territory for each property is indicated below.
FOOTBALL, LIVE CHANNELS, AND SPORTS FROM AROUND THE WORLD
- Continental Tournaments: Copa Libertadores, Copa Sudamericana, and Recopa Sudamericana (United States and Canada)
- Argentine Football: Liga Profesional de Fútbol (Outside Argentina and Brazil) and Copa Argentina (United States and Canada)
- Brazilian Football: Brasileirão and Brazilian futsal (Outside Brazil)
- Peruvian Football: Liga 1 and L1MAX programming (Outside Peru)
- Colombian Football: Liga BetPlay Dimayor and Copa BetPlay Dimayor (United States and Canada)
- Paraguayan Football: Primera División and Copa Paraguay (United States)
- European Football: Ligue 1 (France), Primeira Liga and Taça de Portugal, Süper Lig (Türkiye), Ekstraklasa (Poland) (United States and Canada)
- African Football: Africa Cup of Nations, Women's Africa Cup of Nations, CAF Champions League, and CAF Confederation Cup (United States and Canada)
- More Sports: CDO+ multi-sport programming (available worldwide) and the Premier Padel circuit (United States and Canada)
- Live sports channels, thousands of hours on demand (VOD), interviews and highlights.
PERSONALIZE YOUR EXPERIENCE
- Tailored to you: Choose your favorite teams for faster access to stats and results, and receive personalized alerts.
- Multi-device: Watch on iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV, with AirPlay support. Fanatiz is also available on the web and on other connected TV devices — see fanatiz.com for the full list.
- At your own pace: Watch live or relive the best moments with VOD. (VOD content availability and duration vary)
- Guaranteed quality: Adaptive streaming up to HD. All you need is a stable internet connection.
SUBSCRIPTION
Fanatiz Front Row is available as a monthly subscription, or as an annual subscription at a discounted rate, giving you full access to the content available in your territory. Cancel anytime.
Payment will be charged to your Apple Account upon confirmation of purchase, and the subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and the renewal price will be displayed. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00161427:ios.summary:
Ruffio – Backing Track Maker, Karaoke App, Music Stem Splitter, and AI Music Practice Tool
Ruffio is the all-in-one music app that lets you remove vocals from songs, isolate instruments, and create custom multitrack backing tracks using ad
bluejetty:00161427:ios.description:
Ruffio – Backing Track Maker, Karaoke App, Music Stem Splitter, and AI Music Practice Tool
Ruffio is the all-in-one music app that lets you remove vocals from songs, isolate instruments, and create custom multitrack backing tracks using advanced AI audio separation—right on your iPhone or iPad. Whether you're a singer, musician, student, producer, DJ, or music lover, Ruffio helps you unlock the full potential of any track.
Using powerful machine learning, Ruffio separates songs into stems—vocals, drums, bass, and accompaniment—so you can mute, solo, or adjust individual instruments. Create karaoke versions, practice your instrument, or hear the mix like never before.
---
Powerful AI Features
- AI Stem Separation: Split any song into vocals, drums, bass, and other instruments using Spleeter
- Mute Vocals: Instantly create karaoke versions of any track
- Mute Instruments: Remove drums, bass, guitar, or piano to create your own backing tracks
- Solo Mode: Focus on one instrument to learn parts more effectively
- Real-Time Mixing: Adjust each stem’s volume to build your perfect mix
- Works Offline: Process songs directly on your device—no internet required after setup
- Video and Audio Support: Import MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, MP4, and MOV files
- Private: Your music never leaves your device—no cloud uploads
---
How It Works
- Import songs from your Music app (local files only)
- Open files from iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Google Drive, or Files
- Ruffio separates your song into stems using on-device AI
- Adjust, mute, or solo each track in real time
- Practice, perform, remix, or explore your music in new ways
---
Perfect For
- Singers – Remove vocals and sing along with real instrumentals
- Guitarists – Mute guitar tracks and jam with the band
- Drummers – Create drumless tracks to practice rhythm and timing
- Bassists – Isolate or remove basslines for deeper learning
- Pianists – Focus on keyboard parts or play over piano-free mixes
- DJs and Producers – Extract stems for remixing and creative projects
- Music Teachers – Make custom practice tools for students
- Students – Learn songs by ear and study arrangements in depth
- Cover Artists – Make pro-quality karaoke or backing tracks
- Music Lovers – Hear hidden layers and details in every song
---
Why Choose Ruffio
- No subscriptions or locked core features
- Fast, on-device audio processing
- Simple, clean, user-friendly interface
- Based on Spleeter: trusted by producers and musicologists worldwide
- Constant updates based on community feedback
---
File Support
- MP3, M4A, AAC, FLAC, WAV (audio)
- MP4, MOV (video audio extraction)
- DRM-free songs from your Music app
- Files from cloud storage and local folders
---
Built with Spleeter
Ruffio uses Spleeter, an open-source stem separation model developed by Deezer. This powerful AI is trusted by professional audio engineers and now available in a mobile app designed for everyone.
All separation is done locally. Your music stays private. No cloud uploads, no waiting, no ads.
---
Support & Feedback
We're building Ruffio to be the best music practice and karaoke tool on iOS. Got ideas or issues? Contact us directly:
rufusmall@hotmail.com
---
Transform the way you learn, practice, and enjoy music.
Download Ruffio now and turn any song into a karaoke track, backing track, or stem-separated mix.

bluejetty:00027235:ios.name: Capture Pilot
bluejetty:00027235:ios.summary:
Use your iOS device to remotely view, zoom, rate, and tag high-resolution images during a photography shoot. 
Plus, combine Capture Pilot with the additional “Camera Control” in-app purchase to transform your iOS device into a virtual came
bluejetty:00027235:ios.description:
Use your iOS device to remotely view, zoom, rate, and tag high-resolution images during a photography shoot. 
Plus, combine Capture Pilot with the additional “Camera Control” in-app purchase to transform your iOS device into a virtual camera display, so you can remotely fire your camera and control essential capture parameters from your iPhone, iPad or iPod Touch. 
For use with photo editing software Capture One Pro, Capture Pilot is the perfect tool for teams and multi-user shoots, while clients can use it to review shots in real-time and better communicate with photographers. 
“Whether it is clients, make-up artists, wardrobe stylists or photographers, or anyone who needs to keep an eye on the shoot, Capture Pilot allows them to see every detail of what is being shot. Most importantly, it successfully engages the entire team in the photographic process."
- Daryn Labier, Blast Digital Studio
“In all, I’m extremely impressed with Phase One’s iOS application Capture Pilot. It enhances the creative process in ways that you won’t be able to predict.”
- Mike Hagen, Nikonians
---------------
KEY FEATURES
---------------
VIEW AND BROWSE
- Wirelessly view, zoom and pan high-resolution DSLR and medium format RAW, JPEG and TIFF images during a shoot.
- Unique and easy-to-use rating and tagging feature enables clients or staff in the studio or on remote locations to participate in the shoot and to provide instant feedback.
LIVE VIEW WITH PHASE ONE IQ250 and IQ3 (CMOS) DIGITAL BACKS
- Work wirelessly with remote live viewing functionality with a Phase One IQ250 and IQ3 50MP camera system, turning your mobile device into an electronic viewfinder.
GEOTAGGING OF IMAGES WITH PHASE ONE IQ CAMERA SYSTEMS
- Record location data and geotag your images 
'CAMERA CONTROL' IN-APP PURCHASE
- Connect directly to a Phase One IQ2 or IQ3 series digital back to remotely fire and control your camera and check capture previews directly on your iPhone, iPad or iPod Touch. Free for Phase One Digital Back users.
- Connect your camera to a Mac or Windows computer running Capture One Pro and use your iPad, iPhone or iPod touch to remotely fire and control your Canon, Nikon, Sony, Phase One, Leaf or Mamiya camera.
- Control your camera’s most important capture parameters on a virtual camera display: ISO sensitivity, exposure mode, shutter speed, aperture, and exposure compensation.
-------
NOTES
-------
To check for supported cameras and tethering support visit: https://www.captureone.com/features/supported-cameras
Capture One Pro (11.1 or later) with supported camera tethered connection is required when pairing the camera control app with a Sony camera. 
Capture Pilot can connect directly over Wi-Fi to a Phase One IQ2 or IQ3 Digital back. 
Focus controls is currently only supported when used directly with a Wi-Fi capable IQ Digital Back running Feature Update 4.
Capture Pilot can also connect over Wi-Fi to Capture One Pro (versions 20, 12, 11, 10, 9, 8, 7 and 6) for browsing Capture One collections, or for control of supported cameras tethered to Capture One.
Capture Pilot can use the GPS unit in your device to access and record location data. Synchronization of the recorded location data with images can happen either simultaneously when Capture Pilot is connected to a Phase One IQ2 or IQ3 digital back, or when the Capture Pilot connection is re-established later. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life, therefore a “Turn Geo tagging Off” timer option is available in the Capture Pilot preferences.
You can download a trial version of Capture One Pro from www.captureone.com/en/download-trial

bluejetty:00072950:ios.description:
We are pleased to launch our new Coach Bus Simulator game in the year 2023 with all the modern game play features and realistic racers graphics for your new iPhone.
Our new game of the day is one of the top apple arcade games for you which will give you the perfect feel of driving a Full size passenger bus in multiple environments. 
You will enjoy game play thought out with very easy controls and no instructions needed to complete levels.
Bus simulator games are now trending in most of the countries around the world and are now become one for the favorite free games.
If you have recently purchased a new iPhone and looking for most recent updated & upgraded Bus simulator game, then our Coach Bus simulator 2023 is the answer to your need.
Our game of the day have four Amazing Modes for you to feel the Bus Driving experience with amazing graphics and multi environments while driving bus around the city for picking and dropping passengers in time to complete levels.
Following Four modes are launched in 2023 and many more are coming soon!
1) Career Mode
2) Snow Mode
3) Time Trial 
4) Racing Mode
In Career mode, you can test your bus driving skills in 15 unique levels with multiple Mission Objectives that will help you grow your abilities on controlling huge passenger vehicle.
In Snow mode you have 10 unique levels in which you will be driving bus in snow falling areas with amazing surroundings and beautiful views.
In Time trial Mode, you can practice your bus riding skills of picking and dropping passengers on multiple bus stations and on time to carry on to next station and keep driving until you feel tired and fell asleep.
In the Racing mode you have to complete with 3 other players and have to be first in 5 unique levels to complete in the in Racing mode.
Our updated and upgraded coach bus simulator 2023 game is one of the new games we love from all other games we have made for you so far. You can do drift & drag racing of buses in the racing mode as well as while playing in the other modes. 
So download now as citizens are waiting for new bus driver to provide pick and drop on time to save passengers from getting late from there destinations.
Keep on getting daily reward by playing daily and buy new model coach busses with enhanced features to get unique game play feeling and much more explore in the city.
If you are plane, train, automobiles & more simulator lover then you will definitely rate our game as game of the day in your new iPhone.
With three different camera Angles which are now trending, you can feel the bus simulation from Top view and view from standing behind the driver as well as driver view that will make you feel as real bus driver.
You can choose from three different type of controls for driving your bus as per your own comfort, including arrow navigation, steering wheel and gyro sensor driving mode that gives you opportunity to feel multiple scenarios of game play features.
With realistic racers in your competition you will require Updated & upgraded Busses to compete in racing mode with drift & drag racing.
This new coach bus simulator 2023 game will become one of the top apple arcade games for you and much more explore is coming soon for your favorite free games.

bluejetty:00100300:ios.description:
Arrowscape is a fast-thinking, direction-based puzzle game where every move matters. Your mission is clear: follow the arrows, avoid dead ends, and escape the board before time runs out. Each level tests your logic, focus, and ability to recognize patterns under pressure.
Move through carefully crafted arrow mazes, unlock new difficulties, and challenge yourself with progressively complex levels. As you advance, the arrows become trickier, the routes more deceptive, and the decisions more demanding. One wrong step can set you back, but the right path leads you to victory.
A perfect choice for players who enjoy clean, smart, and highly engaging puzzle challenges.
Features
Hundreds of handcrafted arrow-based puzzles
Fast, intuitive, and easy-to-learn gameplay
Follow the arrows to discover the correct escape path
Time-based challenges for added excitement
Smooth animations with a modern minimalist style
Instant restart allows you to try again and improve your performance
Whether you prefer quick logic challenges or deeper strategic puzzles, Arrowscape offers an addictive and satisfying experience that will keep you coming back for more.

As you advance, the arrows become trickier, the routes more deceptive, and the decisions more demanding. One wrong step can set you back, but the right path leads you to victory.
A perfect choice for players who enjoy clean, smart, and highly engaging puzzle challenges.

Features
Hundreds of handcrafted arrow-based puzzles
Fast, intuitive, and easy-to-learn gameplay
Follow the arrows to discover the correct escape path
Time-based challenges for added excitement
Smooth animations with a modern minimalist style
Instant restart allows you to try again and improve your performance

Whether you prefer quick logic challenges or deeper strategic puzzles, Arrowscape offers an addictive and satisfying experience that will keep you coming back for more.

Basic Features:
- No need to register with your email
bluejetty:00071144:ios.description:
Palu is a shared handwriting calendar app and service.The app allows you to connect with your friends and family through handwritten notes and pictures. IT IS FREE WITHOUT REGISTRATION.
Basic Features:
- No need to register with your email address or provide any personal information!
- Paste images and write whatever you want on your calendar.
- More colorful calendars using “Stamps”
- Share your calendar simply and easily with friends and family.
- Two modes of sharing: full access and view only
- Three calendars available for free
- Overlap two calendars with holding down on a tab
- Cut and paste to move, copy and paste to duplicate daily content
- The calendar shows the month view in portrait orientation and two weeks view in landscape orientation on iPhone.
- Back up and restore your data using iCloud Drive
Additional Features (Optional in-app purchases):
- Remove advertisements to give more screen space
- Increase the maximum number of calendars to thirty (Switching and sorting calendars to be displayed are available)
Usage:
- Mom can use her home iPad to write the night's schedule and Dad can check it on his iPhone.
- Couples can share their work shifts and plan their next get-together.
- Band members can arrange their practice days and their live event schedule.
- Paste one picture of your kids per day on the calendar to make it easy to see how much they grow each day.
Other uses are infinite and up to you!
Notes When Sharing:
- Please take note that when sharing your Palu calendar, it is made public to everyone who receives the invitation email (including those to whom it was forwarded).
- By turning sharing off, the data is deleted from the server and will no longer be shared.

If you’re a fan of puzzle games energy and sort of excitement, this is your perfect blend of chaos and joy. Taste victory — and feel the Hotpot heat.

* holiday e-card templates,

Photo Lab PRO includes:

Become an astronaut, a medieval knight, a gangster or a beautiful fairy – all with a single tap!
- Photorealistic effects.
Put your face on a billboard or a banknote; put your photo into an ancient book or airbrush it on a posh car.
- Photo filters.
Neon Glow, Fire, Chalk & Charcoal, HDR, Pencil Drawing, Oil Painting, Impressionist Art, Jigsaw Puzzle, and more.
- Lovely backgrounds.
Change the background of your photo to make it look really romantic and beautiful!
- Human-to-animal montages.
What would it feel like being a tiger, a rabbit, a lion or a bird? Upload your portrait photo and check it out for yourself!
- Magazine covers for the ambitious and the fashionable.
Put your face on a magazine cover like Cosmopolitan, Vogue or Playboy and feel what it's like to be famous!
- Headwear.
Try on a King's crown, Elf hat, St.Patrick's Day hat or the most popular Santa hat!
- Caricature effects.
Animate faces and turn your portrait photos into amusing caricatures!

Put yourself together with your sweetheart or even all your friends into one photo collage.

With the best ever Okey game,
bluejetty:00121766:ios.description:
Okey, the indispensable classic board game of generations, is now in your pocket. 
The first Okey game specially made for iPad and iPhone, differs from other games with its simple and carefully crafted design.
With the best ever Okey game, you can:
• Play Okey offline against superior artificial intelligence when you do not have the internet.
• Join your friends' game and invite them to yours.
• Avoid the hassle of waiting with a quick match.
• Enjoy Okey as if you are playing at a real table with its simple and carefully prepared designs, away from unnecessary and confusing effects.
• Get rid of the annoying ads that get in your way during the game!
Okey is an addictive, table based game played by 4 players. The goal is to form special sequences with randomly dealt tiles and finish first. 
It is similar to Rummikub with the differing rules.
If you don't know how to play Okey, or if you need to refresh your memory the game includes detailed explanation of the rules. 
We always keep the game up to date and pay attention to your comments to give you and your friends the best Okey experience. 
Download the game now, join thousands of Okey lovers and find your seat at a table without even waiting! 
Come on, we’re waiting for you. 
We need a fourth at the table!

bluejetty:00040938:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00040938:ios.description:
Eng Breaking helps you learn English sucessfully in just 3 months!
Prepare for IELTS 6.5, TOEIC 700, and practice English conversation with native speakers. 567,300 learners across Southeast Asia have achieved success with Eng Breaking.
◆ Eng Breaking is a leading English learning app in Asia for all ages. Eng Breaking can meet all your English learning needs with exclusive benefits:
- Automatically memorize English vocabulary and apply it immediately with: 285 common English expressions and grammar patterns, along with 13 IELTS and TOEIC practice tests.
- Practice listening to and speaking English like a native speaker with 36 common communicative topics (everyday conversations, business English, restaurants, hotels, travel, English for specific purposes, etc.).
- Apply 3,000 common English words to understand 97% of English conversations in any situation.
- Don't understand English or can't speak it properly? Eng Breaking brings to you 264 audio files ranging from easy to difficult, at two speeds.
◆ Eng Breaking - the game app with the most exciting FEATURES to learn English:
* PLAY: Practice your English on a daily basis by playing games to learn English vocabulary by topic, practice pronunciation, and join real conversations with learners around the world. No memorization, no exercises. Just spend 30 minutes a day, and after 3 months, you can communicate in English fluently like a native speaker.
- Vocabulary Stages – Vocab: Learn vocabulary through a multi-sensory approach: sound, vivid images, and fun English games.
- Listening Stages – Listening: Improve listening comprehension skills, get used to the English intonation, and enhance your responsiveness to standard American English pronunciation.
- Speaking Stages – Speaking: Practice responsive speaking, learn to communicate naturally and fluently, and compete with other learners.
* LEARN:
- Ulti Pronun: Focus on building a strong foundation for English pronunciation with 40 standard IPA sounds, along with a detailed speaking course from basic to advanced.
- Eng Breaking: Learn all 4 English skills following the standard IELTS 6.5 and TOEIC 700 programs.
* SOCIAL+: Learn English through outstanding features like Native Club (talking with native speakers), Talking Room (including Basic Room and VIP room), and making friends.
* NATIVE 1-1: Book classes to learn English and practice one-on-one with an native English speaking teacher.
◆ Personalized English learning path:
- With an exclusive and highly effective learning path, Eng Breaking helps users learn English communication at all levels, from easy to difficult.
- An entry test is provided to assess learners' proficiency level and design the most suitable learning path.
- Weekly reports are exclusively designed for each learner to estimate studying hours and track learning progress.
- AI tutor, a reliable companion, helps users learn English easier and more convenient. As they speak, the AI will assess vocabulary and grammar, correct pronunciation and suggest suitable vocabulary and expressions for each situation. Learners can also practice listening at the same time and boost their confidence by communicating one on one with the AI tutor.
Thank you for trusting and using Eng Breaking the English learning app. Contact us and send feedback to:
Email: support@goga.ai
Website: https://goga.ai/
Terms of Use: https://goga.ai/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00141851:ios.summary: Triple Farm - Matching Game is a brand-new, fun, and delightful puzzle game featuring farm-themed objects and animals. It offers a relaxing gameplay experience where time flies by, and best of all, it can be played without a WiFi connection
bluejetty:00141851:ios.description:
Triple Farm - Matching Game is a brand-new, fun, and delightful puzzle game featuring farm-themed objects and animals. It offers a relaxing gameplay experience where time flies by, and best of all, it can be played without a WiFi connection. This new-generation matching puzzle game lets you match and collect goods or objects in an enjoyable and engaging way!
How to Play?
 • Remember, you’re racing against time! Each level has a set time limit.
 • During this time, aim to collect similar objects on the tiles located at the bottom of the gameplay screen.
 • Keep in mind: there are only 7 tiles available. You'll fail the level if you fill them up without making any triple matches.
 • Your goal is strategically using the tile spaces, creating triple matches, and collecting the required number and type of objects to complete the level within the time limit.
Good luck and have fun!

1000+ Ready-to-Use Templates

Customize your photo collage with adjustable grids, borders, and aspect ratios. Mix and match to create layouts that match your unique style.
Vibrant Gradients & Color Palettes

Fast Sharing

• Drag-and-drop interface for quick collage building
• Resize, crop, and rotate photos within the grid

• Add custom text with font, size, spacing, and color options

Whether you’re making a family photo collage, a mood board, a travel diary, or a birthday shoutout, this collage maker is the perfect app to turn your ideas into share-worthy designs.

bluejetty:00121318:ios.description:
Here comes a cute cooking x sim game featuring a Shiba Inu and other animals!
Cute pixel graphics + cooking + business management!
Prepare crepes in the cooking game and design your shop with furniture you like. You can dress up the adorable pixel dogs, too. There's a Shiba Inu, a retriever, a beagle, and more. 
◆How To Play◆
Work with the dogs to build a global crepe business. Use the money you earn to buy furniture and clothes, and decorate your crepe truck or cafe.
◆Gathering Ingredients◆
Collect strawberries, bananas, and other crepe ingredients.
◆Hand Out Flyers◆
Promote your shop by handing out flyers to the animals passing by.
◆Cooking Mode◆
Prepare crepes for customers in Cooking Mode.
◆Part-Timers◆
You can hire other dogs to work as part-timers. Part-timers can do tasks such as gathering ingredients or helping customers on their own. Work together to expand your crepe business.
◆Furniture◆
Buy furniture at the cat shops. Make life better with a chair or a bed. Customize the interior of your shop with benches, tables, and more.
◆Clothes◆
You can buy clothes on the second floor of the cat shops. Have your dogs wear matching outfits or clothes that go with your shop. You can keep up to three sets of clothing for each dog. 
◆Go Global◆
Save up money and open a shop in a new area.
◆Mini games◆
Match-3 puzzle game.
*Clothes, furniture, and different animals will be added in future updates.

Facebook https://www.facebook.com/GAME-START-LLC-494823844363263

bluejetty:00151829:ios.description:
Welcome to Merge Beauty: Love & Makeover!
Cold winter. No home. Julia and her daughter left out in the snow...
Julia thought she had found safety—but what awaited her was her husband's betrayal. 
Heartbroken but strong, she divorced him and married a humble mechanic.
But wait—he’s hiding a shocking secret… he’s actually a billionaire! 
Rags to riches? Lies or true love?
Help Julia rebuild her life, uncover secrets, and design her dream future through merge and makeover! 
Game Features
Satisfying and Strategic Merge Gameplay
 - Drag, drop, and merge items to complete tasks and earn coins!
 - Dozens of merge chains with evolving items await your discovery.
A Dramatic and Emotional Love Story
 - Earn coins through merging to unlock Julia’s gripping story chapters.
 - Discover betrayals, hidden truths, and choose love after heartbreak.
Emotional Home Renovation Through Coins
 - Use merge-earned coins to rebuild and decorate Julia’s dream home.
 - Every room you restore mirrors her emotional journey and recovery.
Fashionable and Stunning Makeover Experience
 - Merge to collect coins and unlock glamorous outfits for Julia.
 - Redefine her look—from broken to bold, you shape her transformation.
From heartbreak to billionaire romance—Julia needs you! Download Merge Beauty: Love & Makeover now!

bluejetty:00145181:ios.description:
Ever get asked for recommendations? Benable is the all-in-one platform to share your favorite: products, places, activities, services, videos, recipes, and more!
THE RECOMMENDATION APP FOR EVERYONE
• Create lists of anything you love
• Discover millions of trusted recs
• Earn commission from 35,000+ brands 
HOW DOES IT WORK?
When you join Benable, you create beautiful shareable lists of things you love. Adding recommendations is super easy! You just add the name or link of your rec (e.g. a restaurant, a book, a product, etc.) and Benable will pull in all the info automatically to make a beautiful recommendation card - photos, links, and more!
HOW DO I SHARE MY LISTS?
Tap to share the link to your Benable profile and lists anywhere you want! Simply copy the link and send it to a friend, paste it in your bio, or add it to your blog. Your recs and profile can be viewed by anyone - people don’t need a Benable account. And with the Benable Keyboard, you can share without ever leaving the app you're in! Turn any product link into your affiliate link, or pull up one of your saved recs and lists, and paste it right into your chat, caption, or bio.
WILL BENABLE HELP SPREAD MY CONTENT?
Yes! On the Discover pages, Trending page, in search results, and in people’s feeds. You’ll get frequent updates on what the Benable algorithm is looking for, and as you improve your Benable lists they’ll trend more and more across the platform and through SEO on the web. Over 1 million people browse Benable every month looking for trusted recommendations, and the Benable algorithm optimizes feeds for each person’s tastes!
35,000+ BRAND PARTNERS?
Yep! Benable has partnered with the world's biggest brands to help you monetize your recommendations. You get instant access to those brand partnerships as soon as you join! Whenever you add recommendations to your Benable lists, your recs will automatically be affiliate-linked. That means that whenever someone makes a purchase from your Benable lists, the brand partner will pay you a commission! Benable doesn't take a cent, you keep the full commission! You can then cash out on Venmo, Paypal, etc. Note: Benable contains affiliate links for creators may be compensated.
IS BENABLE JUST FOR PRODUCTS THEN?
Nope! You can literally recommend anything: restaurants you love, travel recs, articles, activities, resources, recipes, etc. If your recommendation is from a brand partner (e.g. product, hotel, etc) then it’ll get an affiliate link, but you can still recommend everything else!
HOW MUCH DOES BENABLE COST?
Benable is totally free! 
BENABLE IS ALL ABOUT AUTHENTICITY!
Benable is about real people, sharing genuine recommendations. Our algorithms reward the most authentic people and content across the platform, and our community is truly special. Benable brings together anyone who loves curation, finding and sharing great recommendations, and helping others!
KEY FEATURES:
• Recommend ANYTHING 
• Make lists public or private 
• Earn commissions from 35,000+ brands
• Opportunity for brand collabs and UGC
• Share your Benable content on other platforms
• Share from anywhere with the Benable Keyboard
• Grow your audience through Benable 
• Full algorithm insights
• Personalized feeds & notifications
• Discover millions of genuine recommendations

bluejetty:00075128:ios.description:
Dive into the heart-pounding action of Rugby Union with Rugby Nations 24! Fight every ruck, contest every catch, push with all your might at the maul, run for the line and score that cup winning try.
Now with new stadiums, game modes and enhanced game-play. Passes are quicker, kicks can be chained together and loose balls chased down allowing you to score even more spectacular tries. Combined with contested ball catches, new unique AI opponent play styles and a raft of other improvements Rugby has never felt so good.
Download Rugby Nations 24 for FREE now!
NEW STADIUMS
Experience the thrill of playing in Argentina, South Africa, and Italy with our brand new Stadiums! Join the incredible line-up of meticulously designed environments and feel right at home wherever you compete.
NEW WAYS TO PLAY
Ignite your competitive spirit by mastering adrenaline-pumping moves like diving for the ball and intercepting airborne passes to seize the advantage!
NEW GAME MODE
Get ready for the ultimate clash between the powerhouse teams of the Southern Hemisphere in the highly requested Four Nations game mode!
GET CREATIVE 
Create a unique team logo with a wide range of awesome shields and eye-catching emblems. The new kit design tool lets you fully customise your team's kit like never before. Get ready to stand out from the crowd!
TEAM SPONSORS
Partner up with all-new team sponsors and watch your team soar to new heights! With long-term goals spanning across multiple seasons, you'll never run out of things to strive for.
KEY FEATURES
- Choose from several game modes including the World Cup and Four Nations
- Play both Men's and Women's Rugby and explore all aspects of the game
- Enjoy brand new player visuals for both male and female players
- Immerse yourself in 15 beautifully designed stadiums
- Set new long-term goals and secure team sponsors
- Be cheered on by the enhanced stadium crowd
- Personalise your team with exciting customisation options
- Master new mechanics and finesse your play like never before
And, much much more!
IMPORTANT
This game is free-to-play but does include optional in-app purchases, which can be purchased with real money.

bluejetty:00076115:ios.description:
Synopsia is your ultimate audio book summary app, offering instant access to the key ideas of the best works. Whether you're on the go, cooking, or just taking a break, Synopsia broadens your horizons by allowing you to quickly discover key concepts.
Features:
Extended Library: Explore a vast selection of book summaries covering various genres, including business, personal development, health, history, and fiction.
Bionic Reading: Speed up your reading and absorb information faster with the Bionic Reading feature.
Adjustable Font Size: Customize your reading experience by adjusting the font size to your preferences.
Subtitles for Full Immersion: Immerse yourself in the story by activating subtitles on the audio player for an immersive experience.
Automatic Video Player: Let the story carry you away with the automatic video player for total immersion in the content.
Multiple Languages: Access books in a variety of languages, including French, English, Spanish, Hindi, German, Italian, Arabic, Chinese, Vietnamese, Japanese, and Korean.
Inspiring Quotes: Explore and share inspiring quotes from books to enrich your reading experience.
Speed Control: Customize your reading pace by adjusting the speed of audio books to your preferences.
Learn New Words: Enrich your vocabulary by discovering new words through our "Learn New Words" feature.
Key Points: Quickly access key points of each book for a deeper understanding in less time.
Book Downloads: Download your favorite book summaries for offline listening wherever you are.
Synopsia accompanies you on your literary journey, allowing you to learn, grow, and be inspired wherever you are. Download now and dive into an unparalleled reading experience.

- Clans and Head-to-Head Challenges.

- Featured sightings...and more!

bluejetty:00160333:ios.description:
This app uses Google Maps and other sources in order to allow you to place markers even without internet connection.
If you have any issues with the app, please contact me by email, I will most likely be able to help.
Features:
• Set a title, a description, a date, a color, an icon and pictures for each marker, and move them freely on the map
• Organise your markers into different folders
• Browse and organize your markers easily from the text-searchable markers list
• Search places from various sources and create a new marker from the result
• Open a marker's location in any other map application already installed
• Navigate to a marker's location with the integrated compass
• Display and copy marker GPS coordinates to clipboard with one click
• Display a marker's address if available
• Create path-markers and measure their distance easily
• Create polygon-surface-markers and measure their perimeter and area easily
• Create circle-surface-markers and measure perimeter and area easily
• Create GPS tracks recorded from your device location
• Share a captured image of the current map
• Share markers as KML files
• Import markers from a QR code
• Import/export markers from/to KML or KMZ files
• Import your Google Maps favorite locations (those marked with a star)
• Exported KML files are compatible with most other map softwares such as Google Earth
• Custom fields for markers: Checkbox, Date, Email, Text, Multi-choice, Phone, Web link
• Create templates for custom fields per folder: the child markers will inherit their parent folder's custom fields
Premium features:
• Save your markers on the cloud with WebDAV, Google Drive or Dropbox
• Collaborate with your friends by sharing your map cloud folder with them: anyone with access to the map folder can modify it and changes will be synced to everyone using the folder
• Restore previous versions of your cloud map folder
• One time purchase for a lifetime upgrade on your Apple account with an unlimited number of iOS devices
• No ads
Used permissions:
• Get your location => to locate you on the map
• Access to external storage => to export, save and import to/from files

bluejetty:00031989:ios.name: Sort Land Puzzle Game
bluejetty:00031989:ios.summary: Are you ready to enjoy puzzles and strategic matching with Sort Land? Sort Land offers an immersive and relaxing puzzle game that takes the colorful block puzzle world to a whole new level. Get ready to test your skills in sorting, combinin
bluejetty:00031989:ios.description:
Are you ready to enjoy puzzles and strategic matching with Sort Land? Sort Land offers an immersive and relaxing puzzle game that takes the colorful block puzzle world to a whole new level. Get ready to test your skills in sorting, combining and stacking differently colored pieces. Each section in the game is designed to be both visually pleasing and challenge your logic skills. If you want to relieve stress, exercise your mind and have fun at the same time, you're in the right place!
Journey to Colorful Puzle Game
Blending the classic sorting concept with an original design approach, Sort Land transforms the ordinary puzzle experience into an unforgettable journey by offering 3D and 2D elements together. In worlds decorated with different color palettes and visual effects:
Color Matching: Create a perfect whole by placing blocks of the same color side by side or on top of each other.
Merge: Create unique patterns by capturing the geometric harmony between the pieces.
Sorting: Place each block in the correct order and multiply your points while creating a visual feast.
Thanks to this rich content, you will constantly find yourself in a new challenge with blocks of different shapes such as Hexa, square, round or polygonal designs.
Strategic Matching: Every move that seems simple can turn into complex mathematical and logical structures in the later levels.
Fun Background Music: Specially selected music and ASMR sound effects allow you to feel the rhythmic satisfaction created by moving blocks.
Increasing Difficulty Level: While the first sections are simpler to get used to the game, the sections that become more difficult as you progress will literally provide brain training.
Daily Missions and Surprise Rewards
You can enter the game every day and complete daily tasks, get extra boosters or clues. In this way, you can develop new strategies and reach high scores without giving up even in the most difficult sections. The leaderboard allows you to compete with your friends and players from all over the world. In this way, you will both socialize and constantly pursue new goals!
Joyful Puzzle Features
Minimalist and Zen Design: A calm color palette that is easy on the eyes, simple interface and relaxing gameplay.
3D Graphics and Effects: Plan the locations of the blocks by following their 3D movement, making the puzzle experience more intuitive.
ASMR Sound Effects: Special sound effects that multiply the sense of satisfaction felt when the blocks touch each other, stack on top of each other and form a harmonious whole.
Strategic Brain Games: Each section is designed with different mechanics that require light or intense strategy. A fun and brain-developing experience awaits you.
Updates and New Levels: Sort Land's rich content library is updated at regular intervals. Newly added maps, color themes, block sets and surprise bonuses always keep the game fresh.
Who Should Start Playing Sort Land Now?
Those Who Want to Relieve Daily Stress: It offers a relaxing puzzle experience that will distract your mind, even for a few minutes.
Those Looking for Fun with Family and Friends: You can compete in competitive leaderboards or pass the sections by developing joint strategies.
Those Who Love Brain Games: Sort Land is full of puzzles that will strengthen your logic and visual intelligence skills. Puzzle and Block Games Beginners: Low difficulty levels make it easier to get used to the game. The harder it gets, the more satisfying moments you will experience.
Follow us to discover more fun games and get updates on all our games:
https://rotatelab.com/
https://www.instagram.com/rotatelab/
https://www.linkedin.com/company/rotatelab/

bluejetty:00169243:ios.summary:
Seattle Transit — Your Smarter Way Around Seattle
Get real-time bus, light rail, and ferry updates across the Puget Sound — all in one simple, reliable app designed for Seattle commuters.
“Seattle Transit makes getting around so much easi
bluejetty:00169243:ios.description:
Seattle Transit — Your Smarter Way Around Seattle
Get real-time bus, light rail, and ferry updates across the Puget Sound — all in one simple, reliable app designed for Seattle commuters.
“Seattle Transit makes getting around so much easier. Live arrivals are always accurate, and I love being able to see when my bus or train is actually coming.”
Why Seattle riders love Seattle Transit:
• Live King County Metro and Sound Transit tracking
• Stop and schedule alerts
• Trip planner with step-by-step directions
• Live and offline route maps
• One-tap “Get Me Home” journeys
• Customizable widgets for quick access
Never miss your stop again — with Get Off Alerts, Seattle Transit tells you exactly when to hop off. Track your bus, train, or ferry on the map in real time, see how crowded it is before boarding, and get instant alerts about delays, detours, and service changes.
Whether you’re commuting to downtown Seattle, catching Link Light Rail to the airport, or taking a ferry across the Sound, Seattle Transit keeps you connected wherever you go.
Coverage Includes:
• King County Metro Buses
• Sound Transit Express Buses and Link Light Rail
• Sounder Commuter Rail
• Community Transit and Everett Transit
• Pierce Transit and Intercity Transit
• Seattle Streetcar (South Lake Union & First Hill Lines)
• Washington State Ferries
• Real-time service alerts and detour updates
Plan trips, check live arrivals, and save your favourite stops — all in one simple app built just for the Seattle area.
--------
What is Seattle Transit?
Seattle Transit is a real-time public transport app for the Seattle and Puget Sound region. It provides live bus, train, and ferry tracking, trip planning, and service alerts.
Does it work with King County Metro?
Yes — Seattle Transit supports all King County Metro routes with real-time arrivals and live tracking.
Does it include Link Light Rail and Sound Transit?
Absolutely. You can view live Link Light Rail trains and Sound Transit Express buses, as well as Sounder Commuter Rail schedules.
Can I check ferry schedules?
Yes. Seattle Transit includes Washington State Ferries with live times and alerts for delays or cancellations.
Does it show service alerts and detours?
Yes — you’ll get real-time notifications about route changes, construction, and other disruptions across all major agencies.
Can I use Seattle Transit offline?
Yes — offline maps and saved timetables let you plan trips even without mobile data.
Will it remind me when to get off?
Yes. “Get Off Alerts” use GPS to let you know just before your stop, so you never miss it.
Is Seattle Transit free?
Yes — it’s free to download and use, with optional premium features and widgets available via in-app purchase.
How do I contact support?
Email talk@travelwhiz.app or message @trymomego on X (Twitter).
--------
Travel smarter with Seattle Transit — your all-in-one app for buses, trains, ferries, and more.
Download now and get live times, trip planning, and real-time alerts for the entire Seattle area.
Privacy Policy: travelwhiz.app/privacy
Terms of Use: www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00094620:ios.description:
Welcome to Crypto Fortune Tycoon-BTC Miner, a fun and strategic game where you take on the role of the owner of a virtual crypto mining farm. Your goal is to manage your mining farm, hire managers, and upgrade mining rigs to generate more resources, all while earning passive income in the process.
How to Play:
Manage Your Mining Farm: Start with a small mining farm and gradually expand by hiring managers and upgrading your mining rigs to improve efficiency and increase your production.
Hire Managers: There are multiple managers in the game, each with unique skills to help increase the productivity of your mining farm. By hiring better managers, you can boost your mining farm's output more efficiently.
Upgrade Mining Rigs: As you progress, you can upgrade your mining rigs to increase the rate at which you produce resources. Rig upgrades directly affect your resource production speed, and are essential for growing your virtual wealth.
Passive Income: Enjoy the benefit of passive income, as your mining farm will continue to generate resources even when you're not actively playing. Return to the game to collect your accumulated resources!
Important Notice:
Please note, Crypto Fortune Tycoon-BTC Miner is purely a game for entertainment and virtual economic experience. It does not involve any form of real cryptocurrency mining. The mining farms, rigs, and resources in the game are entirely virtual and will not use your device for any real mining activity. The purpose of the game is to offer a fun and relaxing experience where players can manage a crypto mining empire without any real-world cryptocurrency mining risks.
Why You'll Love This Game:
Simple to Play, Deep to Master: This game is suitable for players of all ages. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced strategist, you'll find enjoyment in building your mining empire.
Experience Passive Income: Enjoy the thrill of passive income as you optimize your mining farm and watch your resources grow over time.
Virtual Mining Empire Management: Dive into the world of crypto mining management and enhance your strategic decision-making while growing from a small operation to a massive mining empire.
No Device Mining Risks: The game has absolutely no connection to real cryptocurrency mining. Your device will not be used for any resource-draining activities, ensuring a safe and enjoyable experience.
Join Crypto Fortune Tycoon-BTC Miner now and build your very own mining farm. Become the true crypto tycoon and start earning your virtual wealth today!

bluejetty:00090736:ios.name: Faceter Video Surveillance
bluejetty:00090736:ios.summary: Faceter is smart cloud video surveillance (VSaaS) with its own line of security cameras. Connect third-party IP cameras or use a smartphone as a camera without buying equipment. Monitor offices, warehouses, stores, and your home from a sing
bluejetty:00090736:ios.description:
Faceter is smart cloud video surveillance (VSaaS) with its own line of security cameras. Connect third-party IP cameras or use a smartphone as a camera without buying equipment. Monitor offices, warehouses, stores, and your home from a single system. Get notifications in Telegram and Max, and use an AI Agent for quick archive search instead of long video playback.
Why You Need Faceter
Faceter combines any cameras into a single smart video surveillance system. Connect devices via ONVIF or RTSP with a public IP address. You can:
• Watch live video from any camera online through the cloud
• Use a smartphone as a surveillance camera (turn an old phone into an IP camera) without buying equipment
• Find any moment in the archive in seconds with smart event marking and timeline search instead of hours of viewing
• Keep video surveillance 24/7
• Get a free daily timelapse in messengers: review your whole day in 1 minute
• Receive event descriptions from the AI Agent
• Get event alerts via push notifications and messengers (Telegram, Max, etc.)
• Use the app on phone, tablet, computer, Mac, Windows, and TV
Any Cameras, One System
Maximum stability is ensured with Faceter's cameras: full compatibility and all analytics out of the box. Already have third-party cameras? Connect them via ONVIF and RTSP protocols.
Faceter records video locally to an SD card without internet or cloud fees. In development: our line of network video recorders (NVR) for hybrid systems.
Review a full day's archive in 5 minutes and download any clip instantly. We built a practical app design, fast servers, and a special cloud storage format.
Connecting a camera takes a couple of minutes. An old smartphone connects just as easily: convert a phone into a security camera without buying extra hardware.
Smart Detections
Built-in detections recognize human silhouettes, vehicles, pets, and movement, capturing line crossings and intrusions. The system cuts false alarms like rain, snow, waving branches, and shadows. You only get push alerts during real events.
Faceter AI Agent
The AI Agent works in Telegram, Max, or in the app. Chat with it in plain text instead of watching video. Ask a question and get a precise summary from the archive: "What time did the delivery car arrive?", "What happened on site from 12:00 to 13:00?", or "Did anyone enter the warehouse after closing?".
The agent also sends concise text descriptions of current events: "Person passed by", "Truck entered", "Dog near the door".
Why Choose Faceter
Faceter is an analytics tool with a transparent pricing model.
• AI Agent without overpaying: text reports are included in cloud subscriptions. No extra payment for AI features.
• Free basic features: live streaming and smart detections work free without a cloud plan. Cameras can record to an SD card without internet.
• No complex servers: launch without expensive servers or engineer visits. Human detection works without biometrics or facial recognition.
Only Useful Features
• Online live camera streaming
• Timelapse: full day in a minute
• Event alerts via push, Telegram, and Max
• Intelligent archive search
• Saving required video clips
• Access rights management
• Russian language interface
• Faceter compatibility with Windows, Mac, and TV
Faceter is also great for home: baby monitor, elderly care, or pet watching (with pet detection).
Set up video surveillance in 5 minutes. Get alerts in Telegram or Max when events happen. Download Faceter and monitor your home, office, or business from anywhere!

bluejetty:00187583:ios.name: How to Tie a Tie !
bluejetty:00187583:ios.summary: The need to tie a tie can appear unexpectedly – before a meeting, a job interview, a family celebration or a formal event. Your phone is always with you, so we recommend installing this application and keeping it ready for the future – it m
bluejetty:00187583:ios.description:
The need to tie a tie can appear unexpectedly – before a meeting, a job interview, a family celebration or a formal event. Your phone is always with you, so we recommend installing this application and keeping it ready for the future – it may prove very useful and save you from an awkward situation.
How to Tie a Tie is an application that is helpful for anyone who wears a tie. With clear step‑by‑step instructions and simple graphics, you can quickly and neatly tie a tie. Once you learn the knots, tying a tie will no longer be a problem and will not take you by surprise.
A well‑tied tie is a symbol of elegance and a polished appearance. Whether you are going to an important business meeting, a wedding, a formal dinner or a school event, a properly tied tie helps you look professional and well‑dressed.
There are many ways to tie a tie. Our app includes the most popular knots: the Half‑Windsor, the Windsor, the Pratt knot and the Four‑in‑Hand knot. Clear visual instructions will guide you step by step on how to tie each type of knot:
The Windsor knot is a classic British knot used for special occasions. Its name originated from the Duke of Windsor, who made it popular.
The Half‑Windsor knot is similar to the Windsor knot, but is lighter and easier to make. It is an elegant knot with a triangular shape.
The Pratt knot is also known as the Shelby knot, the Reversed Half‑Windsor knot, the American knot, or the Classical American knot. This knot, popular in the United States, fits many shirt and collar styles and is easier to tie than the Windsor knot.
The Four‑in‑Hand knot, also known as the Simple knot or the “number four knot”, is easy to tie and matches almost any collar style.
We encourage you to install this app. You never know when you might need to know how to tie a tie!
Important
Before you add your comment or rate the app, please read the advice below (tap “more” and scroll down).
New Features
We are planning to develop our application further by increasing its functionality and adding new features. If you have ideas, please send them to us via email at help@examobile.pl or describe them in the comments. We will develop the app accordingly so that it serves you well.

bluejetty:00171529:ios.description:
No more guessing what to do next. SHRED’s AI-powered coaching gives you the structure, motivation, and personalization you need to reach your goals—lose weight, get stronger, or stay consistent. Every plan adapts to your progress and equipment, so you always know you’re training the right way for you. Your goals. Your coach. Your results.
Featured by Apple, Rolling Stone, Men’s Health, Women’s Health, GQ, PCMag, Business Insider, Goop, Garage Gym Reviews, and others.
PERSONALIZED TRAINING THAT EVOLVES WITH YOU
From day one, SHRED builds your plan around how you move and what you want to achieve. As you train, SHRED’s AI learns your patterns—how hard you push, how you recover, and when to advance or pull back. It automatically adjusts reps, sets, rest, and intensity to match your evolving strength and stamina. Gym or home, beginner or advanced—SHRED scales with you and keeps every workout challenging, efficient, and results-driven.
PROGRAMS ENGINEERED FOR REAL RESULTS
Explore expertly designed training paths in hypertrophy, powerlifting, strength, bodyweight, or sculpting. Every program is crafted by real coaches and refined by data from millions of workouts. Whether you’re chasing size, strength, or definition, SHRED’s system combines proven structure with adaptive progression so you keep improving week after week.
YOUR EQUIPMENT, OPTIMIZED
Have dumbbells, a rack, bands, kettlebells—or nothing at all? SHRED automatically adapts to your setup so you get the perfect workout wherever you train. Update your available gear anytime, and your workouts will instantly reconfigure to match your environment.

bluejetty:00024210:ios.description:
Remote Mouse™ turns your mobile device into a powerful remote control app for your PC or Mac. Use your phone or tablet as a wireless mouse, keyboard, and touchpad — complete with multi-touch gestures and media controls. Whether you're watching movies, controlling a presentation, or browsing the web from your couch, Remote Mouse™ offers an effortless way to control your computer remotely.
With over 20 million users and featured by CNET, Mashable, and Product Hunt, Remote Mouse™ offers one of the most elegant solutions to computer control from mobile.
What you can do:
Mouse 
• Control the cursor like a real PC mouse 
• Move using your phone’s gyroscope (Gyro Mouse) 
• Left-handed mode support
Keyboard 
• Type remotely in any language 
• Use voice input (if supported by your soft keyboard)
• Send system and app shortcuts
• Adaptive layouts for Mac or PC 
• Use your phone as a remote keyboard for your computer
Touchpad 
• Simulates Apple Magic Trackpad 
• Supports multi-touch gestures 
• Ideal wireless touchpad app for remote navigation
Specialty Panels 
• Media Remote: Control videos, music, and presentations across apps and sites like YouTube, Netflix, Disney+, Apple TV+, VLC, Spotify, and more. 
• Browser Remote: Navigate Chrome, Firefox, and Opera 
• App Switcher: Launch and switch between apps 
• Power Options: Shut down, sleep, or restart remotely 
• Clipboard Sync: Copy and paste text/images across devices
Other features 
• Control volume using physical phone buttons 
• Secure the connection with a password 
• Reorder specialty panels 
• Customize your remote with personal wallpapers
Connection & Compatibility
• Connect over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth
• Connect by IP address, QR code, or connection history
• Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux
Easy to set up:
1. Download and install Remote Mouse for desktop on your computer: [https://remotemouse.net](https://remotemouse.net)
2. Launch the desktop version (it runs in the background)
3. Connect your mobile device to your computer via Wi-Fi or Bluetooth
