bluejetty:00131534:ios.name: EndeavorRx® - Kid
bluejetty:00131534:ios.summary: EndeavorRx is the first & only FDA-authorized video game treatment to improve attention for kids 8-17 with primarily inattentive or combined-type ADHD. Access to treatment in the game requires a prescription or order from your child's healt
bluejetty:00131534:ios.description:
EndeavorRx is the first & only FDA-authorized video game treatment to improve attention for kids 8-17 with primarily inattentive or combined-type ADHD. Access to treatment in the game requires a prescription or order from your child's health care provider. If you receive a prescription for EndeavorRx, you will be sent an email with instructions to complete payment and receive an activation code.
Created by world-class neuroscientists and award-winning game designers, EndeavorRx is powered by Selective Stimulus Management Engine (SSME™) technology that is designed to challenge and target areas of the brain that play a key role in attention function.
When playing the game, the goal is for your child to successfully navigate their character through courses while collecting targets and avoiding obstacles. They’ll chase mystic creatures, race through different worlds, use boosts to problem-solve while building their very own universe — and the difficulty levels adjust in real-time based on each child’s performance.
Follow your child's treatment journey with EndeavorRx Insight®: the official EndeavorRx companion app for caregivers. This free app connects directly to your child’s EndeavorRx treatment, providing a daily snapshot of your child's in-game mission completion and effort score. Download from the app store today!
EndeavorRx is a digital therapeutic indicated to improve attention function as measured by computer-based testing in children ages 8-17 years old with primarily inattentive or combined-type ADHD, who have a demonstrated attention issue. Patients who engage with EndeavorRx 5 days per week for 4-6 weeks demonstrate improvements in a digitally assessed measure, Test of Variables of Attention (TOVA®), of sustained and selective attention and may not display benefits in typical behavioral symptoms, such as hyperactivity. EndeavorRx should be considered for use as part of a therapeutic program that may include clinician-directed therapy, medication, and/or educational programs, which further address symptoms of the disorder. No serious adverse events were reported. Federal law restricts this device to sale by or on the order of a licensed health care provider. For full instructions for use and important safety information, please visit www.endeavorrx.com/instructions-for-use/.
At the end of the treatment period, your child may benefit from additional treatment, as directed by your child’s health care provider.
If your child experiences any side effects related to playing EndeavorRx (such as frustration, headache, dizziness, emotional reaction, nausea, or aggression), stop the treatment and contact your child’s health care provider before resuming.
EndeavorRx may not be appropriate for patients with photo-sensitive epilepsy, color blindness, or physical limitations that restrict use of a mobile device; caregivers should consult with their child’s health care provider.
For more information, visit EndeavorRx.com.

Other trademarks are trademarks or registered trademarks of their respective owners. Please see the Terms of Use below for applicable patent protection for EndeavorRx.

bluejetty:00099618:ios.description:
Sing karaoke, create covers, and sound like a pro—right from your phone.
Dubsy is the easiest way to sing your favorite songs, make karaoke-style covers, and share your voice with the world. Whether you’re practicing vocals, jamming on an instrument, or just vibing solo, Dubsy turns any song into your stage. No studio, no complicated software—just you, your phone, and your love for music.
Key Features:
- Sing karaoke with high-quality backing tracks and scrolling lyrics
- Add vocal effects like autotune and reverb to polish your sound
- Upload any song or search tracks in the Dubsy catalog 
- Remove vocals to create your own backing tracks
- Isolate instruments like drums and bass for practice or overdubs
- Record with your phone mic—vocals, guitar, anything you want
- Share with friends using custom animations and effects
- Store your creations and revisit them anytime
Dubsy is your personal karaoke machine, practice tool, and mini recording studio—all in one app.
Follow us for updates and user features:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dubsyapp/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@dubsyapp

apple-macos:6763623101.name: Sooon — Wishlist shopping
apple-macos:6763623101.description:
Sooon brings the products you want to buy into one simple wishlist app.
Today, every store and app has its own saved items. A jacket in one app, a gift idea in another, a home decor item left in a cart, an app to remember later, a link saved in a note... after a while, your shopping ideas are everywhere.
Sooon keeps them in one place.
See a product online? Save it to Sooon from Safari or another app. Sooon creates a clear entry with the useful details, lets you choose the right image, then organizes the product in your library or in a wishlist.
Sooon is designed for things you don't want to forget: fashion, home decor, tech, gifts, books, everyday items, apps, and ideas for later.
With Sooon, you can:
- save products from Safari or another app
- find your future purchases in one place
- organize your ideas into wishlists
- share a wishlist with others
- keep a private note on a product
- return to the store's website when you are ready to buy

Even the palest ink is better than the best memory. But with PassLock, you don’t need ink or memory. The data stored in PassLock can only be read by you; not even the developers or Apple can access it! Don’t challenge the complex password security issues of the information age with your memory. Worried about privacy breaches? We have made our code public on GitHub, open to scrutiny by everyone around the world. Based on the principle of security first, open source doesn’t mean you can run this project directly. Some security-related information like encryption algorithms, keys, and Xcode project configurations are not publicly available.
Unlike most password managers that store your passwords on private company central servers, all the data you create in PassLock is stored locally on your device or in your private iCloud container. We don’t have our own servers at all! And all the data is doubly encrypted using AES256 and RSA. How long would it take to brute force AES256? If you had a supercomputer capable of calculating 2 billion times per second, it would take approximately 2,104,000,000,000 trillion years to crack an AES128 encrypted data. Yes, 2,104 billion billion years, far exceeding the lifespan of the universe!
Download PassLock now, and you can:
● Save important accounts (supporting history passwords, notes, image attachments), private photos, and private notes.
● Autofill passwords based on URLs. We have designed a feature to automatically extract URLs through search engines, greatly improving efficiency.

● Record all historical passwords for accounts and support manual filling of historical passwords.
● A simple and convenient strong password generator.
● Detect if your account has been leaked on the notorious dark web.
● Data is saved locally by default and can be used without network authorization. If you accidentally uninstall the app, local data will be lost.
● Sync local data to iCloud without worrying about data loss, but it will take up your private iCloud space.
● Delete data stored in iCloud and keep only local data. Switch freely.
● Open and transparent source code and console demonstration, so you can understand how the private iCloud database is designed.
● Import important photos from your album into PassLock, such as IDs, bank cards, driving licenses, etc.
● Store your home Wi-Fi, router admin passwords, children's birth information, utility accounts, and more.

apple-macos:6827376815.name: VRN Browser
apple-macos:6827376815.description:
VRN is a privacy-first browser built on one idea: the network stays closed until you ask for a page.
Most browsers keep every tab online in the background. VRN gives each tab a short-lived permit instead. The tab in front stays connected while you read, background tabs are cut off within seconds, and sending VRN to the background seals every tab. A page can never reopen its own connection; only you can, by tapping, refreshing or navigating.

fdroid:com.egron.lampan.name: Lampan
fdroid:com.egron.lampan.summary: Stream Android audio to AirPlay speakers and TVs
fdroid:com.egron.lampan.description:
Lampan captures playback audio from Android apps and streams it directly to
AirPlay receivers on your local network.
Features include:
* AirPlay 1 support for speakers such as IKEA Symfonisk and Sonos
* Native encrypted AirPlay 2 for compatible receivers such as Sony Bravia TVs
* Automatic receiver discovery and remembered device capabilities
* Multi-receiver streaming with manual synchronization adjustments
* Background streaming and volume control
* Secure local storage for successfully verified receiver access
Lampan has no accounts, advertisements, subscriptions, analytics, or cloud
relay. Audio and receiver control traffic remain on your local network.
Android playback-capture restrictions still apply. Apps can prevent their audio
from being captured, and Lampan does not bypass DRM protection.
